en.title: Plans and billing for each product
en.description: Each Yammbo product is subscribed to and paid for separately. What each one costs and where you see, change or cancel your plan.
en.body:
Since [each product has its own account](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/account/sign-in/), **each one also has its own plan and its own invoice**. If you use two products, you pay two plans separately, and canceling one doesn't cancel the other.

## By product

| Product | Price | Where you manage the plan |
|---|---|---|
| **Yammbot** | One month free, no card; then $4.99 a month or $39.99 a year | In its web panel, **Plan y facturación** (Plan and billing) |
| **Yammbo POS** | 30-day free trial; then Starter $60 a month or Business $90 a month (with online ordering) | In the dashboard, **Billing**, or in the app, **Settings > Plan and subscription** |
| **Yammbo Store** | $90 a month per location, no per-order commission; optional add-ons | In the dashboard, **My plan** |
| **Yammbo Web** | A Free plan and paid plans (Basic, Standard and Pro) | In your Web account |
| **Yammbo Music** | A free account, and paid plans that remove ads and unlock skips, likes, playlists, lyrics and downloads in the app. Current prices at `music.yammbo.com/pricing` | At `music.yammbo.com/billing`, or **Mi Cuenta** in the app |
| **Yammbo TV** | Basic $7.99 a month (1 device), Standard $12.99 (2 devices), Premium $19.98 (3 devices); also yearly. Current prices at `tv.yammbo.com/pricing` | At `tv.yammbo.com/mi-suscripcion` |

Prices are in US dollars. Each product's article has more detail on its plans:

- Yammbot: [Plan and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/yammbot/plan-and-billing/).
- POS: [Plan and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/plan-and-billing/).
- Store: [Plan, pricing and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/plan-pricing-and-billing/).
- Web: [Plans and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/web/plans-and-billing/).
- Music: [Plans and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/plans-and-billing/).
- TV: [What is Yammbo TV](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/tv/overview/).

## Invoices, card and canceling

For Yammbot, POS, Store and TV, payments are processed by **Stripe**. From each one's plan screen you open the Stripe portal, where you change your card, download invoices and cancel. Web also accepts PayPal.

On Yammbot, Web and TV, when you cancel the plan doesn't renew and you keep access until the end of the period you already paid for. For POS and Store, see what happens when you cancel in their plan article.

Write to **support@yammbo.com** saying which product the charge is for, the email of that account and the date.

en.title: Your Yammbo accounts and signing in
en.description: Each Yammbo product has its own account. Where you sign in to each one, how, and what to do if you can't get in.
en.body:
**Each Yammbo product has its own account.** There is no single account for all of them: if you use, say, Yammbo POS and Yammbo Web, you have two separate accounts, each with its own way to sign in and its own plan. You can use the same email for both, but being signed in to one doesn't sign you in to the other.

## Where and how you sign in to each product

| Product | Where you sign in | How |
|---|---|---|
| **Yammbot** | In the Android app and at `bot.yammbo.com/entrar` | Email and password. The same account works for the app and its web panel. |
| **Yammbo POS** | `pos.yammbo.com/dashboard/login` and the Android app | On the web, email and password. In the app, your email and a 6-digit code to link the tablet, then your PIN. |
| **Yammbo Store** | `store.yammbo.com/dashboard/login` | Email and password. It's a separate account from POS. |
| **Yammbo Web** | `web.yammbo.com/login` | Email and password, or Google or Twitter. |
| **Yammbo Music** | `music.yammbo.com/login` and the Android app | Email and password, or Google or X (Twitter) on the website. The Android app only takes email and password. |
| **Yammbo TV** | `tv.yammbo.com/auth/login` and the apps | Email and password only. On the website you type your email, press **Continue**, and then the password. On a TV, the app shows a QR code that you scan with your phone to sign in. |

More detail in each product's article:

- Yammbot: [Getting started](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/yammbot/getting-started/).
- POS: [The web dashboard](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/the-dashboard/) and [Install the app and link the tablet](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/install-and-link/).
- Store: [Signing in](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/signing-in/).
- Web: [Create your account and sign in](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/web/create-your-account-and-sign-in/).
- Music: [Signing in](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/signing-in/).
- TV: [What is Yammbo TV](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/tv/overview/).

## If you can't get in

**With a password (Yammbot, Web, Music and TV):** on that product's sign-in screen, use the forgot-password link. The email to set a new password comes from that product, not from another one, and its link works for **60 minutes**. On TV the link only appears after you type your email and press **Continue**.

**Yammbo POS:** at `pos.yammbo.com/dashboard/login` tap **"Forgot my password"**, type your email and you get a 6-digit code that works for **30 minutes**. Use it to set a new password. The tablet has no password: if it asks you to sign in again, use the code sent to your email. See [POS troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/troubleshooting/).

**In any product:**

- Check you're typing the same email you signed up with **on that product**. Having an account on another Yammbo product doesn't give you access to this one.
- Check your spam or promotions folder.
- If it still doesn't arrive, write to **support@yammbo.com** saying which product you're trying to sign in to and with which email.

Step-by-step help, with the messages each product shows: [I can't sign in](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/troubleshooting/cant-sign-in/).

Each product runs separately, with its own data and its own plan. What you do in one (change the password, cancel the plan, delete the account) doesn't affect the others.

en.title: Backups
en.description: Turn on the daily Google Drive backup, make manual backups, export them to a file and restore them on a tablet.
en.body:
Backups keep your sales, menu and employees so you do not lose them if the tablet breaks, is lost or you replace it. They are in Settings > **Backups**.

If you restore on another tablet, you will have to type the keys of the link/QR payment providers again (see [Payment links and QR](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/payment-links-and-qr/)).

## Daily backup to Google Drive

It is an automatic backup to your Google Drive, in a private app folder that nobody else sees. 30 days are kept.

1. Go to Settings > **Backups**.
2. Tap **Connect Google Drive** and choose your Google account. You will see "Google account: (name)".
3. Turn on **Automatic daily copy (around 3:00 am)**.

Things to know:

- Without connecting Google Drive there is no automatic backup.
- The time is the tablet's clock time. The backup runs with the tablet connected to the internet and the battery not low.
- If the tablet was off or offline and the last good backup is more than 26 hours old, the app asks for a recovery backup.
- If you use several tablets, **only one** uploads the backup, to avoid duplicates: the register with the lowest receipt prefix seen in the last 3 days. The screen tells you "This device makes the location's daily backup…" or "The location's daily backup is made by: X."
- If Google revokes access, you will see "Google Drive needs to be reconnected" and "Backup stopped", with a **Reconnect** button.
- To stop using Drive, tap **Disconnect Google Drive**.

## Make a backup now

Tap **Back up now** on any tablet. The screen shows "Last successful copy: (name)", or "There is no copy yet." If it failed, you will see "The copy of (name) failed: (name)".

## Export to a file

If the tablet does not have Google Play Services (so it cannot use Google Drive), or you simply prefer to keep the backup yourself:

1. In **Backups** tap **Export a copy to a file**.
2. Choose where to save it. A `.zip` file is created and the app says "Copy saved to the file."
3. Keep that file somewhere safe, off the tablet.

## What the backup includes and what it does not

| Includes | Does not include |
|---|---|
| The whole database (sales, menu, employees, customers, settings) | App preferences |
| Product photos | The Google account |
| The logo | The link with food.yammbo.com |
| An index with the business name, the date, the device and a signature for each file | The keys of the link/QR payment providers |

Also, the backup does not clone the tablet's identity: a restored tablet does not impersonate the original.

## How much is kept

- Backups older than 30 days are deleted, but the 3 most recent are always kept.
- Maximum size: 1100 MB for the full backup and 512 MB for the database. Product photos are up to 4 MB each.

## Restore a backup

Restoring **replaces all the tablet's data** with the backup's. The app keeps the previous data until it confirms the new backup started correctly.

1. On a new tablet, on "What is this tablet for?" choose **Restore a backup**. On an already installed tablet, go to Settings > **Backups**.
2. Pick the backup with **See copies in Google Drive** or **Restore from a file**, and tap **Restore**.
3. You will see **Restore this copy** with the backup's date, business and device, and the warning that the current data is erased and replaced. The app restarts.
4. Enter the **Owner's PIN** and type the word **RESTAURAR** ("Type RESTAURAR to confirm"). On a fresh install with no employees the PIN is not asked.
5. If the tablet **has no sales**, the app asks about its identity:
   - "Replace the device of the backup (same number and receipts)": use it if the original tablet is no longer in use.
   - "Use a new number (receipts start again under a new prefix)": use it if the original device is still working.
   If the tablet already has sales, it keeps its own identity.
6. Tap **Restore and restart**. You will see "Restoring... the app is restarting."

When it finishes:

- "The copy was restored. If something looks wrong, reopen the app."
- If the new backup does not start properly, the app goes back to the previous data: "The restored copy did not start correctly and the previous data was put back."
- "The restore could not be applied. Your current data was not touched."

After restoring, the tablet is no longer joined to the location (if there were several tablets, it must be joined again) and has no Google account, so you will have to reconnect Google Drive.

### When you cannot restore

- If the tablet is joined to others in the location: "This device is linked to others in the business. To restore, remove it from the business first (or restore on a new device) and join it again afterwards."
- If the tablet was removed from the location: "This device was removed from the business and cannot restore. Use Erase data first; then you can restore as on a new device."
- If the backup is from a newer app version: "The backup comes from a newer version of the app. Update the app." An older backup is accepted.

## Backup errors

| Message | What to do |
|---|---|
| "The file is not a Yammbo Food POS backup." | You picked another kind of file. Find the right `.zip`. |
| "The backup is damaged or was modified (checksum mismatch)." and other "The backup is damaged…" messages | The file was altered or downloaded badly. Use another backup. |
| "The backup is missing files.", "The backup has no database.", "The backup is too big." | The file is incomplete or not valid. Use another backup. |
| "This device has no Google Play services, so it cannot use Google Drive. Use the copy to a file." | Use **Export a copy to a file**. |
| "Google Drive is not set up for this version of the app yet." | This app version cannot use Google Drive yet. Use the backup to a file and write to support. |
| "Google Drive is not connected.", "Google Drive needs to be reconnected" or "Google did not authorize access. Try again." | Connect or reconnect Google Drive. |
| "No internet connection. It will be retried later." | It retries by itself. |
| "Your Google Drive is full. Free some space and try again." | Free space in Drive. The previous backup is still available. |
| "Google asks to wait a moment. It will be retried." or "Google Drive did not answer properly. It will be retried." | Temporary. The app retries up to 3 times. |
| "The copy no longer exists in Google Drive." | It was deleted from Drive. Pick another one. |
| "There is no space left on this device." | Free up space on the tablet. |
| "The file could not be read or written." | Try again. |
| "A backup is already running. Wait for it to finish." | Only one backup runs at a time. |
| "A restore is pending. Restart the app to finish it." | Close and reopen the app. |
| "That PIN is not an owner's, or the keypad is locked for a few seconds." | Use an owner's PIN or wait a few seconds. |
| "The confirmation word is missing." | Type RESTAURAR. |

Use **Export a copy to a file** as an alternative and keep the file somewhere other than the tablet. If the problem continues, write to us at support@yammbo.com.

## Related

- [Several tablets](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/several-tablets/)
- [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/troubleshooting/)

en.title: Charging a sale
en.description: How to take cash, card or transfer payments, split a payment, accept another currency and give the customer a receipt.
en.body:
When the order is ready, tap **Charge** with the total (for example, "Charge C$250"). The payment screen opens, where you record how the customer pays.

You can't charge without a shift. If there isn't one, the register says "Open a shift first to be able to charge." See [Shifts and cash drawer](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/shifts-and-cash-drawer/).

## The payment screen

- **Total due**: what the customer must pay.
- **Remaining**: what is still not covered.
- **Change**: the change you must give back.
- **Add payment** and **Remove**: add or delete payments in the list. Until you add one you'll see "No payments added yet."
- **Confirm**: only enabled once the bill is fully covered.

When you tap **Charge**, anything not yet sent to the kitchen is sent automatically.

## Taking cash

1. Choose cash and tap a quick button: the exact amount or one of the next banknotes (up to 4 buttons). The payment is added right away.
2. If the customer gives a different amount, type it in **Other amount received (currency)** and tap **Add payment**.
3. The screen shows the **Change**. Give it back to the customer.
4. Tap **Confirm**.

Change is always calculated in the base currency and is only given for cash payments.

### Cash in another currency

If you accept a second currency (for example US$), there is a cash button for each currency. Type the **Amount received (currency)**, tap **Add payment** and the register shows "Equals (name) at the rate of (name)". Other currencies are only accepted as cash.

Currencies are set in **Settings** > **Sales and taxes** > **Currency**: **Base currency** and **Other currencies you accept** (up to 3). If your register is linked to food.yammbo.com, the second currency and its rate are defined in the web dashboard.

### Cash rounding

In **Settings** > **Sales and taxes** > **Currency** you can choose **Cash rounding**: no rounding, or rounding to 0.50, 1 or 5 units of the base currency. It only applies when the payment is in cash.

## Taking a card payment

1. Open the card tab.
2. Type the **Amount (empty is what is left)**. If you leave it empty, it takes everything that is remaining.
3. Optionally, enter the **Authorization number (optional)** from the card terminal.
4. Tap **Add payment**, then **Confirm**.

## Taking a bank transfer

1. Open the transfer tab.
2. Type the amount and the **Reference or receipt number** (up to 40 characters). It is required if that method has the **Ask for a reference** option turned on.
3. If you set up your bank details, the **Transfer details** block appears so the customer can see them.
4. Tap **Add payment**, then **Confirm**.

## Split or partial payments

You can add several payments to the same bill: for example, C$100 in cash and the rest by card.

1. Add the first payment with **Add payment**.
2. Check how much is **Remaining**.
3. Add another payment until the bill is covered.
4. Tap **Confirm**.

Card and transfer payments can't be more than what is remaining. Only cash can be higher, and the difference is returned as change.

## Your own payment methods

In **Settings** > **Payment methods** you decide how you get paid:

- **Accept cash**: turns cash on or off.
- **Add method**: creates a method of type **Card or electronic payment** or **Transfer or deposit**. Each has a **Name**, **Ask for a reference** and **Active**, and you can reorder them with **Move up** and **Move down**.
- You can have up to 10 cards and 10 bank accounts.
- A transfer method includes bank, account holder, account number (4 to 34 digits), account currency and instructions for the customer (optional).
- At least one way of charging must stay on: **Leave at least one way of charging active**.
- Each method needs its own name: "Every payment method you add needs a name." and "Two payment methods have the same name."

If your register is linked, payment methods are shared with food.yammbo.com in both directions. See [The register and the web dashboard](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/register-and-web-dashboard/).

## After charging: the receipt

When done, you see **Sale paid** with the receipt number and the **Change**. From there you can give the receipt to the customer:

- **Print**: prints on the receipt printer.
- **WhatsApp**: asks for the **Customer phone** and opens WhatsApp with the message.
- **Text message**: sends it by SMS to the customer's phone.
- **Email**: asks for the **Customer email**. With the register linked, the server sends the email; if there is no internet, it waits in a queue and is discarded after 24 hours. The register shows **Sending the receipt to (name)**, **Receipt sent to (name)** or **The receipt to (name) could not be sent: (name)**, with **Open mail app** and **Discard**.
- **Show receipt QR** (only with the register linked): the customer scans it and sees their receipt on their phone. It reads "Scan to see your receipt. Available for 15 days."

When you send the receipt by WhatsApp, text message or share, a «Ver recibo: (link)» line is added. If the link couldn't be created, the receipt goes without it and the register tells you (**Sent without the receipt link. (name)**).

You can tick **Save as customer** to store the phone or email. To start another sale, tap **New sale**; at a table, tap **Continue**.

To reprint a receipt later, use the sales history. See [Selling](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/selling/).

## Common errors

| Message | What it means and what to do |
|---|---|
| "Open a shift first to be able to charge." | No shift is open on this tablet. Open one in the Shift section. |
| "There is still money left to collect." | The payments don't cover the total. Add another payment. |
| "Non-cash payments cannot exceed what is left to pay." | Lower the card or transfer amount to what is remaining. |
| "This payment method needs a reference." | Type the reference or receipt number. |
| "One of the payments uses a method that is no longer active. Remove it and add it with another method." | Remove that payment and add it again with an active method. |
| "The phone number is not valid. Enter 8 digits or the full number with the country code." | Fix the number (8 digits, or the full number with country code). |
| "The email is not valid." | Check that the email is typed correctly. |
| "There is no app to send the receipt that way." | The tablet doesn't have the needed app installed (for example WhatsApp). Use another channel. |
| "This tab was paid (or voided) on another device." | Another tablet already closed the bill. The register releases it; check the sales history. |

## Next step

- [Payment links and QR](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/payment-links-and-qr/)
- [Shifts and cash drawer](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/shifts-and-cash-drawer/)

en.title: Create your account on food.yammbo.com
en.description: Owner sign-up, email verification, the 6-step setup wizard, Yammbo approval and creating the Owner employee with a PIN.
en.body:
Before you use the register you need an account on the web dashboard, with the business approved and an **Owner** employee with a PIN. This is the order to follow.

## 1. Create the account

1. Go to **food.yammbo.com/dashboard/signup**. On the public home page the link is «Para restaurantes» (For restaurants).
2. Enter **Your name** («Tu nombre»), **Email** («Correo electrónico») and **Password** («Contraseña», at least 10 characters).
3. Click **Create account** («Crear cuenta»).

## 2. Verify your email

1. You will see «Revisa tu correo» (Check your email). We send a 6-digit code that **expires in 30 minutes**. The subject is «Tu código de Yammbo Food» followed by the code.
2. Enter the code in the **Code** field («Código») and click **Verify** («Verificar»).
3. If it did not arrive or it expired, click **Send another code** («Enviar otro código»).
4. The email also includes a confirmation link. If you use it, it asks for your password for security and then **Confirm email** («Confirmar correo»).

If that email already had an account, you get a notice titled «Ya tienes una cuenta en Yammbo Food».

## 3. Sign in to the dashboard

You sign in to the dashboard with **email and password** at food.yammbo.com/dashboard/login (**Sign in**, «Entrar»). If you forgot your password, click **Forgot my password** («Olvidé mi contraseña»): we send a code (valid for 30 minutes) to set a new one.

## 4. The 6-step wizard

On your first sign-in you see **«Configura tu restaurante»** (Set up your restaurant) with «Paso N de 6» (Step N of 6).

| Step | What it asks for |
|---|---|
| 1. Your details («Tus datos») | Your phone and Country (sets the currency and time zone) |
| 2. Your business («Tu negocio») | Restaurant name, Type of food, Short description, Business phone, WhatsApp for orders and Business country |
| 3. Taxes and service («Impuestos y servicio») | Typical values for your country |
| 4. Address («Dirección») | Branch name (for example Principal), Address, Landmark, City, Time zone and Map location (with «Usar mi ubicación actual», use my current location) |
| 5. Hours («Horarios») | For each day: Closed, or the Opens and Closes times |
| 6. Logo | Square image at least 512 × 512 px (JPG, PNG or WebP), with «Elegir imagen» (choose image). Optional: «Omitir por ahora» (skip for now) |

At the end click **Finish** («Terminar»).

In step 2 the country sets the currency and time zone, and it **cannot be changed** once the business leaves the setup stage. If you change it inside step 2, the wizard restarts from there with the suggested currency, time zone and taxes of the new country.

More useful details:

- The taxes in step 3 are only guidelines. Confirm the current rate with your accountant; you can change them later under **Store** («Tienda»).
- Step 2 creates your business and its public link, which comes from the name (food.yammbo.com/ plus the short name). If the name is taken, -2, -3 and so on is added. The link **does not change** if you rename the restaurant.
- You can create up to 5 businesses every 24 hours per user.

## 5. Wait for approval

When you click Finish, your business goes into review. In the **Panel** section (the first one in the menu) you will see: **«En revisión por Yammbo. Te avisamos por correo cuando esté aprobado.»** (Under review by Yammbo. We will email you when it is approved.)

When it is approved you get the email **«Aprobamos (your restaurant)»** and the status changes to **«Publicado»** (Published). Until it is approved:

- The register **cannot be linked**. The code is rejected as if it were wrong.
- If the status says «Falta terminar la configuración» (Setup not finished), click **«Continuar configuración»** (Continue setup).

If your restaurant shows as suspended, the dashboard displays «Tu restaurante está suspendido.» with the reason and the **«Hablar con Yammbo»** (Talk to Yammbo) button. While it lasts, the online store and new orders are turned off. Write to support@yammbo.com or use **Support** («Soporte»).

## 6. Create the Owner employee with a PIN

To link a register with a dashboard code, **there must be at least one active employee with the «Dueño» (Owner) role**. Create it like this:

1. In the dashboard go to **Team** («Equipo») and open the **POS employees** tab («Empleados del POS»).
2. Click **Add employee** («Agregar empleado»).
3. Enter the **Name**, choose the **Owner** role and enter a **PIN** of 4 to 6 digits.
4. Save.

PIN rules: it cannot repeat across active employees and, once saved, it is **never shown again**. If you forget it, set a new one with **New PIN** («PIN nuevo»).

If you try to generate the code without that employee, the dashboard says: «Crea primero un empleado con el rol Dueño en la sección Empleados de Equipo. Sin él no se puede vincular una tableta.» (Create an employee with the Owner role first.)

When you link the register by signing in with your account (email and code) and the restaurant has no employees yet, the app itself asks you to create the owner with a PIN. It is still a good idea to create it in the dashboard first. See [First start and linking](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/first-start-and-linking/).

## Common sign-up errors

| Message | What to do |
|---|---|
| «Correo o contraseña incorrectos.» (Wrong email or password.) | Check your details or recover the password |
| «El código no es correcto o ya venció.» (The code is wrong or expired.) | Click «Enviar otro código» |
| «Demasiados intentos. Pide un código nuevo.» (Too many attempts. Request a new code.) | Request a new code |
| «Demasiados intentos. Espera unos minutos y vuelve a probar.» (Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.) | Wait a few minutes |
| «Esta cuenta está desactivada. Escribe a support@yammbo.com.» (This account is deactivated.) | Write to support |
| «No pudimos enviar el correo. Prueba de nuevo en unos minutos.» (We could not send the email.) | Try again later |
| «Primero verifica tu correo.» (Verify your email first.) | Finish the email verification |

## Next step

With the business approved and the Owner created, install the app on the tablet: [Install and update](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/install-and-update/).

en.title: Customers and reports
en.description: Save your customers, review your sales by day, hour, product and employee, and export reports to CSV.
en.body:
## Customers

The **Customers** section (under **More** on a phone) needs the **Customers** permission. To pick or create a customer while selling, being able to sell is enough.

### View and search customers

The screen shows a summary: **Customers**, **Active**, **New this month** and **With orders in 30 days**.

- Search with **Search by name or phone**.
- Sort by **Name**, **Last visit** or **Top spenders**.
- If there are none yet: "There are no customers yet. Add the first one or create them while selling."

When you open a customer you see orders, total spent, average ticket, last visit, customer since and latest orders.

### Add or edit a customer

1. Tap **Add customer**, or **Edit** on an existing one.
2. Fill in **Name**. The other fields are optional: phone, email, address, reference (for example, a landmark to find the place) and note.
3. Save.

A customer is never deleted: it is deactivated by turning off **Active customer**, and it gets the **inactive** tag.

Errors:

- "The phone number is not valid. Enter 8 digits or the full number with the country code."
- "A customer with that phone already exists: (name)"
- "The email is not valid."

The **Phone country code** in Settings > **Business** is prepended to local numbers (see [Settings](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/settings/)).

### Customers while selling

On the register screen, tap **Add customer** to see **Recent customers**, search for one or create a new one with **Save and use**. A delivery order needs the customer's name, phone and address: "A delivery needs the customer's name, phone and address." (see [Selling](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/selling/)).

### Customers and the web

If the register is linked, customers sync both ways with food.yammbo.com. If the phone already exists on the web, the register's customer is merged with the web one and the app tells you: "Customer joined with the one that already existed on the web: (name)". On the web you can also import and export customers as CSV from the dashboard's **Customers** section.

## Reports

The **Reports** section needs the **Sales reports** permission.

### Choose the period

Tap one of these ranges: **Today**, **Yesterday**, **7 days** or **Other range**. With **Other range** you pick the first and last day of the range (tap **Next** and then **View report**). Both days are included and can be in any order.

### What counts as a business day

The business day is the calendar day, from 00:00 to 24:00, and each sale counts on the day it was charged. The reports' time zone is fixed to Managua's (America/Managua), regardless of the country you set; there is no setting to change it or the day cut-off time.

Only charged sales count. Voided sales and accounts merged into another one do not add up; voids are listed separately.

### What it shows

| Section | Content |
|---|---|
| **Summary** | Tickets, average ticket, gross sales, discounts, service, delivery fees charged (only if any), net sales and total collected. |
| **Payments by method** | How much was collected with each method, with "Equivalent to (name)" for other currencies and "Change given". |
| **Top products (quantity)** and **Top products (amount)** | The top 10. |
| **Sales by hour** | With the peak hour. |
| **Sales by employee** | How much each person sold. |
| **Voids** | Whole ticket, who voided it and who authorized it. |

If there are no sales in the range: "No data in this range."

If you use several tablets, reports add up the sales of all of them. The shift summary, however, covers only each tablet's own drawer (see [Shifts and cash drawer](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/shifts-and-cash-drawer/)).

### Export to CSV

1. Choose the period.
2. Tap **Export to CSV**. The **Share report** sheet opens.
3. Send the files by email, WhatsApp, Drive or whichever app you prefer.

Two files are generated: `ventas-YYYY-MM-DD.csv` (one row per sale; the file name uses the Spanish word for sales) and `lineas-YYYY-MM-DD.csv` (one row per product sold). The date in the name is the first day of the range. The files open correctly in Excel with accented characters; amounts have no currency symbol or thousands separator, and the column headers are in English.

### Sales history

On the register screen, the ⋮ menu has **Sales**: browse day by day (**Previous**, **Next**, **Today**), search by receipt, customer or phone, and open any sale with **See details** or **Reprint receipt**. The statuses are Charged, Voided, Merged into another account and Open.

## Reports on the web

If you have the online store, the food.yammbo.com dashboard has its own **Reports** with periods such as "Last 30 days" or "This month" and downloads «Ventas (CSV)», «Productos (CSV)» and «Resumen (CSV)». There, sales are the online store orders that were delivered or picked up.

## Next step

- [Shifts and cash drawer](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/shifts-and-cash-drawer/)
- [Backups](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/backups/)

en.title: Employees, roles and PIN
en.description: How staff sign in with their PIN, the 5 base roles and 14 permissions, the supervisor, kitchen entry without a PIN and where employees are managed.
en.body:
Each employee signs in to the register with a **PIN** and sees only what their **role** allows. This guide explains how that works and how to manage it.

## Sign in with the PIN

1. On the **Enter your PIN** screen, type your PIN.
2. Tap **Enter**, which becomes available from 4 digits. With a 6-digit PIN it signs in on its own.

A PIN has **4 to 6 digits** and cannot repeat across active employees.

| Message | What it means and what to do |
|---|---|
| **Wrong PIN** | Check the PIN and try again |
| **Too many attempts. Wait (number) s** | After **5 failures** the screen locks for **30 seconds**. Wait |
| "Two employees have this PIN, so nobody can sign in with it. Ask the owner to change one of them." | The owner must change one of them |
| "Your role has no access to any section. Ask the owner for help." | Your role has no permissions. The owner must review it |

## Lock the register

- Tap **Lock** in the bar to go back to the PIN screen.
- The register also locks by itself. Change the time under Settings > **This device** > **Auto-lock (minutes)**. The default is **5**. Enter **0** so it never locks. The value must be between 0 and 240; otherwise you will see "Minutes must be a number between 0 and 240."
- The session of a tablet that only shows the kitchen never locks.

## The 5 base roles and the 14 permissions

A role is a set of permissions. The permissions are:

- **Sales**: **Quick sale**, **Tables**, **Charge**, **Discounts**, **Void**, **Refunds**, **Open drawer**.
- **Operations**: **Cash shift**, **Kitchen display**, **Sales reports**.
- **Administration**: **Menu and tables**, **Customers**, **Staff and roles**, **Settings**.

The permission appears in the list, but the app currently has no returns flow. To correct a sale, void it. See [Selling](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/selling/).

The roles that come ready to use:

| Role | Permissions |
|---|---|
| Owner | All |
| Manager | All except Employees and roles, and Settings |
| Cashier | Quick sale, Tables, Charge, Open drawer and Cash shift |
| Waiter | Tables and Charge |
| Kitchen | Kitchen screen |

Permissions also control the app sections: Register, Tables, Kitchen, Shift, Reports, Menu, Customers, Employees and Settings. Depending on the tablet's role, these people can sign in:

- **Register**: all staff.
- **Kitchen or bar**: anyone with Kitchen screen or Settings.
- **Waiter**: anyone with Tables or Settings.

## Supervisor authorization

If your role cannot do an action (for example a discount or a void), **Supervisor authorization** appears: "Your role cannot do this. Ask someone with permission to enter their PIN."

1. Ask someone with that permission to enter their PIN.
2. Tap **Authorize**.
3. If the PIN does not work, you will see **Wrong PIN or no permission**.

The authorization **expires after 2 minutes** and is valid for **a single action**.

## Enter the kitchen without a PIN

On a tablet with the **Kitchen or bar** role you can turn on **Enter without a PIN**, under Settings > **Location and devices** > **What this device is for**. It works **only with a role that sees nothing but the kitchen**. The app asks you; if you do not want it, tap **No, ask for the PIN**. To use it, tap **Enter kitchen**.

If it stops being valid you will see: "Entering the kitchen without a PIN is no longer available. Log in with a PIN."

## Manage employees

The **Staff** section (needs the Employees and roles permission):

1. Tap **Add employee**, which opens **New employee**.
2. Enter the **Name**, choose the **Role** and enter the **PIN (4 to 6 digits)** and repeat it.
3. Save.

To modify one:

- **Change PIN (leave empty to keep it)** changes only the PIN.
- **Deactivate employee** removes access without deleting their history.
- **Reactivate** turns them back on and requires a **new PIN**.

### Create and edit roles

Tap **New role**, enter the **Role name** and check its permissions. A preview says **"Will see: (name)"** the sections it will have. **Delete role** removes a custom role.

### Rules to know

| Message | What it means |
|---|---|
| "Another active employee already uses that PIN. Choose a different one." | A PIN cannot repeat |
| "at least one active owner must remain." | You cannot deactivate or change the last Owner |
| "Only an owner can change an owner or give the Owner role." | That action is Owner-only |
| "You cannot give or change permissions that you do not have." | You cannot grant more than you have |
| "You cannot edit or delete your own role." | Ask someone else to edit it |
| "Some employees have this role. Change their role before deleting it." | Reassign those employees first |
| "Built-in roles cannot be deleted." | The 5 base roles stay |

## When the register is linked

With the register linked to food.yammbo.com, **employees, roles and PINs are managed in the web dashboard**: "Employees, roles and PINs are managed in the web dashboard. Employees that only exist on this register are never deleted."

- In the dashboard: **Team** («Equipo») > **POS employees** tab («Empleados del POS»). There you use Add employee, Deactivate, Reactivate and New PIN. A PIN is never shown again once saved.
- Custom roles are limited to 30 and the account allows up to **100 employees** ("The online account takes up to 100 employees.")
- On the register, **Update employees** (Settings > **Location and devices** > **Online account**) brings in the dashboard changes.
- Employees that exist **only on the register** are not deleted: they show the label **Only on this register** and are uploaded to the web once.
- There must always be at least one active employee with the Owner role. The dashboard warns: «Tiene que quedar al menos un dueño.»

## Next step

Start selling in [Selling](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/selling/).

en.title: Frequently asked questions
en.description: Short answers to the most common questions about Yammbo Food POS, the online store and the food.yammbo.com dashboard.
en.body:
## Does it work without internet?

Yes. Once linked, the register sells, charges, prints and keeps the shift without internet. You need internet in these cases:

- The first start of a new register (to link it to your account).
- Receiving orders from the online store.
- Charging with a link or QR.
- Sending the receipt by automatic email or showing the receipt QR.
- Google Drive backups.

Receipt emails that could not be sent wait in a queue for up to 24 hours.

## What do I need to get started?

An Android 7 or later tablet or phone, and a food.yammbo.com account with the business approved by Yammbo. See [What is Yammbo Food POS](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/what-is-it/) and [Create your account](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/create-your-account/).

## How many tablets can I use?

You can join several tablets to the same location over Wi-Fi (register, kitchen or bar, waiter). They are all equals and keep selling even if another one is turned off. See [Several tablets](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/several-tablets/).

## Do I need a printer?

No. The app works without a printer. If you want receipts, kitchen tickets or to open the cash drawer, see [Printers and hardware](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/printers-and-hardware/).

## Can I issue refunds?

There is currently no refund flow. If you need to undo a sale, void it: on the register screen tap the ⋮ menu > **Void sale** > **Void the sale** and type the reason (this needs the **Void** permission or a supervisor's PIN). For a single product that was already sent to the kitchen, use **Void sent item**.

## How do I update the app?

The app does not update itself. Download the latest APK, open it and install it over the existing installation:

https://github.com/yammbocom/yammbo-food-pos-releases/releases/latest/download/YammboFoodPOS.apk

There is also a «Descargar Yammbo Food POS» (Download Yammbo Food POS) button in the web dashboard, under «Dispositivos» (Devices). If you have several tablets, update **all** of them at once, or they will stop syncing with each other. See [Install and update](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/install-and-update/).

## Where do I see the app version?

In Settings, at the bottom of the category list, as "Version 0.24" (the number changes with each update).

## Do I need a food.yammbo.com account?

Yes, to use a new register. The only exceptions are a tablet that joins another register of the same location, a customer display and a backup restore.

## Why can I not link the register?

It is almost always one of these reasons: the business has not been approved by Yammbo yet, there is no employee with the Owner role and a PIN in the web dashboard, or the 6-digit code has already expired (it is valid for 5 minutes). See [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/troubleshooting/#i-cannot-link-the-register).

## Why is my online store not receiving orders?

The store only accepts orders when a linked register at that location is **on and online**. If 3 minutes pass without a connection from the register, your customers see "This location is not receiving online orders right now." Open the app on the tablet and check that it has internet. See [Online orders](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/online-orders/).

## How do I change my prices or my menu?

From the register, in the **Menu** section, or from the web dashboard. The menu is shared in both directions, so what you change in one shows up in the other. See [Register and web dashboard](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/register-and-web-dashboard/).

## What data is changed only on the web?

When the register is linked, the country, the tax percentage and the second currency with its rate are changed only on food.yammbo.com. Employees, roles and PINs are also managed in the web dashboard. See [Settings](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/settings/).

## What happens if I change the base currency?

Prices are not converted: C$120 becomes US$120. Past tickets will be shown in the new currency and the second currency is turned off. You can only switch to a currency with the same number of decimals.

## Is my data backed up?

With the daily backup to Google Drive (around 3:00, 30 days are kept) or by exporting to a file. Payment link and QR keys are not included in backups. See [Backups](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/backups/).

## Can I charge by card or with a payment link?

The register records card payments (with an optional authorization number), transfers and cash. You can also charge with a link or QR using Tilopay, Pagadito, Stripe, PayPal or Mercado Pago; there, the payment is only recorded once the provider confirms it. Pagadito is the provider we have tested. See [Charging](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/charging/) and [Payment links and QR](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/payment-links-and-qr/).

## Do reports use my country's time?

Reports count the business day from 00:00 to 24:00 in Managua's time zone (America/Managua), and it cannot be changed today, even if your business is in another country. See [Customers and reports](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/customers-and-reports/).

## I forgot my PIN, what do I do?

Ask the owner to change it (in the register's **Staff** section, or in the web dashboard if the register is linked). A PIN has 4 to 6 numbers and cannot repeat among active employees.

## Can I use a second screen for the customer?

Yes, in two ways: a second screen connected to the tablet, or a second tablet joined over Wi-Fi. See [Printers and hardware](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/printers-and-hardware/#customer-display).

## Where do I get help?

Write to support@yammbo.com telling us what you expected to happen and the exact message you saw. Before that, look the message up in [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/troubleshooting/).

## Related

- [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/troubleshooting/)
- [What is Yammbo Food POS](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/what-is-it/)

en.title: First start and linking the register
en.description: Choose what the tablet is for, sign in with your account or a dashboard code, set up the business and fix linking errors.
en.body:
The first time you open the app you choose what the tablet will do and, if it is a register, you link it to your restaurant.

## Before you start

- The tablet needs **internet** on this first start.
- Your business must be **approved**, and an **Owner** employee with a PIN must exist if you will use a dashboard code. See [Create your account](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/create-your-account/).

## "What is this tablet for?"

The first screen offers four options:

| Option | When to use it |
|---|---|
| **Register (charge and sell)** | The main tablet at the location. It links to your account |
| **Join an existing business** | Another tablet at the same location that copies the data from a register over Wi-Fi. See [Several tablets](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/several-tablets/) |
| **Customer screen for another register** | A tablet that only shows the sale to the customer |
| **Restore a backup** | Recover data from a backup |

Joining a location, using the tablet as a customer display or restoring a backup **do not ask for an account**: only a new main register links to your food.yammbo.com account.

## Link with your account (email and code)

1. Choose **Register**. The screen **Sign in with your Yammbo Food account** appears.
2. Enter your **Account e-mail** and tap **Send code**. If you do not have an account yet, tap **Create account**, which opens food.yammbo.com/dashboard/signup.
3. Check your email. The code has 6 digits and is **valid for 30 minutes**. Enter it in the **6-digit code** field and tap **Continue**.
   - **Resend code (N s)** becomes available after 30 seconds.
   - **Change e-mail** lets you correct the email.
4. **The sign-in lasts 5 minutes** from the moment you enter the code. If you take longer, you must start over.
5. Choose the restaurant under **Choose the restaurant** and the branch under **Choose the location**. If there is only one, it is already selected.
6. Under **Name of this register** keep the suggested one (for example «Caja T01») or type your own, up to 60 characters.
7. Tap **Link this register**.

Only accounts that are members with the Settings permission of an approved business can see and link a restaurant.

## Link with a dashboard code

Use this if you prefer not to sign in with your account on the tablet.

1. In the web dashboard open **Devices** («Dispositivos»). If you have several active branches, choose the **Branch** («Sucursal»).
2. Click **Link device** («Vincular dispositivo»). A 6-digit code appears with the countdown **«Vence en M:SS»** (Expires in M:SS).
3. On the tablet tap **I have a 6-digit code from the dashboard**. It is also under Settings > **Location and devices** > **Online account**.
4. Enter the restaurant address or name (**Restaurant address or name**; pasting food.yammbo.com/ plus your restaurant's short name works), the 6-digit code and the register name.
5. Tap **Link**.

Code rules:

- It is valid for **5 minutes** and can be used **only once**.
- It is shown only once on screen. If you reload the page, generate another one.
- Generating a new one cancels the previous one.
- If you see **«El código venció. Genera otro.»** (The code expired. Generate another.), click Link device again.
- Each code belongs to **one branch only**, and the tablet stays tied to that branch.
- Limits: 30 codes per hour per business and 5 wrong attempts per code.

## Set up the business on the register

What you see next depends on whether your restaurant already has employees on the web.

**If it already has employees in the web dashboard:**

1. **Your restaurant details** appears. Tap **Continue**.
2. You sign in with the **PIN the employee has in the dashboard**. Employees, roles and PINs are imported automatically.

**If the restaurant has no employees:**

1. **Set up your business** appears: "You only do this once. You will be the owner."
2. Choose the **country** and enter the business name, your name, your PIN (4 to 6 digits) and repeat the PIN.
3. Tap **Create business**. The app creates the 5 base roles, the stations **Kitchen** and **Bar**, and the category **General**. **Change this choice** takes you back to the options screen.

## Role of this device

When a tablet joins a location, the app asks "What is this device for?": **Register**, **Kitchen or bar** or **Waiter**, then **Continue**. You can change it later under Settings > **Location and devices** > **What this device is for**.

## Continue without an account for a while

A tablet that already had data and is not yet linked offers **Continue without an account for now ((number) days left)** for 14 days. It only appears on installations that already have data.

## Remove or revoke a register

- **In the dashboard**: under **Devices**, click **Remove** next to the register, then **«Sí, quitar»**. You will see «Dispositivo quitado.» The tablet loses access immediately and goes back to the linking screen.
- **On the tablet**: under Settings > **Location and devices** > **Online account** there is **Unlink**. It only forgets the link on that tablet and discards receipts that were waiting for a connection. For the server to stop accepting the register you must also remove it in the dashboard.
- If the server unlinks it, the app shows: "The server unlinked this register (revoked in the panel or invalid token). Link it again." Your sales, products and employees on the tablet are not deleted.

## Check that it worked

1. In the **Panel** section of food.yammbo.com, «Sin caja conectada: esta sucursal no recibe pedidos web.» should no longer appear.
2. Under **Devices** the register is listed in «Dispositivos vinculados» with a recent «Último contacto» (last contact).
3. Leave the app open: the register reports every minute that it is active.

## Errors in this phase

| Message | What it means and what to do |
|---|---|
| "Type a valid e-mail." | The email is misspelled |
| "The code is wrong, expired or already used. Ask for a new one." | Tap Resend code or generate another one in the dashboard |
| "The sign-in expired (it lasts 5 minutes). Start again with your e-mail." | Start over with your email |
| "Your account can no longer link registers to this restaurant." | The account no longer has the Settings permission there. Ask an Owner to restore it |
| "The web employees could not be applied because there is no active owner. Go to food.yammbo.com/dashboard/team and check that there is an owner." | Go to food.yammbo.com/dashboard/team and create or reactivate an employee with the Owner role |
| "Cannot reach food.yammbo.com. Check the internet and try again." | Check the tablet's internet |
| "The server is not answering right now. Try again in a few minutes." | Wait and retry |
| "This restaurant has register connections turned off. Turn them on in the web panel." | Contact Yammbo through Support («Soporte») |
| "Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again." | Wait a few minutes before retrying |
| "The restaurant account is not active." / suspended | The business is not yet approved or is suspended. Check its status in the dashboard |
| "The link could not be stored securely on this tablet. Revoke this register in the web panel (Devices/Registers) and generate a new code." | Revoke this register in the dashboard (Devices) and generate a new code |
| "Enter a name." | The register or business name is missing |
| "The PIN must be 4 to 6 digits." | Change the PIN |
| "The two PINs do not match." | Enter the same PIN in both fields |

In the dashboard, when generating the code you may also see: «Elige una sucursal.» (Choose a branch: pick the Branch or activate one) and «Crea primero un empleado con el rol Dueño en la sección Empleados de Equipo. Sin él no se puede vincular una tableta.»

## Next step

Set up your team and their PINs in [Employees, roles and PIN](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/employees-roles-and-pin/).

en.title: Install and update the app
en.description: Download the Yammbo Food POS APK, install it on Android 7 or later, update it by hand on every tablet and check the version.
en.body:
Yammbo Food POS is installed from an APK file. It works on tablets and phones running **Android 7 or later**.

## Download the APK

There are two ways, and both always download the **latest version**:

- **From the dashboard**: at food.yammbo.com/dashboard open **Devices** («Dispositivos») and click **Download Yammbo Food POS** («Descargar Yammbo Food POS»). The button also appears in the **Panel** section, inside the «Sin caja conectada...» (No register connected) notice of every branch that has no register on.
- **With the direct link**, opened on the tablet: https://github.com/yammbocom/yammbo-food-pos-releases/releases/latest/download/YammboFoodPOS.apk

## Install

1. Download the **YammboFoodPOS.apk** file on the tablet.
2. Open it from your downloads. If Android warns that installing apps from unknown sources is not allowed, grant the permission to the browser or file manager you opened it from.
3. Confirm the installation.
4. Open the app. Continue with [First start and linking](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/first-start-and-linking/).

If you will use several tablets in the same location, install the same version on all of them.

## Check the installed version

Open **Settings**: the version appears at the bottom of the category list, as **Version 0.24** (the number changes with each update). You need the Settings permission to get there.

## Update

The app has **no built-in updater**: it does not notify you and it does not update itself. To update:

1. Download the latest APK from the dashboard (Devices > **Download Yammbo Food POS**) or with the direct link above.
2. Open it and install it over the existing app.
3. Open Settings and check that the new version appears at the bottom.

Tablets in the same location only sync with each other if they have the **same version**. If one has a different version, it stops syncing with the rest: they reject each other. Each tablet keeps selling on its own and reconciles once they all reach the same version; their data is not lost. When joining or pairing tablets with different versions you will see: "The other register runs another version of the app. Update both to the same version."

A tablet already joined to others but on a different version does not show a clear message: in **Devices of the business** you will only see "Offline. Last seen: (name)" and it retries silently. If a tablet stays like that, first check that all of them have the same version.

## Next step

With the app installed, [link the register to your restaurant](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/first-start-and-linking/).

en.title: Kitchen and stations
en.description: How stations, the kitchen screen, order statuses, late orders, alerts and ticket printing work.
en.body:
The kitchen feature sends what you sell to where it is prepared: a kitchen screen, a ticket printer, or both. Turn it on in **Settings** > **Sales and taxes** > **Features** > **Kitchen**.

## Stations

A station is a preparation place, such as the kitchen or the bar. Two are created with your business: "Kitchen" and "Bar".

- To create another, go to **Menu** > **Stations** tab > **Add station**.
- On each product, choose its **Preparation station**. If you choose "Not prepared (does not go to the kitchen or bar)", that product isn't printed and doesn't show in the kitchen.
- On printers, tick the **Stations it prints**. See [Printers and hardware](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/printers-and-hardware/).
- On each kitchen tablet, choose the stations it handles (if you tick none, it sees all of them).

## Sending to the kitchen

On the sales screen tap **Send to kitchen**. The register shows **Sent to the kitchen**. One ticket per station goes to the printers set for that station. If there is nothing new, it says "There is nothing new to send to the kitchen." When you charge, anything not yet sent goes to the kitchen automatically.

A line that was already sent can't be changed: "That line was already sent to the kitchen and cannot be changed." To remove it, void the sent item (see [Selling](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/selling/)); the station gets a **VOIDED** notice.

## Setting up a tablet as a kitchen screen

1. Install the app on the tablet. See [First start and linking](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/first-start-and-linking/).
2. Join it to the location and, under **What this device is for**, choose **Kitchen or bar**. You can change it later in **Settings** > **Location and devices** > **What this device is for**.
3. Choose the **Stations of this device**.
4. Optional: turn on **Enter without a PIN** so the kitchen can get in without typing a PIN. It only works with a role that sees only the kitchen; if it stops being valid, the app says "Entering the kitchen without a PIN is no longer available. Log in with a PIN."

The kitchen tablet doesn't turn off or lock while it is on the kitchen screen. For devices to see each other they must be on the same Wi-Fi. See [Several tablets](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/several-tablets/).

## The kitchen screen

It has two tabs:

- **Preparing (N)**: pending orders.
- **Ready (N)**: finished orders waiting to be handed over.

At the top are filters: **All** and one chip per station. You also see figures such as **Pending**, **Late**, **Longest wait** and **Average prep time today**. An order counts as late once it has been waiting 15 minutes or more.

### How an order moves

1. When an order arrives, it appears under Preparing.
2. Tap a line to mark it done (**Done**). If you make a mistake, tap **Undo**.
3. When everything is ready, tap **All ready**: the order moves to Ready.
4. When it is handed over, tap **Delivered** on the Ready tab.

When there is no work you'll see "There are no pending orders." or "There are no ready orders waiting to be delivered."

### Sound

The **Sound** switch turns the new-order chime on or off on this kitchen screen (only on this tablet). The chime repeats every 15 seconds until you touch the board, for 3 minutes at most. It does not affect the online store order alarm. If the tablet's alarm volume is very low, you'll see **The alarm volume is very low: you will not hear the orders**.

## Alerts for the waiter and cashier

Other devices receive alerts from the kitchen flow:

- "(name) asked for the check".
- "(name): order ready" or "Order for (name) is ready".
- "(name): (name) ready" when a line is done.

## Printing tickets that arrive from other devices

A tablet with the **Kitchen or bar** role can print orders that come from other devices. Turn it on in **Settings** > **Location and devices** > **What this device is for** with **Print orders that arrive from other devices**.

- It prints orders for that device's stations from the last 10 minutes, and never prints the same one twice. It also prints voided items.
- If the register also has a printer for the same station, you'll get two copies. The app warns you.
- Kitchens print in the language of the device that prints.

When you accept an order from your online store and Kitchen is on, the ticket goes to the kitchen. See [Online orders](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/online-orders/).

## Next step

- [Menu](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/menu/)
- [Printers and hardware](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/printers-and-hardware/)

en.title: Menu, products and modifiers
en.description: Create categories, products, modifiers, combos and stations, control what is sold and how the menu is shared with your online store.
en.body:
The **Menu** section is where you build what you sell. You need the "Menu and tables" permission. It has four tabs, each with its own counter: **Products**, **Categories**, **Modifiers** and **Stations**.

## Create a category

1. Go to Menu > Categories and tap **Add category**.
2. Type the **Name**.
3. Optional: choose a **Default station**. New products in that category start with that station. Tick **Apply to the products in this category** if you also want it applied to the existing ones.
4. Leave **Active** on and save.

### Category schedule

Use it to sell something only at certain hours (for example, breakfast).

1. In the category, turn on **With schedule**.
2. Tap **Add schedule** and, for each day (Sunday to Saturday), choose the **Opens** and **Closes** time. **Remove schedule** deletes it.
3. If the closing time is earlier than the opening time, the category closes the next day (up to 06:00).

Outside its hours, the category looks gray on the register with the note **Outside hours**. If you add a product anyway, the register asks "(name) is outside its schedule. Add it anyway?" and you decide. The schedule is always evaluated in the Managua time zone (America/Managua), no matter which country you configured.

Schedule error: "The schedule is not valid. Use times like 07:00, and close before 06:00 the next day."

A category with products can't be deleted: "This category has products. Move them to another one or deactivate the category."

## Create a product

1. Go to Menu > Products and tap **Add product**.
2. Fill in the fields:

| Field | What to do |
|---|---|
| **Name** | Up to 60 characters. |
| **Price** | For example 45 or 45.50. Shows the symbol of your base currency. |
| **Description** | Up to 300 characters. |
| **Sold by** | Unit, Kilogram, Pound, Gram or Ounce (see Products sold by weight). |
| **Type** | "Item" or "Combo". It can't be changed after the product is created. |
| **Category** | Pick an existing one or "New category" (created when you save). |
| **Barcode** | Type it or tap **Scan**. Up to 64 characters and it can't repeat on another active product. |
| **Photo** | **Take photo**, **Choose from gallery** or **Remove**. |
| **Preparation station** | Which station it goes to (see [Kitchen](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/kitchen/)). |
| **Active** | If it's off, the product isn't sold. |
| **Order (optional)** | To sort the list. |
| **Product modifiers** | Link the modifier groups that apply (up to 20 per product). |

3. Save.

Form errors:

- "Enter a valid price, for example 45 or 45.50."
- "The description can have up to 300 characters."
- "Another active product already uses that barcode."
- "The barcode cannot be longer than 64 characters."
- "The product was saved, but the photo could not be saved. Try again."
- If camera permission wasn't granted you see **No camera permission**; you can type the code by hand.

### Photos

The photo is shrunk automatically (maximum 512 pixels per side) to save space. If there is no photo, you'll see "No photo".

### Finding products

In the list, use **Search by name or barcode** or the category chip (**All**). Each product shows "Sold in 7 days: (number)" and the "Combo" and "Inactive" tags where they apply.

### Deleting a product

Tap **Delete** and confirm with **Tap again to delete**.

- If the product already has sales, it isn't deleted: it is deactivated ("The product already has sales, so it was deactivated instead of deleted.").
- If it is part of a combo, remove it from the combo first: "This item is a component of a combo. Remove it from the combo before deleting it."

## Products sold by weight

Under **Sold by** choose Kilogram, Pound, Gram or Ounce. The price becomes per that unit. When selling, the register asks for the weight: **Type the weight in (name)**. Allowed decimals are 3 for kilogram and pound, 0 for gram and 2 for ounce.

Your online store doesn't show products sold by any unit other than "Unidad" (each). If you want to sell them online, create them as units.

## Sold out

The register has no "sold out" switch. What you can do is **deactivate** the product (turn off **Active**) and turn it back on when you have stock again. The "sold out" marker that exists in the web dashboard for a location is not applied on the register.

## Modifiers

A modifier is an option the customer chooses for a product (cooking point, extras, no onion).

1. Go to Menu > Modifiers and tap **Add group** ("New modifier group").
2. Type the group's **Name**.
3. Set the **Minimum** (0 means optional) and the **Maximum** number of options that can be chosen. If they don't add up you'll see **Check the minimum and maximum: the maximum must be at least 1, and the minimum cannot exceed the maximum or the number of options.**.
4. Under **Options** tap **Add option** and type the name and the price **Extra**. **Remove option** deletes it. An extra can be negative (for example, "no cheese").
5. Save. The group summary reads "Elegir de X a Y, N opciones" (choose X to Y, N options).

Limits: 1 to 40 options per group and up to 20 groups per product. If a combination makes the price negative, the register warns "That combination of options gives the item a negative price. Check the menu extras."

When selling, the register shows "Choose one option", "Choose up to (number), if you like" or "Choose (number) to (number)", depending on the group.

## Combos

A combo bundles several items with choices.

1. Create a product with **Type** = **Combo**.
2. Add **Combo groups** with **Add group** and, inside each one, **Add component**.
3. Each component can carry a price **Extra**.
4. Activate the product when you're done.

The combo price is the product's price plus the extras of what the customer picks. A new combo is created inactive: "A new combo is created inactive. Add its groups and activate it when you edit it."

Limits: 1 to 10 groups per combo and 1 to 30 components per group. A component is an item (never another combo), appears only once per group and its extra can't be negative.

If a required group has fewer active components than its minimum, the combo shows as "Unavailable" on the register: "Some components of this group are sold out. The combo cannot be sold until enough are available."

## Stations

In Menu > Stations tap **Add station**. A station is a preparation place, such as the kitchen or the bar. Two come by default: Kitchen and Bar. See [Kitchen](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/kitchen/).

## No bulk import

The register doesn't import or export the menu from a file. You create it product by product on the register or in the web dashboard, and when the register is linked the menu is shared with the web.

## Menu shared with the web

When the register is linked to food.yammbo.com, the menu is the same on the register and in your online store, and you can edit it in either place. The description (up to 300 characters) is shared too. Per-location pricing is changed only on the web: on the register it shows as "Precio en esta sucursal: X (se cambia en la web)" (price at this location, changed on the web).

### First link

The first time you link the register:

- If the web is empty, the register uploads its menu.
- If the register is empty, it adopts the web menu.
- If both have products, **There is already a menu on the web** appears and you must choose (it can't be dismissed without choosing):
  - **Use the web menu**: the register's menu is replaced. Products that were already sold stay inactive to keep the history.
  - **Upload this register's menu**: it is sent to the web once the web accepts it.

While it uploads you'll see **Uploading the menu: (number) of (number)**. To upload the menu, an employee with Menu permission must also exist on the web; otherwise: "To upload the menu, an employee with the Menu permission must also exist on the web."

## Next step

- [The register and the web dashboard](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/register-and-web-dashboard/)
- [Kitchen and stations](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/kitchen/)

en.title: Online store orders
en.description: How orders from your online store reach the register, how to accept or reject them and what the customer sees.
en.body:
Your restaurant has a public page on food.yammbo.com (the link is food.yammbo.com/ followed by your restaurant's short name). Customers order there and the order reaches your register. Old links with /r/ in the middle still work: they take you to the new address.

## Sell online or use only the register

In the web dashboard, under **"Store"** > **"Online ordering"**, there are two switches. Save with **"Save"**.

- **"Sell online"**: if you turn it off, your public page stops being shown and you get no online orders. Use it if you only use the register.
- **"Appear in the food.yammbo.com directory"**: decides whether your business shows on the food.yammbo.com home page. Your page keeps working at its link even if you are not in the directory. It can only be checked while "Sell online" is on.

New businesses start with both on.

To receive orders, the linked register must be on, online and with the app open. If 3 minutes pass without a connection, your store stops accepting orders until the register is back. The register tells the server it is still alive every 60 seconds.

## What you need

- A register linked to your account. See [First start and linking](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/first-start-and-linking/).
- The register on, online and with the app open. In **Settings** > **Location and devices** > **Online account** you can see the status: **Web orders: receiving**, **Web orders: checking the connection** or **Web orders paused: no connection**.
- Permission to sell or to charge for whoever answers the orders.

The linked register keeps a fixed notice **Receiving orders from food.yammbo.com**. It also asks you for **Allow without restrictions** (battery saver) so you don't lose orders with the screen off. If Android hides the notice (Android 13 or later), orders still arrive.

### Problem banners

Above the bar of the linked register you may see:

- **Web orders paused: no connection**: the register has no connection. It goes away on its own when it returns.
- **Link this register again**: when tapped, the owner goes to **Settings** > **Online account** to link again.

## How an order arrives

The register checks for new orders every 10 seconds (and when the network returns or the app opens). When one arrives:

1. A saved bill is created with the same number. You see it in **Open orders** with the tag **Web #12** (whatever the number is) and in **Sales**.
2. A full-screen panel appears over whatever you are doing: **Web order #(number)**, with "(number) of (number) waiting". It shows whether it is **Delivery** or **Pickup**, the customer, phone, address and reference (for delivery), the **Estimated delivery: (number) min**, the note, the products, shipping, discount or coupon, the total and how they pay.
3. A loud bell rings every 8 seconds until someone answers (after 10 minutes, once a minute). The bell can't be turned off and plays on the alarm channel. With Do Not Disturb set to "priority only" or "alarms only" it still rings; with "total silence" it doesn't.
4. On a tablet that is not the linked register, or with a role that can't sell or charge, you'll see **Hide for now**: it hides the screen, but the order stays pending. On the linked register you have to accept or reject.

To check the sound: **Settings** > **Location and devices** > **What this device is for** > **Test order sound**. If the alarm volume is very low you'll see **The alarm volume is very low: you will not hear the orders** with the **Raise volume** button.

## Accepting an order

1. On the order screen, choose the **Preparation time**: 10, 15, 20, 30 or 45 minutes (20 is selected by default).
2. Tap **Accept**. If Kitchen is on, the ticket goes to the kitchen.

## Rejecting an order

1. Tap **Reject**.
2. Choose the **Reason for rejecting (required)**: "Out of stock", "Closed", "Too far", "Other" or write your own.
3. Tap **Confirm rejection**, or **Back** to change your mind.

The order is voided on the register once the server confirms the rejection.

### Who can answer

- Permission to sell or to charge is required. Otherwise: "Your role cannot accept or reject orders. Ask someone who can sell or charge."
- Only the linked register accepts and rejects. On another tablet you see "Web order #(number) is waiting for an answer on the linked register." and, if you try: "This device is not the register linked to food.yammbo.com. Accept the order on the linked register."
- You can also accept or reject from the web dashboard, in the "Pedidos" (Orders) section. See [The register and the web dashboard](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/register-and-web-dashboard/).

## Order statuses

On the register: **Pending**, **Accepted**, **Preparing**, **Ready**, **On the way**, **Delivered**, **Picked up**, **Rejected** and **Cancelled**.

The normal path is: pending, accepted, preparing or ready; then, for delivery, "On the way" and "Delivered", and for pickup, "Picked up". Only a pending order can be rejected. The **Dispatch** button marks it "On the way". The register reports status changes to the server and retries if it fails; it never blocks a payment.

### Orders paid by transfer

If the customer pays by bank transfer, the order shows the payment status: **Bank transfer: no proof yet**, **Bank transfer: proof sent, not verified yet**, **Bank transfer verified** or **Bank transfer: proof rejected**. A new transfer order shows as "no receipt yet" until the server sends the change.

## Cancellations

- If the customer cancels, or the order is rejected from another register or from the dashboard, the bill is voided with the reason and the bell rings three times. You'll see "(name) was cancelled." or "(name) was rejected."
- If the bill already had a payment, it isn't voided automatically: "(name) ended (name) but already has a payment: settle it in Open orders."
- If you void on the register a bill that came from the web, the register tells the server (rejection if it was pending, cancellation if it was already accepted) and the web emails the customer.
- If the server doesn't accept the cancellation, you'll see "(name): the website was not told about the void (name). Let the customer know." If no register is linked, the void dialog tells you "The website will not be told about this void from this device: let the customer know."

The first time the app reads orders, it only picks up your location's orders that are still unfinished and less than 24 hours old; ones already handled don't ring.

## What the customer sees

- They pick products, modifiers and quantity, write a note and choose delivery or pickup. They can order without creating an account.
- They pay according to the payment methods you have on: cash (they say how much they'll pay with), card by terminal on delivery, or bank transfer (they upload a photo of the receipt).
- They see the order status: "Recibido" (received), "Aceptado", "En preparación", "Listo", "En camino", "Entregado" or "Retirado", and the final "Rechazado" and "Cancelado". They get emails for received, accepted, rejected and canceled.
- They can cancel while the restaurant hasn't accepted it: «Puedes cancelarlo mientras el restaurante no lo haya aceptado.» After that they see «El restaurante ya respondió tu pedido: ya no se puede cancelar desde aquí.»
- If your register isn't connected, they see «Este local no está recibiendo pedidos en línea en este momento. Vuelve a intentar más tarde.» and can't place the order.

## If no orders arrive

1. Check that the linked register is on, with the app open and online.
2. Look at the status in **Settings** > **Location and devices** > **Online account**.
3. In the web dashboard's home page, if you see «Sin caja conectada: esta sucursal no recibe pedidos web. Abre Yammbo Food POS en la tablet.» (no register connected), open the app on the tablet.
4. More steps in [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/troubleshooting/).

## Next step

- [The register and the web dashboard](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/register-and-web-dashboard/)
- [Kitchen and stations](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/kitchen/)

en.title: Payment links and QR
en.description: Set up a payment provider and charge with a link or QR code that the customer pays from their phone.
en.body:
With **Charge by link or QR** the register generates a link and a QR code. The customer opens it on their phone and pays there. The register waits for the provider's confirmation and only then records the payment.

The app includes five providers: Tilopay, Pagadito, Stripe, PayPal and Mercado Pago. The one tested end to end is Pagadito (in test mode). We don't promise that the others work in a specific country: confirm with your provider that it can charge in your country and currency, and run a test payment before using it with customers.

## What you need

- An account with the provider you choose, and its keys.
- Internet on the tablet (this kind of payment doesn't work offline).
- An open shift on that tablet and permission to charge.

## Set up a provider

1. Go to **Settings** > **Payment methods** and find **Link or QR payment**.
2. Choose the provider and type its keys:

| Provider | What it asks for |
|---|---|
| Tilopay | API user, API password, integration key |
| Pagadito | UID, WSK and the **Test mode (sandbox)** option |
| Stripe | Stripe key (starts with rk_ or sk_) |
| PayPal | Client ID, Client secret and test mode (sandbox) |
| Mercado Pago | Access token |

3. Tap **Save**.
4. Tap **Test connection** to check that the keys work.
5. Turn on **Offer at checkout** so the provider shows up on the payment screen.
6. If the provider allows it, choose the **Charge currency**.

Other buttons: **Remove** (deletes the provider) and **View diagnostics** (copies the latest calls to the provider, without the keys, in case you need to show them to support).

You can have several providers active at once; the cashier picks one when charging.

Keys are stored encrypted only on the device where you type them. They are not shared with other tablets and are not included in backups. If you have several registers that charge by link, type the keys on each one. If you reinstall the app or restore a backup, the provider shows as "not configured" and you must type the keys again.

Some test-mode details: a Stripe key containing `_test_` charges in test mode, and a Mercado Pago token starting with `TEST-` is a test token (one starting with `APP_USR-` charges for real).

## Charging with a link or QR

1. Build the order and tap **Charge**.
2. Choose the provider: **Charge (amount) with (provider)**.
3. The screen **Charge with (provider)** opens with the QR code and the link. Show the QR to the customer or send them the link.
4. The screen says **Waiting for payment (provider)**. The register asks the provider every few seconds; you can also tap **Check now**.
5. When the provider confirms the payment, the sale is recorded and you reach the receipt screen. See [Charging](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/charging/).

To back out before the customer pays, tap **Cancel charge**.

## If the customer takes a while: close and resume

You can tap **Close** and keep serving other sales. The link stays alive.

- The register shows **A payment link charge is pending**.
- Tap **Resume and check** to go back and see whether they have paid.
