- The link expires after about 15 minutes. If nobody paid, the register says "The link expired without a payment." and you can generate another one.

## Watch list

The register keeps checking unresolved payments every 30 seconds. You will see these notices:

- **Payment link pending**: the customer hasn't paid yet.
- **Being watched: not yet known whether the customer paid**: the register couldn't confirm yet and keeps trying.
- **Payment received but not recorded**: the provider received the money but the register couldn't record the sale (for example, the link had already expired). The register never records a payment without the provider's confirmation. What to do: refund the money from the provider's dashboard, then tap **Mark as resolved**.

While there are unresolved payments, you can't change the credentials or remove the provider.

## Errors and what to do

| Message | What to do |
|---|---|
| "Open this device's shift before charging by link." | Open the shift on this tablet. See [Shifts and cash drawer](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/shifts-and-cash-drawer/). |
| "The provider did not accept the credentials. Check them in Settings, Payments." | Check and retype the keys; use Test connection. |
| "No connection to the provider. It retries on its own." | Check the tablet's internet; the register retries on its own. |
| "The provider does not accept this currency for your business." | Change the payment currency or check with the provider. |
| "The amount is outside what the provider allows." | The amount is too low or too high for that provider. Charge with another method. |
| "The provider reports a payment that does not match the link amount. It was not recorded. See the diagnostics." | No sale was recorded. Check the payment in the provider's dashboard. |
| "No payment methods are active. Turn them on in Settings, Payments." | Turn on at least one way of charging. |

## Related

- [Charging a sale](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/charging/)
- [Shifts and cash drawer](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/shifts-and-cash-drawer/)
- [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/troubleshooting/)

en.title: Printers and hardware
en.description: Connect receipt and kitchen-ticket printers, the cash drawer, a barcode scanner and a customer-facing display.
en.body:
Yammbo Food POS works without a printer, but you can connect printers for receipts and kitchen tickets, a cash drawer, a barcode scanner and a customer-facing display.

## Printers

The printer list is **per tablet**: it is not shared with the others. If you use two tablets, set up the printers on each one.

### Add a printer

1. Go to Settings > **Printers and hardware** > **Printers**.
2. Tap **Add printer**.
3. Type a **Name**, for example Kitchen.
4. Under **Connection** choose how it connects (see below).
5. Under **Paper width** choose 58 mm or 80 mm, depending on your printer.
6. Mark what you want it for:
   - **Prints receipts**: sales receipts, bills and shift closings.
   - **Stations it prints**: the stations whose tickets will come out of this printer (for example Kitchen or Bar).
   - **Has a cash drawer**: if the drawer is connected to this printer.
7. Tap **Test** to print a test page.

### Connection types

| Connection | What to do |
|---|---|
| Bluetooth | Pair the printer first in Android's Bluetooth settings. Then pick it from the list. If none shows up, the app says "There are no paired devices." If a permission is missing it says "Without the Bluetooth permission the list of paired printers cannot be shown.": grant it. |
| Network (IP) | Type the printer's IP address and the port (**Port**; the usual one is 9100). The printer and the tablet must be on the same network. |
| USB | Plug in the printer and tap **Ask for permission**. "USB printer detected: (name)" may also appear with an **Add** button. |
| Built-in printer | For devices with a built-in printer (Sunmi). It works on a best-effort basis and has not been verified on real devices, so always run a test with **Test**. |

The port must be between 1 and 65535.

### What prints and where

- **Receipts:** after charging, with the **Print** button. You can also reprint from the **Sales** history with **Reprint receipt**. With no receipt printer you will see "No receipt printer is set up on this device."
- **Kitchen tickets:** when you tap **Send to kitchen**, one ticket comes out per station, on the printers that have that station checked. A product with no station does not print in the kitchen.
- **Table bill:** **Print check** prints a bill marked "NOT AN INVOICE"; see [Tables](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/tables/).
- **Shift closing:** prints by itself when you close, with **Print close report again** if you need it.
- **Voids:** when you void a product that was already sent, a VOIDED notice prints on its station's printer.
- **Tickets coming from other devices:** a tablet with the **Kitchen or bar** role can print orders from other devices (see [Several tablets](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/several-tablets/)).

The logo you upload in Settings > **Business** shows on the top bar and the PIN screen. It is not printed on the receipt yet.

### Cash drawer

The drawer opens through the printer that has **Has a cash drawer** checked. The printer setup also has a **Drawer pin** field. To open it by hand use **Open drawer**, found in the ⋮ menu of the register screen or in the Shift section; the app asks for a reason. If no receipt printer has a drawer, the reason is logged but the app warns you: "It was recorded, but no receipt printer has a drawer."

### If it does not print

The warning looks like "Could not print on (name): (reason)". The most common reasons:

| Reason | What to do |
|---|---|
| "Bluetooth is turned off" | Turn on the tablet's Bluetooth. |
| "No Bluetooth printer was chosen" | Edit the printer and pick one from the list. |
| "The printer's IP address is missing" | Type the IP in the setup. |
| "Permission to use the USB printer is missing" | Tap **Ask for permission** and accept. |
| "The USB printer is busy with another app" | Close the other app that uses the printer. |
| "The built-in printer did not answer" | Try again with **Test**. |

More cases in [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/troubleshooting/).

## Barcode scanner

- **With the camera:** on the register screen tap **Scan barcode** and point the camera at the code. If the permission is missing you will see "No camera permission"; grant it in Android.
- **USB or Bluetooth keyboard-type scanner:** connect it to the tablet and scan with the sales screen open; the product is added by itself.
- If the code does not exist: "No product with code (name)".
- The same code cannot be on two active products: "Another active product already uses that barcode."

Barcodes are assigned when you create the product (see [Menu](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/menu/)).

## Customer display

It shows the customer their order while you build it. There are two ways to do it.

### Option 1: a second screen connected to the tablet

1. Go to Settings > **Printers and hardware** > **Customer screen**.
2. Turn on **Show the sale on the customer screen**.
3. If Android detects the screen you will see "Second screen detected: (name)". Otherwise, "No second screen connected".

Options for that screen:

- **Offer the receipt on the customer screen**.
- **The customer screen is a touch screen**.
- **Welcome message (optional)** (up to 120 characters).
- **Show preview**.

### Option 2: another tablet over Wi-Fi

1. On the register, first turn on **Show the sale on the customer screen**. If not, you will see: "Turn on 'Show the sale on the customer screen' to pair tablets."
2. On the register, go to Settings > **Location and devices** > **Tablets connected over Wi-Fi** and tap **Pair a tablet**. A 6-digit code and the register's address appear.
3. On the other tablet choose **Use this tablet as the customer screen**; on a fresh install it is **Customer screen for another register**.
4. Pick the register from the list or type its IP and port, enter the **6-digit code** and tap **Link**.

Both tablets must be on the same Wi-Fi and run the same app version. This display does not ask for a food.yammbo.com account.

To leave customer display mode, press and hold the top-left corner for 3 seconds.

If the display loses its connection it shows "Reconnecting to the register". If the register removed it, you will see "This tablet is no longer paired" and a **Link again** button.

| Message | What to do |
|---|---|
| "This tablet is not connected to a Wi-Fi network." | Connect it to the location's Wi-Fi. |
| "The code is not correct." | Check the code on the register. |
| "The code expired…" | Link again to get a new one. |
| "Too many attempts. Ask for a new code on the register." | Generate another code. |
| "Could not reach the register. Make sure both tablets are on the same Wi-Fi network." | Check the network of both tablets. |

## Next step

- [Settings](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/settings/)
- [Shifts and cash drawer](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/shifts-and-cash-drawer/)

en.title: The register and the web dashboard
en.description: What data is shared between the register and food.yammbo.com, in which direction, what can only be edited on the web and what happens offline.
en.body:
When you link a register to your food.yammbo.com account, the register and the web dashboard share part of their information. That way you edit the menu, employees or business details in either place and it looks the same in both. To link, see [First start and linking](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/first-start-and-linking/).

Only the linked register talks to the web. The other tablets at the location receive everything over Wi-Fi from it (see [Several tablets](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/several-tablets/)). The register checks for changes and orders with the web every 10 seconds.

## What is shared and in which direction

| Data | Direction | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Employees, roles and PINs | Web to register, and register to web | Employees marked "Only on this register" are uploaded once. Maximum 100 employees. |
| Business details (name, tax ID, address, phone, receipt footer, customer language) | Both directions | The last change wins. |
| Country, tax and second currency | Web to register only | Read-only on the register. |
| Base currency | Both directions | Only currencies with the same decimals; prices are not converted. |
| Logo and cover photo | Both directions | The cover photo only appears with the register linked. |
| Menu and product descriptions | Both directions | The description allows up to 300 characters. See [Menu](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/menu/). |
| Customers | Both directions | Matched by phone. |
| Payment methods | Both directions | A single list; the last change wins. |
| Online store orders | Web to register | The register answers the web (accept, reject, statuses). See [Online orders](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/online-orders/). |

## What is changed only on the web

With the register linked, these fields show on the register with the text **Change it at food.yammbo.com** and can't be edited there:

- **Country.**
- **Tax percentage and whether it is included in the price or added on top.** (The tax name can still be edited on the register.)
- **Second currency and its exchange rate.** The register reads **The base currency is changed here. The second currency and its rate are set at food.yammbo.com**.
- **Per-location price** of products: on the register it reads "Precio en esta sucursal: X (se cambia en la web)".

Employees, roles and PINs are managed in the web dashboard (the "Equipo" (Team) section, "Empleados del POS" tab). On the register you'll see "Employees, roles and PINs are managed in the web dashboard. Employees that only exist on this register are never deleted." and the **Update employees** button.

These dashboard features exist only on the web: promotions and coupons, reviews, delivery zones, location opening hours, team and billing. See [Create your account](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/create-your-account/).

Still editable on the register: business name, tax name, tax ID, address, phone, receipt footer, customer language, base currency, payment methods, logo and cover photo.

## Conflicts: the last change wins

If the same piece of data (for example, the address or the payment methods list) is changed on the register and on the web, **the last saved change wins**. If two people edit at the same time on the web, the dashboard warns «Alguien más cambió esto mientras lo editabas. Recarga la página y vuelve a intentar.» (someone else changed this while you were editing; reload and try again).

Customers are matched by phone: if the phone already exists on the web, the register's customer merges with the web one and the register notes **Customer joined with the one that already existed on the web: (name)**.

## Without internet

The register works without internet to sell, take cash, card and transfer payments, use the kitchen and print. What you can't do without a connection:

- Receive online store orders. After 3 minutes without a connection, your store stops accepting them until the register is back.
- Charge by link or QR.
- Receipts by QR and by email (email waits in a queue and is discarded after 24 hours).
- Get menu, employee or business-detail changes to the web (they are sent when the connection returns).

On the **Online account** card (in **Settings** > **Location and devices**) you see the link status: "food.yammbo.com/…", "Linked on (name)", "Last connection with food.yammbo.com: (number) minutes ago" and "Web orders: receiving", "Web orders: checking the connection" or "Web orders paused: no connection".

## Unlinking and revoking a register

- **Unlink** (on the Online account card) only forgets the link on that tablet. Receipts that were waiting for a connection are discarded.
- For the server to stop accepting the register, revoke it on the web dashboard too: "Dispositivos" (Devices) > **Remove** > **Yes, remove** («Sí, quitar»). The tablet loses access immediately.
- If the server unlinks the register, you'll see "The server unlinked this register (revoked in the panel or invalid token). Link it again."
- **Link again**: the tablet's sales, products and employees are not deleted; only receipts waiting for a connection are discarded.

## Suspended account

If Yammbo suspends your restaurant, the dashboard shows «Tu restaurante está suspendido.» (your restaurant is suspended), your page and new orders are turned off and the dashboard becomes read-only. Write to support@yammbo.com or use the "Hablar con Yammbo" (talk to Yammbo) button in the dashboard.

## Related

- [First start and linking](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/first-start-and-linking/)
- [Menu](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/menu/)
- [Online store orders](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/online-orders/)

en.title: Selling from the Register screen
en.description: Search products, use modifiers and combos, choose Dine in, To go or Delivery, apply discounts, send to the kitchen, save orders and void sales.
en.body:
The **Register** screen is where you build the order. To charge you need an **open shift**. See [Shifts and cash drawer](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/shifts-and-cash-drawer/).

## Add products

- Type in **Search product** or tap a category chip (**All**, shows everything).
- Tap a product to add it to the order.
- Deactivated products show "This product is deactivated."
- If the menu is empty: "The menu is empty. Add products in the Menu section."
- With a barcode scanner, scan the product code. If it does not exist: "No product with code (name)".

### Modifiers

When a product has options, a sheet opens that says **Choose one option**, **Choose up to (number), if you like** or **Choose (number) to (number)**. Check what the customer wants and tap **Add**.

- If you do not meet the minimum or maximum: "The chosen options do not meet the minimum or maximum of the group."
- If the combination leaves the item with a negative price: "That combination of options gives the item a negative price. Check the menu extras."

### Combos

A combo is built by choosing one component from each group, with their extras. If components are missing or inactive, the combo shows **Unavailable**.

### Products sold by weight

If the product is sold by weight, the app asks for **Weight of (product)** with **Type the weight in (name)**. The units are Unit, Kilogram, Pound, Gram and Ounce.

### Categories with hours

If a category is outside its hours, its products appear grayed out with the note **Outside hours**. Tapping them asks "(name) is outside its schedule. Add it anyway?"

## Edit the lines

- **−** and **+** change the quantity (maximum **99** per line).
- Tap the line to write a note: **Line note** or **Note for the kitchen**.
- To remove a line, press and hold it or swipe it and confirm **Remove from the sale**.
- A line already sent to the kitchen cannot be changed: "That line was already sent to the kitchen and cannot be changed."

## Dine in, To go or Delivery

Choose the order type with three buttons: **Dine in**, **Takeaway** and **Delivery**.

- **Tables** are handled separately. See [Tables](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/tables/).
- The **Table: No table** button only appears under Dine in, when tables are on and you have the Quick sale and Tables permissions.

## Customer

Tap **Add customer** to open the **Customer** dialog: you will see recent customers, search results and **New customer**. For a new one, fill in the details and tap **Save and use**. **Remove customer** takes them off the order.

## Delivery and delivery fee

Choosing **Delivery** opens **Delivery details**:

1. Enter the **name**, **phone** and **address** (required). The **reference** is optional.
2. Check the **Delivery fee (currency)**.
3. Turn on **Save to the customer** if you want to keep the details.
4. Tap **Continue**.

If something is missing: "A delivery needs the customer's name, phone and address."

The default fee is set under Settings > **Sales and taxes** > **Home delivery** > **Default delivery fee**. You can change it on each order, but **lowering** it requires the Discounts permission or a supervisor PIN. If the value is not valid: "Enter a valid delivery fee, for example 0 or 30."

## Discount

Tap **Discount**. The discount is **a fixed amount only**, not a percentage.

1. Enter the **Discount amount (currency)**; the screen shows "Maximum".
2. Confirm. **Remove discount** takes it off.

You need the Discounts permission or a supervisor PIN. If the amount is higher than the products: "The discount cannot be greater than the total of the items." On a table order you want to split, remove the discount first.

## Totals

The order shows Subtotal, Discount, Service, tax, Delivery and Total. The bottom buttons are **Discount**, **Send to kitchen** (if Kitchen is on), **Request check** or **Print check** on tables, **Save order** (not on tables) and **Charge (amount)**.

## Send to the kitchen

Tap **Send to kitchen**: you will see **Sent to the kitchen**. One ticket is printed per station on the printers that have that station. A product without a station is not printed in the kitchen. If there is nothing new: "There is nothing new to send to the kitchen." When you **charge**, anything new is sent to the kitchen automatically.

## Save the order and open orders

For an order that will be paid or delivered later, tap **Save order**:

1. Enter **Name or reference (optional)**.
2. Choose the **Pickup time**: **As soon as possible**, **+(number) min** or **Other time**.
3. For deliveries, choose "How do they pay?": **Cash on delivery** or **Card on delivery**. For cash, enter **Pays with**.
4. Tap **Save** or **Charge now**.

Saved orders appear under **Open orders (N)**, with filters **All**, **Takeaway**, **Delivery** and **Counter**. On deliveries, **Dispatch** opens the delivery driver's sheet.

Common errors:

| Message | What to do |
|---|---|
| "Enter the customer's name or phone." | Fill in the detail |
| "The pickup time has already passed or is more than a day away." | Choose another time |
| "Choose how the delivery is paid." | Pick cash or card |
| "The amount they pay with does not cover the total." | Correct **Pays with** |
| "Finish or save the order on screen before opening another one." | Save or charge the current order |

## No open shift

If you try to charge without a shift you will see: "This device has no open shift. Each register keeps its own shift." Choose **Open a shift to charge** or **Send to the register to charge**.

## Void

If a product was already sent to the kitchen:

1. Tap the line and choose **Void sent item**.
2. Enter the reason (required). A **VOIDED** notice is printed at its station.

You need the Void permission or a supervisor PIN. If the product was not sent yet: "That item has not been sent to the kitchen yet. Just remove it from the sale."

To void a whole sale: **⋮** menu (**More options**) > **Void sale** > **Void the sale**, with a reason. You will see **Sale voided**.

The app has no returns flow. If a sale was a mistake, void it.

## Sales history

In the **⋮** menu tap **Sales**:

- Browse by day and use **Search by receipt, customer or phone**.
- Each sale shows its status: **Paid**, **Voided**, **Refunded**, **Merged into another check** or **Open**.
- **See details** opens the sale and **Reprint receipt** prints it again. Without a printer: "No receipt printer is set up on this device."
- If another tablet already charged or voided that order: "This tab was paid (or voided) on another device."

## The ⋮ **More options** menu

It gathers **Sales**, **Open drawer** and **Void sale**.

## Next step

If you work with tables, continue with [Tables](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/tables/). To take the payment, [Charging](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/charging/).

en.title: Settings
en.description: A tour of every Settings screen in Yammbo Food POS and what each option does, including what is managed from the web.
en.body:
Settings groups the business data, taxes, currency, payment methods and each tablet's configuration. Only employees whose role has the **Settings** permission can enter (by default, the Owner). On a phone the bottom bar shows 4 sections and the rest is under **More**.

## How changes are saved

- Form fields are saved together: when you change something the bar **You have unsaved changes** appears with **Discard** and **Save**. After saving you will see "Changes saved".
- Some options apply instantly, without **Save**: theme, app language, the Tables, Kitchen and customer display switches, the device role, the logo and cover, and printers.
- At the bottom of the category list is the app version, for example "Version 0.24".

The seven categories are: **Business**, **Sales and taxes**, **Payment methods**, **Printers and hardware**, **Location and devices**, **Backups** and **This device**.

## Business

Name, tax data, contact and logo.

**Business details**

- **Business name**, up to 80 characters, required.
- **Country**: choosing it fills in the currency, the phone code, the tax names and the customer language. You can change them below.
- **Customer language**: **Español** or **English**. It is the language of printed or sent receipts and of the customer display.

**Tax ID**

- The name of the tax ID (RUC, NIT, RFC…), up to 30 characters.
- The number, up to 40 characters.

**Contact and receipt**

- **Address** (up to 200) and **Phone** (up to 40).
- **Phone country code**: 1 to 4 digits, not starting with 0. It is prepended to customers' local numbers.
- **Receipt footer message** (up to 300).

**Logo**

- **Change**, **Take photo**, **Remove**. It shows on the top bar and the PIN screen. It is not printed on the receipt yet.

**Cover** (only if the register is linked)

- It is the large photo on your restaurant's page at food.yammbo.com.

## Sales and taxes

- **Taxes:** the tax name (VAT, IGV, Tax…, up to 20 characters) and its percentage, between 0 and 100. Choose whether it is "(name) is already included in prices" or "(name) is added to the price".
- **Service:** **Service (%)** between 0 and 100. With Tables on there are two switches: **Charge service on tables** and **Servers can request the check**; someone who cannot charge prints the bill for the customer and the cashier sees it flagged on the table map.
- **Features:** the **Tables** and **Kitchen** switches. Tables cannot be turned off while table accounts are open: "There are open table checks: charge or close them before turning Tables off."
- **Delivery:** **Default delivery fee**. It is filled in automatically when you mark an order as delivery and can be changed per order.
- **Currency:**
  - **Base currency**.
  - **Other currencies you accept**: up to 3, with "Value of 1 USD in C$" (up to 6 decimals). Buttons **Add currency** and **Remove**.
  - **Cash rounding**: **No rounding** or steps of 0.50, 1 or 5 units.

Prices are not converted: C$120 becomes US$120. Past tickets will be shown in the new currency and the second currency is turned off. If there are already sales or shifts, or the register is linked, only currencies with the same number of decimals are offered. The app asks you to confirm in "Change the currency?" with the **Change currency** button.

Common errors: "The tax must be a percentage between 0 and 100."; "Enter a valid delivery fee, for example 0 or 30."; "Enter an exchange rate above zero for each currency, with no repeats, up to 6 decimals."

## Payment methods

- **Accept cash**: you can turn it off. At least one way of charging must stay active or it will not save: "Leave at least one way of charging active".
- **Add method**: **Card or electronic payment** or **Transfer or deposit**. The type cannot change once saved. The app offers **Suggestions**, such as Tarjeta BAC, Link de pago, PayPal, Transferencia Banpro, Transferencia LAFISE, Billetera móvil.
- For each method: **Name**, **Ask for a reference**, **active**, **Move up**, **Move down** and **Remove**.
- Transfers ask for **Bank** (up to 40), **Account holder** (up to 80), **Account number** (4 to 34 digits), **Account currency** and **Instructions for the customer (optional)** (up to 200). If one is missing: "Fill in bank, holder and number to show it on the web".
- Limit: up to 10 cards and 10 bank accounts.
- Errors: "Every payment method you add needs a name." and "Two payment methods have the same name."

**Charge by link or QR:** this is where you set up the providers (Tilopay, Pagadito, Stripe, PayPal, Mercado Pago). The keys are stored encrypted on that tablet only: you must type them in every register that charges this way, and they are not included in backups. Full details in [Payment links and QR](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/payment-links-and-qr/).

## Printers and hardware

The tablet's printers and the customer display. Everything is in [Printers and hardware](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/printers-and-hardware/). The **Use this device as a customer screen** button is also there (with confirmation).

## Location and devices

Cards: **Tablets connected over Wi-Fi** (customer displays), **Devices of the business** (several registers), **Online account** and **What this device is for**.

- **Online account:** shows your food.yammbo.com address, the link date, the last connection and the web order status ("Web orders: receiving", "Web orders: checking the connection" or "Web orders paused: no connection"). It has **Update employees** and **Unlink**. **Unlink** only forgets the link on that tablet; for the server to stop accepting it, also remove it in the web dashboard, under «Dispositivos» (Devices).
- **Devices of the business** and **What this device is for:** see [Several tablets](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/several-tablets/).

## Backups

Google Drive, daily backup, export to file and restore. See [Backups](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/backups/).

## This device

Options that only affect this tablet.

- **Appearance:** "Automatic (like the phone)", **Light** or **Dark**.
- **App language:** **System**, **Español** or **English**. Kitchens print in the language of the tablet that prints.
- **Device prefix** (1 to 4 letters or numbers, for example T01): the prefix of this tablet's receipt numbers. Error: "The prefix must be 1 to 4 letters or digits."
- **Auto-lock (minutes):** 0 to 240. With 0 it never locks. The default is 5. Error: "Minutes must be a number between 0 and 240."

## What is changed on the web when the register is linked

When the register is linked to food.yammbo.com (or a tablet receives that information from another one), some fields appear read-only with the text **Change it at food.yammbo.com**:

- The country.
- The tax percentage and whether it is included or added.
- The second currency and its rate: "The base currency is changed here. The second currency and its rate are set at food.yammbo.com".

Still editable on the register: business name, tax name, tax ID, address, phone, receipt footer, customer language, base currency, payment methods, logo and cover.

Employees, roles and PINs are managed in the web dashboard. Employees that only exist on the register are tagged **Only on this register** and are not deleted. The per-location price is also changed on the web ("Price at this location: (amount) (change it on the web)").

To see which data travels in each direction, see [Register and web dashboard](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/register-and-web-dashboard/).

## Related

- [Register and web dashboard](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/register-and-web-dashboard/)
- [Employees, roles and PIN](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/employees-roles-and-pin/)
- [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/troubleshooting/)

en.title: Several tablets in the same location
en.description: Join another tablet to your location over Wi-Fi, choose its role (register, kitchen or bar, waiter) and learn what is shared between them.
en.body:
You can use several tablets in the same location: a register at the counter, a kitchen screen, a waiter with their own tablet. They all connect to each other over the location's Wi-Fi and **do not need internet** to sync.

## How they work

- All tablets are equals: there is no "main" one. Each one keeps all the data of the location.
- If one is turned off, the others keep selling.
- Each tablet has its own shift and its own cash drawer. Reports do add up the sales of all of them.

The tablets must be on the same Wi-Fi and run the same app version. If you need to update, do it on all of them at once (see [Install and update](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/install-and-update/)).

## Join another tablet to the location

You need an employee with the **Settings** permission on the register that already has the business.

**On the register that already has the business:**

1. Go to Settings > **Location and devices** > **Devices of the business**.
2. Tap **Add device**. A 6-digit code appears, along with this register's address (IP and port).
3. Leave that screen open. The code is valid for 5 minutes and can be used once.

**On the new tablet (freshly installed):**

1. On "What is this tablet for?" choose **Join an existing business**.
2. Pick the register under **Business registers found**. If it does not appear, type the IP and port by hand.
3. Type the code and tap **Join**.
4. Wait for **Copying the business data** to finish; you will see "N of M records". Until it finishes, the tablet cannot be used. If the connection drops, the copy resumes where it stopped.
5. Choose the device's role (see below).

The tablet that joins does not ask for a food.yammbo.com account: it uses the link of the register it joined.

If the tablet is not connected to any Wi-Fi you will see: "This register is not connected to Wi-Fi. Connect both tablets to the same Wi-Fi network of the shop." (the app shows it in Spanish or English depending on its language setting).

### If the new tablet already has data

A tablet that already has employees, sales or events of its own **is not merged** with another location. The app offers **Erase this device and join**, which asks for the **PIN of this register's owner** and typing **BORRAR**. It cannot be undone: the data of two registers is never mixed.

If you tap **Cancel and erase** halfway through the copy, what was already copied is erased and the tablet is left like new.

## Role of each device

When you join you are asked "What is this device for?". You can change it later in Settings > **Location and devices** > **What this device is for**.

| Role | What it is for |
|---|---|
| **Register** | All staff. Sells and charges. |
| **Kitchen or bar** | Kitchen screen. You choose the **Stations of this device**. It can enable **Enter without a PIN** (only for a role that sees nothing but the kitchen) and **Print orders that arrive from other devices**. |
| **Waiter** | Opens the table map with the **Mine** filter. |

The same screen has **Test order sound** and **Allow order alerts** (the Android 13+ notification permission).

More about the kitchen in [Kitchen](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/kitchen/).

## What is shared and what is not

**Shared across all tablets:**

- Menu (categories, products, modifiers, stations and combos).
- Tables, roles, employees and customers.
- Sales, lines, payments, cash movements and shifts.
- Most settings: taxes, currency, service charge, payment methods, customer display message and auto-lock.
- Product photos and logo (they arrive after the data).

**Stays on each tablet only:**

- The device prefix and the next receipt number.
- Printers.
- The device role, its stations, "Enter without a PIN" and printing of tickets from other devices.
- The theme, the kitchen sound and the keypad lock.
- Paired customer displays.
- The keys of the link/QR payment providers (you must type them in every register that charges this way).

## Check the status of each tablet

In Settings > **Location and devices** > **Devices of the business**, each tablet shows:

- "Connected now", or "Offline. Last seen: (name)" / "Offline. Has not connected yet".
- Its receipt prefix ("Receipts: T02").
- "Pending to copy: N records".
- Its role: Register, Waiter or Kitchen or bar.
- **This register** marks the tablet you are on.

## Keeping the tablets connected

While other registers or a customer display are connected, the app shows a permanent notification ("Syncing with N devices…") and keeps Wi-Fi on. Some brands close apps when the screen is off:

- On Samsung: Settings, Battery, Background usage limits, and leave the app unrestricted.
- On Xiaomi: Battery saver, "No restrictions", and turn on autostart.

The card offers the buttons **Allow the notice**, **Open notification settings** and **Open battery settings**.

Data travels over the location's Wi-Fi unencrypted (each tablet identifies itself with its own keys). It is a good idea to use a staff network separate from the guest one.

## Conflicts between registers

If two tablets change the same thing while they are not connected, the app does not fix it by itself. You will see "There is 1 conflict between registers to review." (or "There are N conflicts…"). People with the **Settings** or **Reports** permission can see it.

1. Go to **Devices of the business** and tap **Conflicts between registers**, or **Check now**.
2. Read each case, fix what is needed and tap **Mark as reviewed**.

| Case | What the app says and what to do |
|---|---|
| Double charge | "Account X was charged Y. Check and refund one of the charges." |
| Charge versus void | One register charged and another voided. Decide which one stands and fix the other register. |
| Change after payment | The account was already paid, but its products changed afterwards. Check that what was charged matches what was served. |
| Table with two accounts | "Merge the accounts or move one to another table." Use **Merge tabs** or **Move**. |
| Duplicate phone | Several active customers share a phone number. Keep only one or fix the number. |
| Duplicate barcode | Each product needs a different barcode. |
| Duplicate PIN | Two employees have the same PIN and nobody can sign in with it. Change one of them. |
| No owner | No active employee can open Settings. Give someone the Owner role. |
| Repeated prefix | Two registers use the same receipt prefix. One changes it by itself within seconds; if it stays the same, check **Devices of the business**. |

**Merge tabs** moves the products of the newer accounts into the oldest one and cannot be undone. If the accounts have discounts, the app warns that they will be lost when merging.

If you open an account that another tablet already charged or voided, the register drops it and says "This tab was paid (or voided) on another device."

### Clock out of sync

If another tablet's time differs by more than 120 seconds, the owner sees "The time on T02 differs by N min…". Fix it in that tablet's Android settings; it affects, for example, ticket printing.

## Remove a device

1. In **Devices of the business** tap **Remove** next to the tablet.
2. Confirm in **Remove device**. That tablet will stop receiving and sending location data and will not be able to reconnect. A tablet cannot remove itself.

The removed tablet shows "This device was removed from the business". From there you can:

- **Export unsynced sales**: creates two CSV files (tickets and payments) and asks for the owner PIN. Use it before erasing if there are sales that no other register has copied.
- **Erase data**: asks for the owner PIN and typing **BORRAR**; leaves the tablet like a fresh install.

## Same version on all of them

With different versions, tablets reject each other. Their data is not touched and each one can keep selling on its own; once all are updated, they reconcile.

- When joining a tablet you will see: "The other register runs another version of the app. Update both to the same version."
- A tablet that is already joined but runs another version only shows "Offline…" in **Devices of the business**, without mentioning the version. If a tablet shows offline for no apparent reason, compare the versions in Settings (at the bottom of the list).
- If a tablet is on a very old version you will see: "This tablet runs an older version and cannot sync: remove it from the business and join it again (Join an existing business)."

## Related

- [Printers and hardware](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/printers-and-hardware/)
- [Backups](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/backups/)
- [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/troubleshooting/)

en.title: Shifts and cash drawer
en.description: How to open and close the register shift, record cash in and out, open the drawer and review the difference when closing.
en.body:
A shift is the period during which a register is open for charging. It lets you keep control of cash: how much there was at the start, how much came in and out, and how much should be there at the end. To use the **Shift** section you need the "Cash shift" permission.

If you try to charge without an open shift on that tablet, the register says "This device has no open shift. Each register keeps its own shift." You can tap **Open a shift to charge** or **Send to the register to charge**.

## Each tablet has its own drawer

Each tablet keeps its own shift and its own cash drawer. If you have two registers, each opens and closes its own shift. Sales reports add up all devices, but the shift summary covers only that tablet's drawer. See [Several tablets](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/several-tablets/).

## Opening the shift

1. Go to the **Shift** section. You'll see **No open shift**.
2. Type the **Opening cash (name)** you leave in the drawer, one figure for each currency you handle. If you start with no cash, type 0 (it's valid).
3. Tap **Open shift**.

If one is already open on that tablet, the register says "There is already an open shift on this device."

## While the shift is open

The shift screen shows:

- **Sales made** and **Total sold**.
- **Shift payments**, by payment method.
- **Cash that should be in the register**: starting cash plus cash collected, plus cash in, minus cash out.

### Cash in and cash out

Use these buttons when you put money into or take money out of the drawer outside a sale (for example, to buy ice or leave change).

1. Tap **Cash in** or **Cash out**.
2. Choose the currency.
3. Type the **Amount** (greater than zero).
4. Type the **Reason**.
5. Tap **Record**.

### Opening the drawer without a sale

Tap **Open drawer**, type the reason and confirm. You'll see **Drawer opened**. If no receipt printer has a drawer connected, the register records the opening but warns "It was recorded, but no receipt printer has a drawer." To set up the drawer, see [Printers and hardware](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/printers-and-hardware/).

You can also open it from the sales screen, in the ⋮ menu > "Open drawer" (requires the "Open drawer" permission).

## Closing the shift

1. Count the cash in the drawer.
2. In **Shift**, tap **Close shift**.
3. Type the **Counted** amount, one figure per currency.
4. If there are open bills, the register warns you, but it doesn't stop you from closing.
5. Confirm the closing.

**Shift closed** appears with three figures per currency:

- **Expected**: what should be there.
- **Counted**: what you counted.
- **Difference (counted minus expected)**: 0 means the drawer balances; negative means money is missing; positive means there is extra.

The closing summary prints by itself. If you need another copy, tap **Print close report again**. Tap **Done** to finish.

## Previous shifts

In the same section, **Previous shifts** lists past closings. Each one shows **Drawer balanced** or **Difference** with the amount.

## Next step

- [Charging a sale](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/charging/)
- [Printers and hardware](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/printers-and-hardware/)

en.title: Tables and table orders
en.description: Turn on tables, create them by area, use the map, handle several orders per table, move, merge and split orders, request the bill and charge service.
en.body:
With tables turned on you can keep an open order per table, see which are free or busy and hand the bill to the customer before charging.

## Turn on tables

1. Open **Settings** > **Sales and taxes**.
2. Under **Features**, turn on the **Tables** switch.

Tables **cannot be turned off while orders are open**: "There are open table checks: charge or close them before turning Tables off."

## Create tables and areas

You need the **Menu and tables** permission.

1. In the **Tables** section tap **Edit tables**.
2. Enter the table name and, if you want, its **Area (optional)** (for example Terrace or Main room).
3. Save.

If there are no tables yet, the map shows: "There are no tables yet. Ask the manager to create them."

## The table map

- Each table appears as **Free** or with the minutes it has been open (**(number) min**).
- A **Ready** mark means the kitchen finished the order. **Check requested** means the customer asked for the bill.
- Filters: **All**, **Mine** and chips by area. On a tablet with the **Waiter** role, **Mine** is selected by default.
- Tap a free table to open its order or a busy one to continue it.
- A table can have several orders: **Check 1**, **Check 2** and so on.

At the table you sell the same way as on the Register screen. See [Selling](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/selling/).

## Move, merge and split orders

Inside a table order, open the **⋮** menu:

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Move to another table** | Moves the order to another table |
| **Merge with another table** | Combines the orders of two tables into one |
| **Split check** | Separates part of the items into a new order |

To split:

1. Tap **Split order**. You need at least **2 lines** and the Charge permission.
2. Check the items that go to the new order. Leave **at least one** in the original order.
3. Confirm.

If the order has a discount: **Remove the discount before splitting the check**.

## Request or print the bill

The button changes depending on your role:

- **Request check** if you do not have the Charge permission.
- **Print check** if you do.

It prints the customer's bill with the legend **NOT AN INVOICE** and marks the table for the cashier. You will see:

- **Check printed and flagged for the cashier**, or
- **Check flagged for the cashier, but there is no receipt printer**.

Whether waiters can request the bill is controlled in Settings > Sales and taxes with the **Servers can request the check** switch. When a table requests the bill, the cashier sees the notice **(name) asked for the check**.

## Charge a service fee on tables

In Settings > **Sales and taxes** > **Service**:

1. Enter the **Service (%)** (from 0 to 100).
2. Turn on **Charge service on tables**.

Service is only charged on table orders. It appears as its own line in the totals.

## Errors

| Message | What to do |
|---|---|
| "The table no longer exists or is deactivated." | Refresh the map and choose another table |
| "That table already has an open check." | Choose another table or continue the existing order |
| "Only table checks can be moved, merged or split." | This option does not apply to To go or Delivery orders |
| "Choose at least one item and leave at least one on the original check." | Adjust the selection when splitting |
| "This tab was paid (or voided) on another device." | Another tablet already closed it. The register drops it by itself |

## Next step

When the customer asks to pay, continue with [Charging](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/charging/).

en.title: Troubleshooting
en.description: The error messages and alerts of Yammbo Food POS and the food.yammbo.com dashboard, grouped by situation, with their cause and what to do.
en.body:
Find your situation and the message as it appears on screen. Each row says what it means and what to do.

The app messages and labels are quoted here exactly as they appear when the app is set to English. If your app is set to Spanish, you will see the Spanish original. Messages from the web dashboard (food.yammbo.com) are shown in their original Spanish, followed by a translation.

- [I cannot sign in with my PIN](#i-cannot-sign-in-with-my-pin)
- [Account and web dashboard](#account-and-web-dashboard)
- [I cannot link the register](#i-cannot-link-the-register)
- [Employees, roles and permissions](#employees-roles-and-permissions)
- [Register offline and web orders paused](#register-offline-and-web-orders)
- [Web orders that do not ring or cannot be accepted](#web-orders-that-do-not-ring-or-cannot-be-accepted)
- [Changes that are not saved on the web](#changes-that-are-not-saved-on-the-web)
- [Several tablets](#several-tablets)
- [It does not print](#it-does-not-print)
- [Selling, tables and charging](#selling-tables-and-charging)
- [Payment links and QR](#payment-links-and-qr)
- [Receipts](#receipts)
- [Menu and products](#menu-and-products)
- [Backups](#backups)

## I cannot sign in with my PIN

| Message | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| "Wrong PIN" | PIN typed incorrectly | Type it again. It signs in from 4 digits; with 6 digits it signs in by itself. |
| "Too many attempts. Wait (number) s" | 5 wrong tries in a row lock the keypad for 30 seconds | Wait for the countdown to end. |
| "Two employees have this PIN, so nobody can sign in with it. Ask the owner to change one of them." | Two active employees share the same PIN | An owner changes one of the PINs (in the web dashboard if the register is linked). |
| "Your role has no access to any section. Ask the owner for help." | Your role has no permissions | An owner must give permissions to your role. |
| "Your role cannot do this. Ask someone with permission to enter their PIN." | The action needs a permission you do not have | Have a supervisor type their PIN in **Supervisor authorization**. It is valid for 2 minutes and a single action. |
| "Wrong PIN or no permission" | The supervisor's PIN is wrong or their role lacks that permission | Try another supervisor. |
| "Entering the kitchen without a PIN is no longer available. Log in with a PIN." | The role or the **Enter without a PIN** setting changed | Sign in with your PIN. |
| The tablet locks by itself | Auto-lock (5 minutes by default) | Adjust it in Settings > **This device** > **Auto-lock (minutes)**. With 0 it never locks. |

## Account and web dashboard

| Message | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| "Wrong email or password." | Sign-in details typed incorrectly | Check them or use «Olvidé mi contraseña» (I forgot my password). The dashboard signs in with email and password, not with a code. |
| "Verify your email first." | The account has not confirmed its email yet | Enter the 6-digit code that was emailed to you. |
| "The code is not correct or has already expired." | The code is valid for 30 minutes | Tap «Enviar otro código» (Send another code). |
| "Too many attempts. Request a new code." | The code's attempts ran out | Request a new code. |
| "Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again." | Rate limit | Wait a few minutes. |
| "This account is deactivated. Write to support@yammbo.com." | Deactivated account | Write to support. |
| "We could not send the email. Try again in a few minutes." | Email sending failed | Try again in a few minutes. |
| "You do not have permission to do this." | Your role lacks **Settings** for that section | Ask an Owner to change your role. |
| "Someone else changed this while you were editing. Reload the page and try again." | Two people edited at once | Reload the page. |
| "This restaurant changed status while you were viewing it. Reload the page." | A status change happened at the same time | Reload the page. |
| "Under review by Yammbo. We will email you when it is approved." | You finished the wizard; approval is pending | Wait for the "We approved…" email. You cannot link the register until then. |
| "Your restaurant is suspended." | Yammbo suspended the business | Tap «Hablar con Yammbo» (Talk to Yammbo) or write to support@yammbo.com. Your page and new orders are off; you can keep serving the orders you already have. |
| "This feature is turned off for your restaurant." | A feature of your plan is off | Contact Yammbo. |

## I cannot link the register

To link you need three things: the business **approved** (status "Published"), an **Owner employee with a PIN** in the web dashboard and, if you use a code, that it has not expired.

### With your email (first start)

| Message | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| "Type a valid e-mail." | Email typed incorrectly | Fix it. |
| "The code is wrong, expired or already used. Ask for a new one." | The emailed code is valid for 30 minutes and works once | Tap **Resend code**, enabled after 30 seconds. |
| "The sign-in expired (it lasts 5 minutes). Start again with your e-mail." | You took more than 5 minutes after typing the code | Start again with your email. |
| "Your account can no longer link registers to this restaurant." | Your account lost the **Settings** permission in the restaurant | Ask an Owner to give it back. |
| "Your account has no restaurant you can link. Finish the sign-up on the web." | There is no business ready | Finish the wizard at food.yammbo.com and wait for approval. |
| "Only the account owner can create the first employee…" | The restaurant has no employees and you are not the account owner | Go to food.yammbo.com/dashboard/team and create an employee with the Owner role. |
| "The web employees could not be applied because there is no active owner…" / "The web employees were not applied: the register would have been left without an active owner…" | The web has employees but none is an active Owner | At food.yammbo.com/dashboard/team, keep at least one active Owner. |
| "The employees could not be fetched. Check the internet and try again." | No internet | Check the connection and retry. |
| "That employee already exists in the account. Contact Yammbo support." | The employee already exists on the web | Write to support. |
| "Type a name." / "The PIN must have 4 to 6 numbers." / "The two PINs do not match." | Data when creating the business | Fix the field. |

### With the dashboard code («Dispositivos»)

| Message | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| "The code is wrong or expired, or the restaurant does not exist or is not active. Generate a new code in the web panel." | Code mistyped, expired (5 minutes), already used, replaced by a newer one, or business not active | In the dashboard, «Dispositivos» (Devices) > «Vincular dispositivo» (Link device), generate another and type it within 5 minutes. Also check the restaurant name. |
| "Type the restaurant address, for example food.yammbo.com/my-restaurant." | Address missing | Type your restaurant's name or address. |
| "The code has 6 digits." | Incomplete code | Type all 6 digits. |
| "Check the data: the register name can be up to 60 characters." | Register name too long | Shorten it. |
| "Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again." | Too many attempts or codes | Wait a few minutes. |
| "This restaurant does not have register connection enabled. Enable it in the web dashboard." | The register connection feature is off | Contact Yammbo. |
| "the restaurant account is not active" / "…is suspended." | Business not approved or suspended | Wait for approval or contact Yammbo. |
| "No connection with food.yammbo.com. Check your internet and try again." | No internet | Connect the tablet to the internet. |
| "The server is not answering right now. Try again in a few minutes." | Service unavailable for a moment | Try again later. |
| "The server answered something unexpected. Try again." | Unexpected response | Try again. |
| "The link could not be stored securely on this tablet. Revoke this register in the web panel (Devices/Registers) and generate a new code." | The tablet could not store the link | In the web dashboard, «Dispositivos», remove that register with **Remove**, generate a new code and link again. |

### Errors in the dashboard when generating the code

| Message | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| "First create an employee with the Owner role in the Employees section of Team. Without one a tablet cannot be linked." | There is no active employee with the Owner role | In «Equipo» (Team) > «Empleados del POS» (POS employees) tap **Add employee**, with the Owner role and a 4 to 6 digit PIN. |
| "Choose the location" | There are several active locations and you did not pick one, or none is active | Choose the «Sucursal» (Location) or activate one. |
| "The location does not belong to this business." | Location from another business | Choose one of your own. |
| "Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again." | Maximum of 30 codes per hour, or too many failed attempts | Wait a few minutes. |
| "We could not find that device." | You removed a device that no longer exists | Reload the page. |

A tablet is linked to **one location** for good. If your device shows "No location (link again)", remove it and link it again.

## Employees, roles and permissions

| Message | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| "That PIN is already used by another active employee. Choose another." | The PIN must be unique among active employees | Choose another PIN (4 to 6 numbers). |
| "The PIN has 4 to 6 numbers." / "The PIN must have 4 to 6 numbers." | Wrong format | Fix it. |
| "at least one active owner must remain." | You try to deactivate or change the role of the last owner | Create another Owner first. |
| "Only an owner can change an owner or give the Owner role." | Permission missing | Have an Owner do it. |
| "You cannot give or change permissions that you do not have." | Permission missing | Have someone with that permission do it. |
| "You cannot edit or delete your own role." | Role rule | Have another owner edit it. |
| "Some employees have this role. Change their role before deleting it." | Role in use | Change those employees' role. |
| "Built-in roles cannot be deleted." | Owner, Manager, Cashier, Waiter and Kitchen | They cannot be deleted. |
| "The online account takes up to 100 employees." / "You reached the maximum of 100 employees." | Employee limit | Deactivate the ones you no longer use. |
| "Reactivate the employee before changing their PIN." / "To reactivate, set a new PIN." | Deactivated employee | Reactivate with a new PIN. |

If the register is linked, employees, roles and PINs are managed in the web dashboard («Equipo» section).

## Register offline and web orders

The online store only accepts orders when a linked register of that location is **on and online**. If 3 minutes pass without a connection, the store stops accepting orders until the register comes back.

| Where you see it | Message | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| Your customer, in the store | "This location is not receiving online orders right now. Try again later." | Open the app on the linked register, with internet. |
| Web dashboard, **Panel** section | "No register connected: this location is not receiving web orders. Open Yammbo Food POS on the tablet." | Open the app on the tablet. With «Ver dispositivos» (See devices) check the "Last contact" (if it is more than 3 minutes old, it is offline). |
| Register, banner | "Web orders paused: no connection with food.yammbo.com. They resume by themselves when the connection is back." | Check the tablet's internet. It resumes by itself. |
| Register, banner | "Link this register again" | Tap the notice and link again (see below). |
| Register, **Online account** card | "The server unlinked this register (revoked in the panel or invalid token). Link it again." | Someone removed the register in the dashboard or the link stopped being valid. Link it again. |
| Register | "Link this register again: the server cannot find its location." | Sign in again to link. Your sales, products and employees on the tablet are not deleted. |
| Register | "This register is no longer linked on the server." | Link again. |
| Register | "No connection with food.yammbo.com yet" | There has been no connection yet; open the app with internet. |
| Customer, when ordering | "This restaurant is not receiving orders for now." | There is no active location that receives orders. Activate it under «Sucursales». |
| Customer, when ordering | "The restaurant is closed right now." | Outside the location's hours. |

**How to keep the register online:**

- Leave the app open on the linked register, with internet and the screen on.
- When the register is linked, the app keeps a permanent notification ("Receiving orders from food.yammbo.com"). If Android 13 or later hides it, orders still arrive.
- Give the tablet's battery setting "Allow without restrictions" so orders are not lost with the screen off.
- If the internet drops for a moment it does not matter: the register retries by itself and is never unlinked because of a lack of internet.

**Unlink and revoke:** **Unlink** on the register only forgets the link on that tablet. For the server to stop accepting it, also remove the register in the web dashboard, under «Dispositivos» > **Remove** > «Sí, quitar» (Yes, remove); the tablet loses access immediately.

## Web orders that do not ring or cannot be accepted

| Situation | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| The order arrives but the alarm does not ring | «Silencio total» (total silence) on, alarm volume low, or notification permission not granted | The ring uses the alarm channel and cannot be turned off, but with total silence it does not sound. Raise the volume with **Raise volume** and test with **Test order sound** (**Settings** > **Location and devices** > **What this device is for**). |
| "The alarm volume is very low: you will not hear the orders" | Low alarm volume | Tap **Raise volume**. |
| "Your role cannot accept or reject orders. Ask someone who can sell or charge." | Permission missing | Ask someone with permission to sell or charge. |
| "This device is not the register linked to food.yammbo.com. Accept the order on the linked register." | Only the linked register accepts or rejects | Accept the order on the linked register. Other tablets see "Web order #(number) is waiting for an answer on the linked register." |
| "(name): the server did not accept the answer: (name). The order is waiting for an answer again." | The server did not accept your **Accept** or **Reject**. Reasons: that employee has no permission, the server does not recognize the order, the order was already in another state, the request was not valid, or there was no connection in time (6 hours offline) | The order goes back to pending and rings again. Check the reason and answer it again, or handle it from **Orders** in the web dashboard. |
| "(name): the server does not allow that step for that employee." / "…does not recognize it for this register." / "…was in another state; the real state is shown." / "…the server rejected the step." | State change not accepted | Check the order's real state on screen. |
| "A web order could not be read: check it in the dashboard." | The register could not read an order | Handle it from **Orders** in the web dashboard. |
| "(name) was cancelled." / "(name) was rejected." (rings three times) | The customer cancelled, or another register or the dashboard rejected it | The account is voided by itself with the reason. |
| "(name) ended (name) but already has a payment: settle it in Open orders." | The order ended but already had a payment | Resolve it by hand in **Open orders**. |
| "(name): the website was not told about the void (reason). Let the customer know." | You voided on the register and the server did not accept the notice | Let the customer know yourself. |
| "The website will not be told about this void from this device: let the customer know." | No linked register | Let the customer know yourself. |

## Changes that are not saved on the web

When the register is linked, some changes are uploaded to food.yammbo.com. If the web does not accept them, the register downloads again what the web has (the local change is reverted) and shows: "The change to (employee, business data, customer, menu item "X" or payment method "X") was not saved on the web: (reason)".

| Reason | What to do |
|---|---|
| "another active product on the web already uses that barcode." | Change the barcode on the register or on the web. |
| "the category still has products on the web." | First move or delete the products on the web. |
| "the product is part of a combo on the web." | Take it out of the combo on the web. |
| "the product is not a combo on the web." / "the web already has that product with the other type (single or combo) and it cannot be changed." | The type (product or combo) does not change once created. |
| "other menu items depend on it and wait until you fix it (empty name, too many groups or options, or a price over the limit)." | Fix that item. |
| "there is a more recent version and that one was kept." | A later change won (the last change wins). |
| "the person who made it has no permission on the web." | Give the employee the permission in the web dashboard. |
| "you cannot give more permissions than the person making the change has." | Ask an Owner to do it. |
| "at least one active owner must remain." | Keep at least one active Owner. |
| "the web takes up to 100 employees." | Deactivate employees you no longer use. |
| "the role does not exist on the web." | Check the roles in the web dashboard. |
| "the web account is suspended." | Contact Yammbo. |
| "some value is not valid for the web." | Review the data of the change. |
| "this register no longer has a location on the web. Link it again." | Link the register again. |
| "bank transfers are switched off for this business on Yammbo." | Contact Yammbo to enable them. |
| "the web already has the maximum of 10 cards or 10 bank accounts." | Remove one under «Tienda» (Store) > «Formas de pago» (Payment methods). |
| "the web already has that payment method with another type and it cannot be changed." | The method's type does not change once saved. |
| "the web did not accept it." | Review the change and try again. |

Other notices:

- "The web currency has different decimals than this register's, so it was not applied. Prices and charges were not changed." Use currencies with the same decimals on both sides.
- "To upload the menu, an employee with the Menu permission must also exist on the web." Permanent notice; it goes away when you create an employee with the Menu permission on the web.
- "The online account takes up to 100 employees."

## Several tablets

| Message | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| "This register is not connected to Wi-Fi. Connect both tablets to the same Wi-Fi network of the shop." / "This tablet is not connected to a Wi-Fi network." | No Wi-Fi | Connect both tablets to the same Wi-Fi. |
| "The other register runs another version of the app. Update both to the same version." / "This tablet and the register run different versions of the app." | Different versions | Update all tablets to the same version (see [Install and update](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/install-and-update/)). |
| A tablet shows "Offline. Last seen: (name)" with no clear reason | It may be on another version (the app does not say so), turned off or without Wi-Fi | Compare the version in Settings and update; check the Wi-Fi and that the app was not closed by battery saving. |
| "This tablet runs an older version and cannot sync: remove it from the business and join it again (Join an existing business)." | Very old version | Remove it from the location, update and join it again. |
| "The code has expired. Start pairing again to get a new one." / "The code is not correct." / "The code was entered wrong too many times. Start pairing again to get a new one." | Expired code (5 minutes), wrong code, or too many attempts | Tap **Add device** again on the register and use the new code. |
| "Enter the register's IP address." / "Enter a valid port." | IP or port missing when joining by hand | Type the data the register shows. |
| "That PIN does not belong to an owner of this register." / "Type the owner PIN." / "Type the word BORRAR." | When erasing and joining | Type an owner's PIN and the word BORRAR. |
| "The business accepted this device, but this one could not be prepared. Check the free space and try again." | Low space on the tablet | Free up space and retry. |
| "The business accepted this device but did not say which receipt prefix to use. Try again." | Momentary failure | Retry. |
| "This device could not be erased. Try again." | Failure while erasing | Retry. |
| "That tablet was not found." / "A register cannot remove itself." | When removing a device | Remove the tablet from another register. |
| "This register does not share data with others yet." | No tablet has joined yet | Add a device. |
| "This tab was paid (or voided) on another device." | Another tablet charged or voided that account | Nothing to fix; the register dropped it. |
| "There are (number) conflicts between registers to review." | Two tablets changed the same thing offline | See [Several tablets](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/several-tablets/#conflicts-between-registers). |
| "The time on T02 differs by N min…" | Clock out of sync | Fix the time in Android. |
| Customer display: "Reconnecting to the register" | The connection was lost | Check the Wi-Fi. |
| Customer display: "This tablet is no longer paired" | The register removed it | Tap **Link again**. |
| "Could not reach the register. Make sure both tablets are on the same Wi-Fi network." / "The register did not answer properly. Try again." / "Could not start the Wi-Fi connection. Check that you are on the network and try again." | Network problem when linking a customer display | Check the Wi-Fi and retry. |
| "The code has expired, or the register has no pairing open." / "Too many attempts. Ask for a new code on the register." | Customer display code | Tap **Pair a tablet** again on the register. |
| "Turn on 'Show the sale on the customer screen' to pair tablets." | The option is not enabled | Enable it in Settings > **Printers and hardware**. |
| "This device is joined to others in the location. To restore, first remove it from the location…" | You try to restore a backup on a joined tablet | See [Backups](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/backups/). |

## It does not print

The warning looks like "Could not print on (name): (reason)".

| Reason | What to do |
|---|---|
| "Bluetooth is turned off" | Turn on Bluetooth. |
| "No Bluetooth printer was chosen" | Edit the printer and choose a paired one. If there are none, pair the printer in Android first. |
| "There are no paired devices." / "Without the Bluetooth permission the list of paired printers cannot be shown." | Pair the printer or grant the permission. |
| "The printer's IP address is missing" | Type the IP in the setup. |
| "The port must be between 1 and 65535." | Use a valid port (the usual one is 9100). |
| "Permission to use the USB printer is missing" | Tap **Ask for permission** and accept. |
| "The USB printer is busy with another app" | Close the other app that uses it. |
| "The built-in printer did not answer" | Try again with **Test**. |
| "No receipt printer is set up on this device." | Add a printer with **Prints receipts** checked. |
| The kitchen ticket does not come out | Check that the printer has the station checked and that the product has a **Preparation station**. A product with no station does not print in the kitchen. |
| Two tickets come out | The register and a kitchen tablet have a printer for the same station; remove one. |
| The drawer does not open: "It was recorded, but no receipt printer has a drawer." | Check **Has a cash drawer** on the printer the drawer is connected to. |

Full steps in [Printers and hardware](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/printers-and-hardware/).

## Selling, tables and charging

| Message | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| "This device has no open shift. Each register keeps its own shift." / "Open a shift first to be able to charge." | You cannot charge without a shift on that tablet | Tap **Open a shift to charge**; see [Shifts and cash drawer](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/shifts-and-cash-drawer/). |
| "There is already an open shift on this device." / "There is no open shift." | Shift status | Check the **Shift** section. |
| "The menu is empty. Add products in the Menu section." | There are no products | Add products. |
| "This product is deactivated." | The product is inactive | Activate it in the Menu. |
| "That line was already sent to the kitchen and cannot be changed." | Line already sent | Use **Void sent item**, which needs the **Void** permission or a supervisor. |
| "There is nothing new to send to the kitchen." | Everything was already sent | Nothing to do. |
| "A delivery needs the customer's name, phone and address." | Delivery data missing | Fill in **Delivery details**. |
| "The discount cannot be greater than the total of the items." | Discount too large | Lower the amount. |
| "Remove the discount before splitting the check" | Cannot split with a discount | Remove the discount. |
| "There are open table checks: charge or close them before turning Tables off." | You try to turn off Tables with open accounts | Charge or close the accounts. |
| "That table already has an open check." / "The table no longer exists or is deactivated." | Table status | Choose another table. |
| "Only table checks can be moved, merged or split." / "Choose at least one item and leave at least one on the original check." | When moving or splitting | Fix the selection. |
| "That combination of options gives the item a negative price. Check the menu extras." | Negative extras larger than the price | Fix the extras. |
| "The chosen options do not meet the minimum or maximum of the group." | Modifiers | Choose within the minimum and maximum. |
| "Non-cash payments cannot exceed what is left to pay." | Card or transfer for more than what is left | Lower the amount. |
| "There is still money left to collect." | The account is not covered | Add payments until **Remaining** reaches zero. |
| "This payment method needs a reference." | The method has **Ask for a reference** | Type the reference (up to 40 characters). |
| "One of the payments uses a method that is no longer active. Remove it and add it with another method." | Deactivated method | Change the method. |
| "Leave at least one way of charging active" | You want to turn everything off | Keep one active under **Payment methods**. |
| "Finish or save the order on screen before opening another one." | There is an order on screen | Save or finish it. |

## Payment links and QR

| Message | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| "Open this device's shift before charging by link." | No shift | Open the shift. |
| "This session cannot charge." | Your role lacks **Charge** | Sign in as an employee who can charge. |
| "No payment methods are active. Turn them on in Settings, Payments." | All are off | Turn them on in Settings > **Payment methods**. |
| "The provider did not accept the credentials. Check them in Settings, Payments." | Keys mistyped or wrong | Type them again and use **Test connection**. Keys are stored per tablet. |
| "No connection to the provider. It retries on its own." | No internet or the provider is not responding | Wait or check the internet. |
| "The provider does not accept this currency for your business." / "The link charge currency is not one of the business currencies." | Unsupported currency | Review **Charge currency** and the business currency. |
| "The amount is outside what the provider allows." | Amount too low or too high | Charge another amount or use another method. |
| "The provider answered something unexpected. See the diagnostics in Settings, Payments." | Unexpected response | Tap **View diagnostics** and send it to support. |
| "The provider rejected the repeated reference. Try again." / "The provider rejected the operation." | The provider did not accept it | Try again. |
| "The payment was not completed. Nothing was charged." / "The link expired without a payment." | About 15 minutes went by or it was cancelled | Create a new charge. |
| "There is a pending link payment" | You closed the charge screen without finishing | Tap **Resume and check**. |
| "The link expired, but the provider did not confirm it is closed. The app keeps watching it…" | The provider's confirmation is missing | Wait; the app checks every 30 seconds. |
| "Payment received but not recorded" | The provider charged, but it could not be recorded in a sale | Refund the money from the provider's dashboard and tap **Mark as resolved**. |
| "The provider reports a payment that does not match the link amount. It was not recorded. See the diagnostics." | The amount paid does not match | Nothing was recorded; check the payment in the provider's dashboard. |
| "There are N unresolved payments of X. Credentials or test mode cannot be changed, nor can this provider be removed, until they are resolved." | There are pending payments | Resolve them first. |
| Tap to Pay errors | It is only for Stripe, needs Android 13 or later, NFC and location turned on. It has not been verified on real devices | Check NFC, location and permissions; if it fails, use the link or QR. |

A payment is never recorded unless the provider confirms it. More in [Payment links and QR](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/payment-links-and-qr/).

## Receipts

| Message | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| "The phone number is not valid. Enter 8 digits or the full number with the country code." | Wrong phone | Fix it. |
| "The email is not valid." | Email mistyped | Fix it. |
| "There is no app to send the receipt that way." | The tablet lacks the app (WhatsApp, SMS, email) | Install the app or use another method. |
| "The receipt to (name) could not be sent: (name)" | The automatic email failed. Reasons: this register is no longer linked, the server no longer recognizes this register, invalid data such as the email, register connection is turned off, the restaurant account is not active or is suspended, that send already exists with other content, the receipt is too large, 24 hours went by without a connection, or the server rejected it | Tap **Open mail app** to send it from your email, or **Discard**. Without internet the receipt waits in a queue and is discarded after 24 hours. |
| "To send it automatically, link the register in Settings, Location and devices, Online account. For now your mail app will open." | Register not linked | Link it to send the automatic email. |
| Show receipt QR: "No internet connection." / "Too many links were created in one hour. Try again in a few minutes." / "The online account is suspended." / "This register is unlinked from the online account." / "The online account does not allow links right now." / "The link could not be created." | The receipt link could not be created | Check the internet and the link, or wait a few minutes. The QR is only available on linked registers. |
| "Sent without the receipt link. (name)" | The message went out without the link | Generate the QR when there is internet. |

## Menu and products

| Message | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| "Another active product already uses that barcode." / "No product with code (name)" | Repeated or non-existent code | Use a different code. |
| "Enter a valid price, for example 45 or 45.50." | Wrong price | Fix it. |
| "The description can have up to 300 characters." | Description too long | Shorten it. |
| "The product was saved, but the photo could not be saved. Try again." | The photo failed | Upload the photo again. |
| "The product already has sales, so it was deactivated instead of deleted." | Products with history are not deleted | Nothing to do; it stays inactive. |
| "This item is a component of a combo. Remove it from the combo before deleting it." | It is in a combo | Remove it from the combo. |
| "This category has products. Move them to another one or deactivate the category." | Category with products | Move the products. |
| "The schedule is not valid. Use times like 07:00, and close before 06:00 the next day." | Category schedule | Fix it. |
| "A new combo is created inactive." | This is normal | Add the groups and activate it. |
| A combo says **Unavailable** | A group is left with fewer active components than its minimum | Activate the components. |
| "Customer joined with the one that already existed on the web: (name)" | Same phone on the register and on the web | It is only a notice. |

## Backups

The Google Drive, file and restore messages are in the table in [Backups](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/backups/#backup-errors). The most frequent ones:

| Message | What to do |
|---|---|
| "Google Drive needs to be reconnected" / "Backup stopped" | Tap **Reconnect**. |
| "Your Google Drive is full. Free some space and try again." | Free space in Drive. |
| "This device has no Google Play Services…" | Use **Export a copy to a file**. |
| "The backup comes from a newer version of the app. Update the app." | Update the tablet. |
