Write to support@yammbo.com telling us what you expected to happen and the exact message you saw. For a payment link or QR problem, attach the text from **View diagnostics** (it does not include keys).

## Related

- [FAQ](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/faq/)
- [Several tablets](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/several-tablets/)
- [Printers and hardware](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/printers-and-hardware/)

en.title: What is Yammbo Food POS
en.description: The register for restaurants, bars and cafes that works without internet, its web dashboard and your online store, and what you need to get started.
en.body:
**Yammbo Food POS** is an Android register app built for restaurants, bars and cafes. You use it to sell, take payments, send orders to the kitchen, run your cash shift and see your reports, and it **keeps working even when the internet goes down**.

It connects to **food.yammbo.com**, which gives you two more things: a **web dashboard** to manage your business and a public **online store** where your customers order from their phones.

## The three parts

| Part | What it is | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| The register (Yammbo Food POS app) | Android tablet or phone app | Selling, charging, kitchen, tables, shift, menu, customers, reports |
| The web dashboard | food.yammbo.com/dashboard | Creating your account, getting the business approved, linking registers, live orders, editing the store, menu and team |
| Your online store | food.yammbo.com/ plus your restaurant's short name | Lets customers see your menu and place delivery or pickup orders |

## What you need to get started

1. An **Android tablet or phone running Android 7 or later**.
2. An **account on food.yammbo.com**, with the business **approved by Yammbo**. See [Create your account](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/create-your-account/).
3. **Internet only for the first start**: a new register links to your account while online. After that it works without internet as usual.

Some features depend on a connection: automatic receipt emails, the receipt QR or link, online store orders and payment by link or QR. Selling, taking cash or card payments, kitchen, shift and reports keep working offline.

## How the app is organized

The app bar shows the sections your role can use. On a phone the bottom bar shows four and the rest sit under **More**.

- **Register**: the sales screen. You search for products, build the order and charge. See [Selling](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/selling/).
- **Tables**: the table map and per-table orders. See [Tables](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/tables/).
- **Kitchen**: the preparation screen for kitchen and bar.
- **Shift**: open and close the cash shift, cash in and cash out.
- **More**: **Menu**, **Customers**, **Reports**, **Staff** and **Settings**.

Not every staff member sees everything: each employee signs in with a PIN and sees only what their role allows. See [Employees, roles and PIN](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/employees-roles-and-pin/).

## What happens without internet

- Once the register is linked you can keep selling, charging and sending orders to the kitchen.
- Your **online store stops accepting orders** if no linked register at the location has checked in for 3 minutes. So the register must be on, online and linked to receive web orders.

## Next step

Create your account and register your restaurant in [Create your account](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/food/create-your-account/).

en.title: Welcome to Yammbo Help
en.description: What each Yammbo product does, where you use it and which article to read first. Each product has its own account and its own plan.
en.body:
Yammbo is a family of separate products. You can use one or several, but **each one has its own account and its own plan**: signing up for one doesn't give you access to another.

## The products

| Product | What it does | Where you use it | Start here |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Yammbo POS** | The register for restaurants and stores: sales, payments, tables, kitchen, shifts, inventory and online ordering | An Android app for tablets and phones, plus a web dashboard at `pos.yammbo.com` | [What is Yammbo POS](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/overview/) |
| **Yammbo Store** | An online shop for businesses that sell products, on top of your Loyverse register | `store.yammbo.com`, in the browser | [What is Yammbo Store](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/what-is-yammbo-store/) |
| **Yammbo Web** | Website builder with templates, drag-and-drop blocks and AI | `web.yammbo.com`, in the browser | [What is Yammbo Web](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/web/overview/) |
| **Yammbot** | Replies for your business on WhatsApp, Messenger and Telegram with your own rules | An Android app, plus a web panel at `bot.yammbo.com` | [What is Yammbot](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/yammbot/what-is-yammbot/) |
| **Yammbo Music** | Music, live radio and podcasts, with Chromecast | `music.yammbo.com` and an Android app | [What is Yammbo Music](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/overview/) |
| **Yammbo TV** | Films and series by subscription | `tv.yammbo.com`, and apps for Android phones, Android TV and Windows | [What is Yammbo TV](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/tv/overview/) |

Yammbo POS is the full register: it runs in its own Android app and keeps selling without internet.

Open the product you're going to use and start with its first article, what it is; most products follow it with how to create your account. POS, Store, Web, Music and Yammbot also have their own troubleshooting and FAQ articles.

## Accounts and plans

- [Your Yammbo accounts and signing in](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/account/sign-in/): where and how you sign in to each product.
- [Plans and billing for each product](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/account/billing/): what each one costs and where you change or cancel it.

## If something isn't working

- [I can't sign in](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/troubleshooting/cant-sign-in/)
- [A product is loading slowly](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/troubleshooting/slow-loading/)

If none of this answers your question, write to **support@yammbo.com** and say which product it's about. A person reads every message.

en.title: Account settings
en.description: Manage your Yammbo Music account on the web - profile, password, two-factor authentication, active sessions, language and time zone, theme and deleting your account - and what you can do from the Android app.
en.body:
Your account settings live on the web, at `music.yammbo.com/account-settings`. To open them, press your avatar in the top bar and choose **"Account settings"**. The Android app has its own, much smaller, account area; it is at the end of this page.

## On the web

The page has a section for each topic:

| Section | What you can do |
|---|---|
| **"Account details"** | Change your first name, last name and profile image (**"Save"**) |
| **"Social login"** | See and unlink the Google or X accounts linked to yours. If you created the account with Google or X, first create a password with "Forgot your password?"; otherwise unlinking leaves you with no way to sign in |
| **"Password"** | Change it: **"Current password"**, **"New password"**, **"Confirm password"** |
| **"Two factor authentication"** | Turn on an extra code from an authenticator app (you scan a QR code) |
| **"Active sessions"** | See where you are signed in and press **"Logout other sessions"** to close all except this one (**"This device"**). Do it, and change your password, if you think someone else got in |
| **"Location and language"** | Language, country and time zone, under the heading "Date, time and language" |
| **"Danger zone"** | **"Delete account"** |

The web is available in Spanish (the default) and English. Change it in the **"Language"** field of the language section, then **"Save"**.

If you signed up by email and haven't confirmed it yet, you can browse, listen and change the language, but you can't change your profile or avatar, or edit or delete the account, until you confirm. See [Create your account](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/create-your-account/).

### Your email can't be changed

There is no email field in your settings. To change it, write to **support@yammbo.com**.

### Light and dark theme

In the same avatar menu, choose **"Dark mode"** or **"Light mode"**. The menu also has **"Billing"**, where you manage your plan: see [Plans and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/plans-and-billing/).

## Delete your account

Under **"Danger zone"**, press **"Delete account"**. Music asks for your password and then shows **"Delete account?"**: the account is deleted **immediately and permanently**, and it can't be restored.

While you have a subscription that is active, in a trial or in a grace period, deleting is blocked and you see "Could not delete subscribed user" followed by your email. Cancel the plan first (**"Billing"**), wait until the paid period ends, and then delete the account. If your plan was given to you by Yammbo (you don't pay for it), write to support@yammbo.com to delete the account. See [Plans and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/plans-and-billing/).

## In the Android app

- **Settings → "Accounts"**: shows your Yammbo email and lets you sign out. You can also sign in to YouTube Music there; it is off by default and independent of your Yammbo account.
- **Mi Cuenta** tab: Settings, Statistics, Plans / manage subscription, light / dark / auto theme and **"Cerrar sesión"** (these labels are in Spanish in the English app too).
- You **can't delete your account from the app**. Do it on the web, as described above.
- Signing out of the app deletes the app's local data. See [Library and playlists](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/library-and-playlists/).

## Privacy

The app sends Yammbo which songs you play, to build your statistics and recommendations, unless you turn on **"Pause listen history"** (**«Pausar historial de escucha»** in the Spanish app) in **Settings → General**. That tab is part of the paid plans: on a free account it is locked, so you can't turn it on.

Read the full texts here: [Privacy policy](https://music.yammbo.com/pages/privacy-policy) and [Terms of service](https://music.yammbo.com/pages/terms-of-service). Questions: support@yammbo.com.

Next: [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/troubleshooting/).

en.title: The Android app: download, install and update
en.description: How to download and install the Yammbo Music Android app, what permissions it asks for and why, how signing in works, and how to update it.
en.body:
The Yammbo Music Android app is a native player: it keeps playing with the screen off and adds downloads and other things the browser can't do. See [What the app can do](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/android-app-features/) for the full list.

## Requirements

- An Android phone or tablet with **Android 7.0 or later**.
- A Yammbo Music account (the app requires you to sign in).
- **It is not on Google Play.** You download the installer file (APK) from Yammbo's own site.

There is no iOS app. On iPhone or iPad, use the web at `music.yammbo.com` and add it to your home screen from Safari (Share → Add to Home Screen). See [What is Yammbo Music?](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/overview/).

## Download and install

1. On your Android phone, open `music.yammbo.com/download/YammboMusic.apk`. The link always gives the latest version.
2. When the download finishes, open the file from your browser's downloads or from the Files app.
3. Android will ask you to allow installing apps from that source (your browser or Files app — Android calls them "unknown sources"). Allow it, go back and press **Install**.
4. Open **Yammbo Music**.

## Permissions it asks for

| Permission | What it is for |
|---|---|
| Notifications | Playback controls in the notification, update notices and the download alert |
| Audio / music on the device | So **"On my device"** can show the music stored on your phone |
| Microphone and audio settings | Only for the equalizer and the audio visualizer |
| Install apps | So the app can update itself (see below) |

## First start

- **You must sign in.** The app doesn't play anything without an account.
- Use the **same account** as on `music.yammbo.com`, with **email and password only**. There is no Google or X button in the app.
- If you created your account on the web with Google or X, create a password first: press **"Forgot Password?"** on the app's sign-in screen (it opens the web) and set one.
- You can also register from the app. The password needs at least 6 characters, and you confirm it by typing it twice.
- In some countries Yammbo includes a paid plan for free; if you register there with a VPN on, the app may warn you to turn it off so your real country is detected.

Even with the app in English, a few texts stay in Spanish: **«Mi Música»**, **«Mi Cuenta»**, **«Cerrar sesión»**, **«Precios»**, **«Contenido Premium»**, **«Ver Planes»**, the «Suscríbete para …» messages and the «Nueva versión disponible» notification. They are written like that in the app.

## The five tabs

| Tab | What you find |
|---|---|
| **Home** | The home page |
| **Radio** | Live radio stations (the screen is called "Live radio") |
| **Mi Música** | Your songs, artists, albums, playlists, **"On my device"** and favorite stations |
| **Search** | Search the whole catalogue |
| **Mi Cuenta** | **Settings**, **Statistics**, plans (**«Precios»**, or **"Manage my subscription"** if you have a plan), theme and sign out |

Your library in the app is stored **on the phone**. It isn't synced with the web or with other phones. See [Library and playlists](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/library-and-playlists/).

## Updating the app

The app checks for new versions each time you open it (this is on by default).

1. When there is a new version, a dialog appears: **"A new version is here"**, with the version number and what's new.
2. Press **"Update now"**. The file downloads inside the dialog, with a progress bar; you can close the dialog and the installer opens by itself when it finishes. If you were away, press **"Install"**.
3. Android may ask you to allow the installation. Allow it and confirm.
4. **"Later"** hides the notice until a newer version comes out.

If the download fails, the dialog says "The update could not be downloaded. Check your connection and try again." and offers **"Try again"** and **"Download in the browser"**.

You may also get a notification that says «Nueva versión disponible: …».

You can turn the check off or on, and check by hand, in **Settings → General → "Enable automatic update check"** (options: Disabled, Enabled, Ask) with the **"Check now"** button. If there is nothing new, it shows "No updates available". That **General** tab is one of those that need a paid plan (see [What the app can do](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/android-app-features/#settings-that-need-a-paid-plan)); on a free plan the check still works with its default setting.

### "App not installed" or Android won't install over the old one

If Android refuses to install the update on top of the existing app, it is usually because the installed copy was signed differently. The fix is to uninstall and reinstall — but **uninstalling erases what the app stores on the phone** (favorites, playlists, history). Before that:

1. In the app, go to **Settings → Data** and, under **"BACKUP AND RESTORE"**, press **"Save to backup"**; it exports the database to your phone's storage.
2. Uninstall Yammbo Music, install the latest APK, and sign in.
3. Go back to **Settings → Data** and press **"Restore from backup"**.

More about backups in [What the app can do](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/android-app-features/#backup-and-restore).

## Next step

See [What the app can do](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/android-app-features/), or, if something doesn't work, [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/troubleshooting/).

en.title: What the Android app can do
en.description: Background playback, lock-screen controls, widgets, sleep timer, equalizer, picture-in-picture, statistics, backups and which settings need a paid plan.
en.body:
This is what the Android app adds on top of the web. To install it, see [The Android app](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/android-app/).

## Playing in the background

Songs keep playing with the screen off and when you leave the app. You get controls in the notification, on the lock screen, on wired and Bluetooth headphones and on a Bluetooth car system. In a browser, songs stop in the background; live radio does not.

On Android Auto the app shows up as a music app, with your library, radio and search. We haven't tested it on every car, so we can't promise it works with a given model.

Android's battery optimization can stop the player. See [Battery](#battery) below.

## Widgets

The app has two home-screen widgets, a **vertical** and a **horizontal** one. Add them from your phone's widget picker, like any other Android widget.

## Playback tools

| Tool | Where it is |
|---|---|
| Sleep timer | In the song's menu in the player: **"Set sleep timer"** |
| Equalizer | **Settings → General → "Equalizer"**: choose between the app's own ("Internal") or your phone's ("System") |
| Playback speed | In the player controls: the **"Playback speed"** dialog |
| Volume normalization | **Settings → General → "Loudness normalization"** |
| Watch the video | The **"Watch the video"** button in the player (and **"Back to the song"** to go back) |
| Picture in picture | **Settings → General → "Enable Picture-in-picture"** |

There is no audio-quality selector, in the app or on the web.

## Lyrics

Lyrics, synced when the song has them, are part of a paid plan. You can also share them. On a free plan the app says «Suscríbete para ver las letras».

## On the device

**Mi Música → "On my device"** shows the music stored on your phone. The app asks permission to read your device's audio for this. Songs stored on the phone can't be cast to a TV.

## Statistics

**Mi Cuenta → Statistics** shows what you listen to most and your listening time. The app also builds a yearly "Rewind" of your listening. Both are kept on your phone.

## Backup and restore

Your favorites, playlists and history live on the phone only, so a backup is the way to move them to another phone or to keep them safe before uninstalling.

- **Settings → Data → "BACKUP AND RESTORE"**: **"Save to backup"** exports the database; **"Restore from backup"** brings it back. Restoring overwrites the data currently in the app, and the app closes by itself afterwards.
- **Playlists to a file:** a playlist's menu has **"Export playlist"**, and the Playlists screen has **"Import playlist"**, to move them as CSV files.

Signing out of the app deletes the data stored on the phone. Make a backup first if you want to keep your library.

## Battery

If Android optimizes the app's battery use, the notification can disappear when you pause and playback can be cut. Two ways to avoid it:

- **Settings → General → "Ignore battery optimizations"** (this tab needs a paid plan).
- For everyone: Android **Settings → Apps → Yammbo Music → Battery → Unrestricted**.

## Settings that need a paid plan

In **Settings**, four tabs are locked on a free plan: **General**, **UI**, **Player Appearance** and **Home**. They show «Contenido Premium» and a **"Ver Planes"** button. The tabs **Data**, **Accounts**, **Misc** and **About** are open to everyone.

That affects every item above whose route starts with **Settings → General** (equalizer, normalization, picture in picture, the battery button and pausing the listening history). The backup lives in **Data**, which stays open. See [Free vs paid](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/free-and-paid/).

## Privacy: pause listening history

The app sends Yammbo which songs you listen to, to build your statistics and recommendations. To stop it, turn on **"Pause listen history"** (**Settings → General**, a paid-plan tab). It stops saving the playback events used for statistics, history and suggestions. Our privacy policy is at `music.yammbo.com/pages/privacy-policy`.

## Your Yammbo account in the app

**Settings → Accounts** shows your Yammbo email and lets you sign out. It also has an optional sign-in to YouTube Music, off by default and separate from your Yammbo account. You can't delete your account from the app: do it on the web, in [Account settings](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/account-settings/).

en.title: Cast to your TV with Chromecast
en.description: Send Yammbo Music to your TV with Chromecast, from the Android app or from Chrome or Edge on your computer - requirements, steps, what the TV shows, controls, error messages and where it doesn't work.
en.body:
You can send what is playing to a TV from the Android app or from a computer. Cast doesn't need a paid plan, but you do need to be signed in, as for any listening.

## What you need

- A **Chromecast**, or a TV with Chromecast built in (Google TV or Android TV).
- Your phone or computer and the TV on the **same Wi-Fi network**.
- On Android: **Google Play Services** on the phone. Without it the Cast button doesn't appear.
- On the computer: **Chrome or Edge**.

## From the Android app

1. Start a song or a live radio station.
2. Press the **Cast** button in the header, next to search.
3. Pick your TV from the list.

When it is connected, the button shows a white dot. To stop, press the button again and disconnect.

## From the computer (Chrome or Edge)

1. Open `music.yammbo.com` and start a song or a station.
2. Press the Cast button in the player bar (or in the maximized player). It is an icon: hover over it to see "Cast to a TV", and "Casting to" followed by the TV name once connected. These tooltips are in English on the Spanish version too.
3. The browser's own device picker opens. Choose your TV.

## What happens on the TV

- Songs and live radio are sent.
- The TV shows the cover and the lyrics.
- From then on **the TV is in charge**: play, pause, seek and volume control the TV.
- In the Android app, **Settings → General → "Show the video on the TV"** makes the TV play the YouTube video instead of the cover and lyrics. That tab is for paid plans. The web has no such option: it always sends the cover and lyrics.

## What can't be sent

A song stored on the phone ("On my device" or a download) isn't sent. The app says "A song stored on the phone cannot be cast, so it plays here" and plays it on the phone.

## Messages and errors

| Message | What it means | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| "The TV is not playing this song, so the sound comes back to the phone" | The TV didn't start the song | The sound returns to the phone and keeps playing there. Try again or pick another song |
| "Cast: YouTube 101: this song cannot be played on a TV" and the same for **150** | Whoever uploaded the song doesn't allow it to play outside YouTube's own apps, so a TV can't play it | Nothing on your side. Play another song or listen on the phone |
| "Cast: YouTube 100: this song is no longer on YouTube" | The song was removed | Play another song |

The YouTube messages (101, 150 and 100) appear in English. If the TV simply doesn't start the song, after about 9 seconds the sound returns to the phone and keeps playing there. Only with the YouTube errors 100, 101 and 150 does the app bring the sound back to the phone and skip to the next song, up to 3 in a row. On the web, a song the TV can't play is skipped without a message.

## Where it doesn't work

- **Firefox** and **Safari** on the computer: the Cast button doesn't appear.
- **iPhone and iPad**: there is no Cast button.
- The **mini player** on the web on a phone: the button isn't there.
- **Phones without Google Play Services**: the Android app's Cast button doesn't appear.

If the TV doesn't show up in the list, check that it is on and on the same Wi-Fi as your phone or computer. More help: [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/troubleshooting/).

Next: [Account settings](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/account-settings/).

en.title: Create your account
en.description: How to sign up for Yammbo Music on the web or in the Android app, how to confirm your email, and what you can do before you do.
en.body:
Creating a Yammbo Music account is free, and you need one to listen: a guest who tries to play something sees "Sign in or create a free account to listen." A guest also can't see the Library.

This account is only for Music. Your account for Yammbo Web, POS or Store doesn't work here, and the other way round. See [Your Yammbo accounts and signing in](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/account/sign-in/).

## Sign up on the web

1. Go to `music.yammbo.com/register`.
2. Pick how to sign up:
   - **Email and password** — fill in **"Email"**, **"Password"** and **"Confirm password"** and press **"Create account"**.
   - **Google** or **X** — under **"Or sign up with"**, press the button with the **Google** logo or the one with the **X** logo. You are sent to that service to approve, and then back to Music.
3. Facebook and Apple are not available.

## Confirm your email

If you signed up with email and password, Music sends you a **6-digit code** by email.

1. Press **"Verify email"** in the black banner at the top ("Confirm your email to be able to subscribe"), or open `music.yammbo.com/verify-email`.
2. Type the code in **"Code"** and press **"Next"**.
3. If it doesn't arrive, check spam and promotions, then use the **request a resend** link on that page.

The code expires after **30 minutes**; ask for a new one if it does.

Accounts created with Google or X are already verified.

| Before you confirm your email | |
|---|---|
| Browse, search, listen, follow, change the language, cancel a subscription | You can |
| Subscribe or change plan, comment, change your profile or avatar, edit or delete the account | You can't |

## Sign up in the Android app

The app asks you to sign in as soon as you open it, and it has a sign-up screen too.

1. On the sign-in screen, press **«Crear Cuenta»** (in English: "Create Account").
2. Fill in **Email**, **Password** and **Confirm Password**. The password needs at least 6 characters.
3. Press **"Register"**.

The app only registers with email and password; there is no Google or X button. The app has no screen for typing the verification code, so confirm your email on the web (sign in at `music.yammbo.com`) if you want to subscribe.

In some countries Yammbo includes a paid plan for free; if you register there with a VPN on, the app may warn you to turn it off so your real country is detected. Turn the VPN off before registering.

## Next step

[Sign in](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/signing-in/) on the web or in the app, or see [Free vs paid](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/free-and-paid/) to know what your account includes.

en.title: Frequently asked questions
en.description: Short answers to the most common questions about Yammbo Music, with links to the detailed article for each one.
en.body:
Short answers, with a link to the detailed article.

## Is Yammbo Music free?

Yes. A free account lets you search the whole catalogue, listen, follow podcasts and use live radio. A paid plan removes the ads and the skip limit, and adds likes, creating playlists, lyrics and downloads. See [Free vs paid](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/free-and-paid/).

## Do I need an account to listen?

Yes. Without an account you can't listen. Creating one is free. See [Create your account](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/create-your-account/).

## Is there an app for iPhone?

No. On iPhone or iPad use the web at `music.yammbo.com` and add it to your home screen from Safari. See [The Android app](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/android-app/).

## Is there an Android app, and is it on Google Play?

Yes, there is an Android app, but it is not on Google Play. You download the installer from `music.yammbo.com/download/YammboMusic.apk`. It needs Android 7.0 or later. See [The Android app](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/android-app/).

## Does it keep playing with the screen off?

In the Android app, yes. In a browser, live radio keeps playing but songs don't: the browser and YouTube don't allow it. See [What the app can do](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/android-app-features/).

## Can I download songs to listen offline?

Yes, in the Android app and with a paid plan. The app sends the songs to YTDLnis, a separate free downloader. There are no downloads on the web. See [Offline downloads](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/offline-downloads/).

## Can I play music on my TV?

Yes, you can send it from your phone or computer to a Chromecast or to a TV with Chromecast built in. Chromecast is the supported way to listen on a TV. See [Cast to your TV](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/cast-to-your-tv/).

## What is the difference between Basic and Pro?

Both unlock the same features. We don't promise any difference between them, and the prices are on `music.yammbo.com/pricing`. See [Plans and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/plans-and-billing/).

## Are my web playlists in the app?

No. The web and the app don't share a library: in the app, favorites, playlists and history are stored on the phone. You can move them with a backup. See [Library and playlists](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/library-and-playlists/).

## How do I cancel my plan?

From **Billing** (`music.yammbo.com/billing`), with **"Cancel plan"**. The plan stays active until the end of the period you paid for. Charges already made aren't refunded unless the law requires it. See [Plans and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/plans-and-billing/).

## Can I change my email?

Not from your account. Write to support@yammbo.com. See [Account settings](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/account-settings/).

## How do I delete my account?

On the web, in **Account settings → Danger zone → Delete account**. It asks for your password, it is immediate and it can't be undone. If you have an active plan, cancel it first and wait until the paid period ends; until then deleting is blocked. You can't do it from the app. See [Account settings](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/account-settings/).

## Why does YouTube block playback sometimes?

YouTube may ask a connection to confirm it isn't a bot, and then songs can't play for a while. Turning off a VPN or proxy, or trying another network, usually helps. See [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/troubleshooting/#web-playback).

## Is it the same account as my other Yammbo products?

No. Yammbo Music has its own account and its own plan. See [Signing in](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/signing-in/).

## Where do I ask for help?

Write to support@yammbo.com, or use the contact page at `music.yammbo.com/contact`. Tell us what you expected, what happened and the exact message. See [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/troubleshooting/).

en.title: Free vs paid
en.description: What you get with a free Yammbo Music account and what a paid plan adds, how the skip limit works, and the messages you may see.
en.body:
Music only tells two situations apart: you have an **active subscription**, or you don't. It is the same on the web and in the Android app. To use any of it you need a [Music account](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/create-your-account/); creating it is free.

## What each option includes

| | Free (with an account) | Paid plan |
|---|---|---|
| Listen to the whole catalogue, search, live radio, podcasts | Yes | Yes |
| Skipping songs | 6 per hour | Unlimited |
| Ads | Web: ads and Premium notices. App: a full-screen ad every 4 songs | None |
| Likes / saving to your Library | No | Yes |
| Creating playlists | No | Yes |
| Lyrics (synced when the song has them) | No | Yes |
| Downloads (Android app only, through YTDLnis) | No | Yes |
| App: Settings tabs General, UI, Appearance and Home | Locked | Yes |

Even with a free account you can follow playlists, remove songs from your Library, and edit, delete, reorder and follow playlists that already exist.

## How skips are counted

On a free account you have **6 skips per hour**. These count:

- **Next**.
- Picking a different song from the queue.

These do **not** count: a song ending and the next one starting by itself, and **Previous**.

## What you will see

| When | Message |
|---|---|
| Out of skips | "Subscribe for unlimited skips" |
| Like a song | "Subscribe to like songs" |
| Create a playlist | "Subscribe to create playlists", or "Creating playlists is available with an active plan." |
| Open lyrics | "Subscribe to view lyrics", or "Lyrics are available with an active plan." |
| Guest (not signed in) | "You need an account for this. Creating one is free." |

In the app the messages read "Suscríbete para …" followed by the name of the feature. The locked Settings tabs show **«Contenido Premium»** and a **«Ver Planes»** button; the app shows both in Spanish.

On the web, the Premium notices are a dialog every 12 songs and a pop-up once a day; the pop-up stops appearing after you dismiss it 3 times.

## Basic, Pro and prices

The plans on `music.yammbo.com/pricing` (for example Basic and Pro) unlock exactly the same things. Pro is for people who want to support the development of Yammbo Music. Prices change, so we don't list them here: check `music.yammbo.com/pricing`.

There is no audio-quality selector on the web or in the app, on any plan.

## Next step

To subscribe, see [Plans and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/plans-and-billing/).

en.title: Library and playlists
en.description: Your library on the web - likes, playlists (create, edit, share), following, podcasts and history - what needs a paid plan, and why the web and the Android app don't share a library.
en.body:
What you save on `music.yammbo.com` lives in your account. What you save in the Android app lives **on your phone**: it isn't synced with the web or with other phones. Details at the end of this page.

## Where your library is (web)

Sign in and look at the **"Your Music"** section of the sidebar. It leads to your library, which holds:

- Songs, playlists, albums and artists
- Podcasts you have saved
- Live radio (the shortcut to the stations page)
- History: the page is titled **"Listening history"** and has a search box to look inside it

A guest (no account) doesn't see the library; Music asks you to sign in first.

## Likes and saving to the library

| Action | Free | Paid plan |
|---|---|---|
| Save a song or album to your library | No | Yes |
| Follow an artist (artist page, or artist menu) | No | Yes |
| Remove something from your library | Yes | Yes |
| Save a podcast (bookmark icon on its page) | Yes | Yes |

- On a song: the heart button, or its menu → **"Add to your music"** / **"Remove from your music"**.
- If you try it on a free account you see "Subscribe to like songs". Plans are at `music.yammbo.com/pricing`; see [Free vs paid](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/free-and-paid/).

## Playlists

**Creating** a playlist needs a paid plan. On a free account the dialog says "Creating playlists is available with an active plan." Everything else works on any account.

1. In the **"Playlists"** section of the sidebar, press the **+** button.
2. In **"New playlist"**, fill in **"Name"** and, if you want, **"Description"**.
3. Choose the options:
   - **"Collaborative"** - "Invite other users to add tracks."
   - **"Public"** - "Everyone can see public playlists."
4. Press **"Create"**.

| What you want | How (any account) |
|---|---|
| Add a song | Song menu → **"Add to playlist"** |
| Edit name, description or options | Playlist menu → **"Edit"** → **"Update"** |
| Make it public or private | Playlist menu → **"Make public"** / **"Make private"** |
| Reorder it | Drag the songs into a new order on the playlist page |
| Delete it | Playlist menu → **"Delete playlist"** and confirm |
| Follow someone else's playlist | Playlist menu → **"Follow"** / **"Unfollow"** |

You can also follow other users from their profile.

## Share links

From the menu of a song, album, artist or playlist, choose the **"Copy song link"**, **"Copy album link"**, **"Copy artist link"** or **"Copy playlist link"** option. A public playlist also has **"Share"**. Links of the form `music.yammbo.com/track/...`, `/album/`, `/artist/` and `/playlist/` open the Android app if it is installed.

## What isn't possible

- There is no import of playlists from Spotify or other services on the web.
- Playlists and likes don't move on their own between the web and the app.

## In the Android app

In the app, favourites, playlists and history are saved on the phone, under the **Mi Música** tab (the app keeps that Spanish name in English too): songs, artists, albums, playlists, "On my device" (music stored on the phone) and favourite stations. To move them to another phone, or to keep them if you reinstall, use the backup in **Settings → "Data"** ("Export the database to the external storage" and "Restore from backup"); playlists can also be exported and imported as CSV from their menu. See [Android app features](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/android-app-features/).

Signing out in the app clears the app's local data. Export a backup first if you want to keep it.

Next: [Search, discover and radio](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/search-discover-and-radio/).

en.title: Listening on the web
en.description: How the Yammbo Music web player works - queue, shuffle, repeat, song radio, shortcuts, background playback, what to do when YouTube blocks playback, and how to install it as an app.
en.body:
You listen on the web at `music.yammbo.com`, from any browser on your computer or phone. You need to be signed in: as a guest nothing plays, and Music shows "Sign in or create a free account to listen." See [Create your account](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/create-your-account/).

## The player

The player sits at the bottom of the screen. Songs play through YouTube's own embedded player, so there is no audio quality selector, on the web or in the app.

| Control | What it does |
|---|---|
| **"Queue"** | Shows what plays next. Add songs from a song's menu with **"Add to queue"** |
| Shuffle | **"Enable shuffle"** / **"Disable shuffle"** |
| Repeat | Press it to cycle: repeat the queue, repeat one song, off |
| Next / Previous | On a free account, "Next" counts toward the skip limit. See [Free vs paid](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/free-and-paid/) |

**The music doesn't run out.** When two songs or fewer are left in the queue, Music adds recommendations on its own.

### Song and artist radio

- On a song: open its menu and choose **"Go to song radio"**.
- On an artist: open the artist menu and choose **"Go to artist radio"**.

### Keyboard shortcuts

| Keys | Action |
|---|---|
| Space or `k` | Play / pause |
| `←` / `→` | Back / forward 10 seconds |
| Ctrl or Shift + `←` / `→` | Previous / next song |

The shortcuts don't work while you are typing in a text box. Your keyboard's media keys, headphone buttons and the lock-screen controls also work, as long as the browser is the one holding the audio.

## Background playback

| What you play | With the screen locked or in another tab |
|---|---|
| **Live radio** | Keeps playing. It is plain audio; we haven't tested every browser |
| **Songs** | Don't keep playing. The browser and YouTube don't let an embedded video play in the background |

Use the Android app: it plays with the screen off and has controls on the notification. See [The Android app](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/android-app/). On iPhone and iPad there is no app, so songs only play while the page is open.

## "YouTube is blocking playback"

If two songs in a row are blocked, a dialog titled **"YouTube is blocking playback"** opens. YouTube is asking the connection to confirm it is not a bot. What you can try:

1. If you use a **VPN or proxy**, turn it off or try another network.
2. Press **"Use my YouTube session"**. The player then uses the YouTube account you are signed into in that browser. In Safari, Firefox and Brave the browser may block third-party cookies and stop it from working. The page reloads.
3. On Android, the dialog also offers **"Download the app"**, which doesn't use the browser player.

You can turn the same option on or off whenever you like: user menu (your avatar) → **"Account settings"** → the **"YouTube"** section → switch **"Use my YouTube session from this browser"**. It is per browser, and the page reloads when you change it.

## When a song can't be played

If a song fails, the player tries another version of it and, if that doesn't work, skips to the next one on its own. After three in a row it stops and shows **"Playback stopped: three tracks in a row could not be played. Check your connection and try again."** There is no manual button to report a song.

On an artist or album that few people have played, you may see what is available first and the rest fill in by itself after a few seconds, with the notice "Loading discography…". It isn't an error.

## Install it as an app

| Device | How |
|---|---|
| Windows, macOS, Linux | In **Chrome** or **Edge**, use the browser's install option (the install icon in the address bar, or the browser menu). It installs as "Yammbo Music" and opens in its own window |
| iPhone / iPad | In **Safari**: Share → **Add to Home Screen** |

This is the same website, not a different app. There are no desktop installers. For the real Android app, see [The Android app](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/android-app/).

## Cast to a TV

From Chrome or Edge you can send what's playing to a Chromecast. See [Cast to your TV with Chromecast](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/cast-to-your-tv/).

If something else goes wrong, check [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/troubleshooting/).

en.title: Offline downloads
en.description: How to download songs in the Android app to listen without a connection, how YTDLnis fits in, the Data settings, and where the files end up.
en.body:
Downloads are only in the **Android app** and need a **paid plan**. On the web there are no downloads.

If you try to download without a plan, the app says «Suscríbete para descargar canciones». See [Free vs paid](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/free-and-paid/).

## How it works: the app hands the song to YTDLnis

Yammbo Music doesn't save songs itself. It sends them to **YTDLnis**, a free, open-source downloader that you install separately and that isn't made by Yammbo. YTDLnis downloads the files in the background.

If it isn't installed, the app tells you: **"YTDLnis is not installed"**. From the share sheet it also offers to open YTDLnis's official page on GitHub (button **"Open GitHub"**; the description inside it is in Spanish). While it is missing you can also open the page from **Settings → Data**, in the **"Data saver"** card: the entry **"YTDLnis is not installed"** ("Downloads go through YTDLnis. Tap to open its page and install it").

## Download a song

1. Open the song's share sheet (**"Share"**).
2. Press the **YTDLnis** button.
3. The song's link goes to YTDLnis, which takes over the download.

## Download an album, playlist or artist

In the menu of an album or an artist, choose **"Download all with YTDLnis"**. The same option is in the menu of a song list or playlist, and it sends what's on screen. For collections, the direct send covers up to 50 songs. If there is nothing that can be downloaded, the app says **"Nothing here can be downloaded"**.

## Settings in Data

In **Settings → Data → "Data saver"**:

| Setting | What it does |
|---|---|
| **"Play the downloaded copy"** | If a song is downloaded on the phone, it plays from the file and uses no data |
| **"Download favorites automatically on Wi-Fi"** | On Wi-Fi the app notifies you of favorites not downloaded yet; one tap sends them to YTDLnis. Android doesn't allow doing it without that tap. It needs notification permission, and it is disabled until YTDLnis is installed |
| **"Download pending favorites now (N)"** | Sends the pending favorites right away. It says "Only on Wi-Fi" if you are on mobile data and "No favorites waiting to be downloaded" if there is nothing pending |

While it sends, you see «Sending to YTDLnis: 3 of 20» and, at the end, how many songs were sent. If you leave Wi-Fi it stops («Stopped: you are no longer on Wi-Fi»). Without notification permission the app can't notify you; use the **"Download pending favorites now"** button instead.

The **"App data usage"** card in the same tab shows how much data the app uses. The app's own note: YouTube songs use about 2.5 MB per minute; downloaded ones, nothing.

## Where the files are and how to delete them

The files are managed by YTDLnis and are saved in **its** folder. The app finds them and lists them in **Mi Música → "On my device"**. To delete them, do it from YTDLnis or from your phone's Files app.

A song stored on the phone can't be sent to a TV, so it plays on the phone. See [Cast to your TV](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/cast-to-your-tv/).

## If something doesn't work

See [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/troubleshooting/#android-app). If the problem is inside YTDLnis itself, that app has its own page and support.

en.title: What is Yammbo Music?
en.description: Listen to music, live radio and podcasts on the web and in the Android app. Where it works, how the web and the app differ, and what's free and what isn't.
en.body:
Yammbo Music lets you listen to music at `music.yammbo.com` — in a browser on your computer or phone — and in the native Android app. You get a catalogue of over 100 million songs, live radio from a public directory of stations, and podcasts.

## Where it works

| Your device | How you use it |
|---|---|
| Android phone | The Android app (download it from `music.yammbo.com/download/YammboMusic.apk`; it is not on Google Play) or the web |
| iPhone / iPad | There is no app. Use the web, and add it to your home screen from Safari (Share → Add to Home Screen) |
| Windows, macOS, Linux | In any browser. In Chrome or Edge you can also install it as an app called "Yammbo Music". There are no desktop installers |
| TV | Send it from your phone or computer to a Chromecast or a TV with built-in Chromecast. See [Cast to your TV](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/cast-to-your-tv/) |

## Web vs Android app

| | Web | Android app |
|---|---|---|
| Songs keep playing with the screen off or in another tab | No — the browser doesn't allow it. Live radio does keep playing | Yes, with controls on the notification and lock screen |
| Offline downloads | No | Yes, on a paid plan |
| Cast to a TV | Yes, in Chrome or Edge | Yes |
| Library (likes, playlists, history) | Saved in your account | Saved on your phone; not synced with the web |
| Signing in | Email and password, Google or X | Email and password only |

Details in [Listening on the web](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/listening-on-the-web/) and [The Android app](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/android-app/).

## Your Music account

Yammbo Music has its **own account and its own plan**. It is not the same account as Yammbo Web, POS, Store or Yammbot, even if you use the same email. See [Your Yammbo accounts and signing in](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/account/sign-in/).

Creating one is free. Without an account (as a guest) you can't play anything: Music will ask you to sign in or create a free account.

## Free and paid

With a free account you can listen to the whole catalogue, search, tune into live radio and play podcasts, with ads and a limit on skipping. A paid plan removes the ads and the skip limit and adds likes, playlists, lyrics and, in the app, downloads. See [Free vs paid](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/free-and-paid/).

## Next step

Continue with [Create your account](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/create-your-account/).

en.title: Plans and billing
en.description: How to subscribe to Yammbo Music, pay by card or PayPal, change or cancel your plan, update your payment method, and what to do if you paid and the plan didn't activate.
en.body:
The subscription belongs to your account, so one plan works on the web and in the Android app with the same email and password. What a plan includes is in [Free vs paid](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/free-and-paid/); prices are on `music.yammbo.com/pricing`.

## Subscribe

You can't subscribe or change plan until your email is verified. If you see "Confirm your email to be able to subscribe", follow [Create your account](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/create-your-account/).

1. Sign in and go to `music.yammbo.com/pricing`.
2. Choose a plan.
3. Pay by **card** or with **PayPal**.

The plan renews automatically until you cancel. Charges already made are not refunded, except where the law requires it.

## Manage your plan

Open **"Billing"** at `music.yammbo.com/billing`, or from the user menu (your avatar) once you have a plan. It shows your active plan and these options:

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| **"Change plan"** | Pick another plan and press **"Confirm"** |
| **"Cancel plan"** | Cancels the renewal (see below) |
| **"Change payment method"** | Updates the card or PayPal you pay with |
| **"Payment history"** | Your invoices |

### Cancel and renew

When you cancel, the plan **stays active until the end of the period you already paid** (Music shows the date: "Your plan will be canceled, but is still available until the end of your billing period"). Before that date you can press **"Renew plan"** to keep it. You can cancel without having verified your email.

## I paid but the plan didn't activate

If the payment went through but Music couldn't activate your plan, you see "Your payment went through, but we couldn't activate your subscription", a **"Reference"** and a **"Retry"** button.

1. Press **"Retry"**. Don't pay again.
2. If it still doesn't work, write to support@yammbo.com and include the reference shown on screen.

## From the Android app

1. Open the **«Mi Cuenta»** tab.
2. Without a plan the row is called **«Precios»** ("View available plans"); with a plan it is **"Manage my subscription"** ("Renew, change or cancel your plan"). «Precios» stays in Spanish in the English app.
3. It opens the same pages (plans, or Billing) inside the app. The app opens them with Spanish selected.

The app refreshes your plan status when you sign in and every time you come back to it. If you have just subscribed on the web, open the app again and it will pick it up.

## Next step

Learn how your music is organised in [Library and playlists](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/library-and-playlists/). If something fails, see [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/troubleshooting/).

en.title: Search, discover and radio
en.description: Find music in Yammbo Music - search, artist and album pages, genres, the Discover home page, song and artist radio, live radio with filters, and podcasts.
en.body:
Everything on this page works with a free account. Without an account nothing plays: Music asks you to sign in or create a free account first.

## Search

Type in the search box and Music suggests results while you type. Press Enter to see the full results page, which groups what it finds under **"Top results"** and then by type: songs, albums, artists, playlists, podcasts and profiles.

## Artist and album pages

Open an artist to see their songs and albums, and an album to see its track list.

On an artist or album that few people have played, you may see what is available first, with the notice "Loading discography…" (or "Loading tracks…" on an album). The rest fills in by itself after a few seconds. It isn't an error: just wait.

## Browse

The sidebar on the web has entry points to browse:

| Entry | What you find |
|---|---|
| **"Popular Albums"** | The most listened albums |
| **"Genres"** | Music grouped by genre; open one to see its tracks, albums and what is trending |
| **"Popular songs"** | The most listened songs |
| **"New releases"** | Recent releases |

On a phone, the bottom bar has **Discover** (the home page), **Radio**, **My Music** and **Search**.

## Discover (home page)

The home page is the **"Discover"** page. Besides what you played recently it has sections such as "Recommended Artists" and "Recommended Tracks" (when Music has personalized them for you; otherwise "Top Artists" and "Popular Tracks"), "Because you listened to ..." , "Discover Radio" and "Popular podcasts".

## Song and artist radio

Radio plays an endless queue of similar music, starting from a song or an artist you like.

- On a song: its menu → **"Go to song radio"**.
- On an artist: the artist menu → **"Go to artist radio"**.

On the web, the player also adds recommendations by itself when the queue is nearly empty. See [Listening on the web](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/listening-on-the-web/).

## Live radio

**"Live Radio"** (under **"Your Music"** in the sidebar, and the **Radio** button on the phone's bottom bar) lists thousands of stations from a public directory. In the Android app, the same thing is the **Radio** tab.

On the web you can narrow the list. The filters stack, so you can combine them:

- The search box, **"Search radio stations..."**
- By **genre**, by **country** and by **language**
- A sort order: **"Most listened"**, **"Top rated"**, **"Best quality"** or **"Name (A-Z)"**
- **"Clear filters"** and **"Load more"** to see more stations

Press a station to play it. Stations that can't play in a browser are left out of the list. Stations don't count toward your history or likes.

Some free stations include their own advertising, sometimes depending on your country, so it can even be in another language. It comes from the station, not from Yammbo, and a paid plan doesn't remove it.

If the stations don't load you see "Could not reach the radio directory. Please try again." Try again in a moment.

In the app, your favourite stations are kept under **Mi Música**.

## Podcasts

Podcasts have their own section: **"Podcasts"** under **"Your Music"**, "Popular podcasts" on the home page, and a "Podcasts" group in the search results. Open a podcast to see its episodes, and press the bookmark icon to save it; saved podcasts appear in **"Your podcasts"**. Listening and saving podcasts is free.

Next: [The Android app](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/android-app/).

en.title: Signing in
en.description: How to sign in to Yammbo Music on the web and in the Android app, what to do if you forgot your password, two-factor codes, and how to sign out.
en.body:
Your Yammbo Music email and password only work in Music. Your accounts for Web, POS, Store or Yammbot are separate, even with the same email. See [Your Yammbo accounts and signing in](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/account/sign-in/). If you don't have a Music account yet, [create one](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/create-your-account/).

## Sign in on the web

1. Go to `music.yammbo.com/login` ("Sign in to your account").
2. Type your **"Email"** and **"Password"** and press **"Continue"**. Or, under **"Or sign in with"**, press the button with the **Google** logo or the one with the **X** logo.
3. Tick **"Stay signed in for a month"** if you don't want to sign in again on that browser for a month.

### Link Google or X to an account you already have

If an account with that email already exists and you sign in with Google or X, Music shows **"Password required"**: enter the password of the existing account and press **"Connect"**. From then on you can use either way. The accounts linked to yours are listed in **"Account settings"** (see [Account settings](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/account-settings/)).

## Forgot your password?

1. On the sign-in page, press **"Forgot your password?"** (or open `music.yammbo.com/forgot-password`).
2. Type your email and press **"Continue"**. You receive a link by email.
3. Open the link, type a **"New password"**, repeat it in **"Confirm password"** and press **"Reset password"**.

This is also how you create a password if you signed up with Google or X and now want to use the app.

## Sign in on the Android app

The app asks you to sign in when you open it, with the same account as `music.yammbo.com`.

- It only accepts **email and password**: there is no Google or X button.
- If you created your account with Google or X, press **"Forgot Password?"** on the sign-in screen. It opens the web page where you create a password.
- The app's sign-in screen only asks for email and password; there is no field for a two-factor code.

## Two-factor authentication

If you turned it on in **"Account settings"**, after your password the web asks for the code from your authenticator app. If you lost your phone, press **"Use recovery code instead"** and type a **"Recovery code"**. You set it up in [Account settings](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/account-settings/).

## Sign out and active sessions

| Where | How |
|---|---|
| Web | User menu (your avatar) → **"Log out"** |
| Web, all other devices | **"Account settings"** → **"Active sessions"** → **"Logout other sessions"**. Your current browser is marked **"This device"** |
| Android app | **«Mi Cuenta»** tab → **«Cerrar sesión»** (the app shows both labels in Spanish; it asks you to confirm). Signing out deletes the data the app keeps on the phone |

In the app, favourites, playlists and history live on the phone. Before signing out, make a backup: **Settings → Data**. See [Android app features](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/android-app-features/).

If you can't get in, see [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/troubleshooting/).

en.title: Troubleshooting
en.description: Messages you may see in Yammbo Music, on the web and in the Android app, what causes them and what to do, organized by area.
en.body:
Find the area where the problem happens, then look for the message you see. Where a message exists in Spanish too, both versions are given. If your problem isn't here, jump to [Still stuck?](#still-stuck) at the end.

## Web playback

| Message | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| "Sign in or create a free account to listen." | You are browsing as a guest. A guest can't listen | Sign in or create a free account. See [Create your account](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/create-your-account/) |
| "YouTube is blocking playback" («YouTube está bloqueando la reproducción») | YouTube asked this connection to confirm it isn't a bot, so songs can't play for now. It appears after two songs in a row get this block | Turn off your VPN or proxy, or try another network, and press play again. If it persists, try **"Use my YouTube session"** (it uses the YouTube session of that browser; in Safari, Firefox and Brave third-party cookies can prevent it). On Android, the dialog offers **"Download the app"** |
| «Playback stopped: three tracks in a row could not be played. Check your connection and try again.» | Three songs in a row couldn't be played | Check your connection and press play again |
| A song fails and the next one starts by itself | The player tried another version of the song and, if that failed too, skipped it | Nothing to do. There is no manual "report song" button |
| An artist or album shows only part of its content at first | The first visit to a little-played artist or album can show what's there first and fill in a few seconds later | Wait a few seconds |
| Songs stop when you switch tabs or lock the screen | The browser and YouTube don't let an embedded video play in the background | Use the Android app. See [The Android app](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/android-app/) |

## Account and verification

| Message | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| "These credentials do not match our records." | Wrong email or password | Check both. Use **"Forgot your password?"** to get a reset link by email |
| "Too Many Attempts." | 5 failed attempts in a minute with the same email | Wait a minute and try again |
| "Confirm your email to be able to subscribe" | Your email isn't verified. Without verifying you can listen, but you can't subscribe, change plan, comment, edit your profile or delete your account | Enter the 6-digit code that arrives by email (it expires after 30 minutes). If you didn't get it, use the **request a resend** link on that page, and check spam and promotions |
| "The security code you entered is invalid or has expired" | The code is wrong or older than 30 minutes | Ask for a new code and use the latest one |
| You signed up with Google or X and the password doesn't work | That account has no password yet | Sign in with the same Google or X button, or use **"Forgot your password?"** to create one |

Accounts created with Google or X are already verified. See [Signing in](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/signing-in/).

## Plan and payments

| Message | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| "Your payment went through, but we couldn't activate your subscription" | The payment was received but the plan didn't activate. The screen shows a "Reference" | Press **"Retry"**. If it still fails, write to support@yammbo.com with that reference |
| I subscribed but the app still shows a free plan | The app refreshes your plan when you sign in and every time you come back to it | Close the app, open it again and wait a moment. If it doesn't change, back up first (**Settings → Data → "Save to backup"**), then sign out and in |
| A feature says «Suscríbete para …» | That feature needs a paid plan | See [Free vs paid](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/free-and-paid/) |

To manage or cancel a plan, see [Plans and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/plans-and-billing/).

## Android app

| Message | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| Android refuses to install the update over the old app | The installed copy is usually signed differently | Make a backup first (**Settings → Data → "BACKUP AND RESTORE" → "Save to backup"**), uninstall, install the latest APK and restore. See [The Android app](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/android-app/#app-not-installed-or-android-wont-install-over-the-old-one) |
| «Ha ocurrido un error de conexión» ("A network error has occurred") | The connection dropped | Check your connection and try again |
| «No se pudo encontrar un formato de audio compatible» ("Couldn't find a playable audio format") | No playable audio for that song | Try another song; if all fail, update the app |
| «La fuente del vídeo original de esta canción ha sido eliminada» | The original video was removed | That song can't be played; choose another version |
| «Esta canción no puede ser reproducida debido a restricciones del servidor» | The source restricts that song | Choose another version of the song |
| «Ha ocurrido un error de reproducción desconocido» | Unknown playback error | Try again; if it repeats, contact support with the exact message |
| «Suscríbete para descargar canciones» | Downloads need a paid plan | See [Offline downloads](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/offline-downloads/) |
| "YTDLnis is not installed" | Downloads are handed to YTDLnis, which isn't installed | Install it from its official page. See [Offline downloads](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/offline-downloads/) |
| Playback cuts out or the notification disappears | Android's battery optimization stops the player | Android **Settings → Apps → Yammbo Music → Battery → Unrestricted**. See [What the app can do](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/android-app-features/#battery) |
| You can't sign in with Google or X in the app | The app only accepts email and password | Create a password with **"Forgot Password?"** and use it. See [The Android app](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/android-app/#first-start) |
| The app warns you about a VPN when registering | The plan Yammbo gives in some countries is decided by your real country | Turn the VPN off and register again |
| Settings show «Contenido Premium» | Four Settings tabs need a paid plan | See [What the app can do](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/android-app-features/#settings-that-need-a-paid-plan) |

The app can also move on by itself when a song fails: turn on **"Skip song on error"** in **Settings → General** (a tab that needs a paid plan).

## Chromecast

| Message | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| No cast button on the web | Casting from the web works only in Chrome or Edge on a computer, or in the maximized player. It doesn't appear in Firefox, Safari, iPhone or iPad, or in the phone's mini player | Use Chrome or Edge, or cast from the Android app |
| No cast button in the app | The button needs Google Play Services on the phone | Check that your phone has it |
| The TV doesn't show up | Your phone or computer and the TV aren't on the same Wi-Fi | Connect both to the same network |
| «El TV no está reproduciendo esta canción, así que el sonido vuelve al teléfono» ("The TV is not playing this song, so the sound comes back to the phone") | The TV didn't start the song | Try again or choose another song |
| «Una canción guardada en el teléfono no se puede enviar al TV, así que suena aquí» | A song stored on the phone can't be cast | Pick the same song from the catalogue |
| YouTube error 101 or 150 | The person who uploaded the song doesn't allow it to play on a TV | Choose another version of the song |
| YouTube error 100 | The song is no longer on YouTube | Choose another song |

See [Cast to your TV](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/cast-to-your-tv/).

## Live radio

| Message | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| "Could not reach the radio directory. Please try again." (it appears untranslated) | The public station directory didn't answer | Try again in a moment |
| An ad plays in another language | Some free stations insert their own ads depending on your country. It comes from the station, not from Yammbo | Choose another station |
| A station is missing | Stations that can't play in a browser are left out of the web list | Search for another one, or try it in the app |

## Worth knowing

- **Web and app don't share a library.** In the app, favorites, playlists and history live on the phone. Use a backup to move them. See [Library and playlists](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/library-and-playlists/).
- **Signing out of the app erases its local data.** Make a backup first.
- **Live radio plays in the background in a browser; songs don't.**
- **The app isn't on Google Play and there is no iPhone app.**
- **You can't change your email from your account.** Write to support@yammbo.com.
- **Deleting your account** is immediate and irreversible, and it's done on the web, not in the app, and not while a plan is active.

## Still stuck?

Write to **support@yammbo.com** and tell us what you expected to happen, what happened instead, and the exact message you saw. If your payment went through but the plan didn't activate, include the reference shown on screen. You can also use the contact page at `music.yammbo.com/contact`, or the error report in the app.

en.title: Backups and Google Sheets
en.description: Turn on the daily backup to Google Drive, export a copy to a file, restore your data and send your sales to a Google Sheet.
en.body:
Your sales, your inventory, your customer accounts and your shifts are saved **on the tablet**. If the tablet is lost or damaged without a backup, they are lost. Turn the backup on the first day.

## Daily backup to Google Drive

1. Open **Settings > Backups**.
2. Tap **"Connect Google Drive"** and choose your Google account.
3. Leave **"Automatic daily copy"** turned on. It runs at around 3:00 in the morning.

The copy goes to a **private app folder** in your Drive: nobody else sees it, not even you from the browser. **30 days** of copies are kept. With several tablets, only one makes the location's backup.

Other buttons:

- **"Back up now"**: before a big change.
- **"Export a copy to a file"**: a file you save wherever you want.
- **"Change account"** or **"Disconnect Google Drive"**.

## Restore

Restoring **erases all the current data** on the tablet and puts in the data from the backup. It asks for the owner's PIN and the app restarts.

- **On a tablet you already use**: **Settings > Backups > "See copies in Google Drive"** or **"Restore from a file"**.
- **On a new tablet**: on the first screen choose **"Restore a backup"**.

If the backup is from another tablet that is still in use, the app asks whether you want to **"Replace the device of the backup"** or **"Use a new number"**. Choose a new number if both tablets are going to keep working.

## My data in Google (Google Sheets)

Copy your data to a **Google Sheet** in your Drive to see it on the computer or to make free charts with Looker Studio.

1. Open **Settings > My data in Google**.
2. Tap **"Connect my data in Google"** and choose your account.
3. The register creates the sheet and keeps filling it with your **sales**, the **products sold**, the **inventory**, the **customers** and the **shift closes**.

Buttons: **"Export now"**, **"Open sheet"**, **"Change account"** and **"Disconnect"**. You need to be the owner or have the Settings permission.

Only **one register** writes to the sheet. If you want another one to write, tap **"Write from this register"** on it.

If you delete the sheet or one of its tabs in Google, the register stops sending data and warns **"The sheet or a tab was deleted in Google"**. Tap **"Create again"** so it builds it again.

The sheet is not a backup: to recover the register use the Google Drive backup.

en.title: Create your account
en.description: Create your Yammbo POS account from pos.yammbo.com or from the tablet, confirm your email and set up your business in six steps.
en.body:
You can create your account in the browser or directly on the tablet. Both paths end the same way: an active business with a **30-day free trial** and you as the owner. You do not wait for any approval.

## Option 1: from pos.yammbo.com

1. Open [pos.yammbo.com](https://pos.yammbo.com/dashboard/login) and tap **"Sign up"**.
2. Enter **"Your name"**, your **"Email"** and a **"Password"** of **10 characters or more**. Tap **"Create account"**.
3. You receive an email with a **6-digit code** ("Your Yammbo POS code"). It expires in **30 minutes**. Enter it in **"Code"**. If it did not arrive, tap **"Send another code"** or check your spam folder. The email also has a link that confirms the account.
4. Follow the **"Set up your business"** wizard (below).

The account is only created when you confirm the email.

### The six-step wizard

| Step | What it asks for |
|---|---|
| **1. About you** | Your name, your country and **"Your phone"** (required) |
| **2. Your business** | **"Business name"**, **"Business country"**, **"Type of business"** (Restaurant or Store), the category (restaurants only), a short description, the business phone and the WhatsApp number for orders (optional) |
| **3. Taxes and service** | The tax percentage, whether it is already included in prices or added on top, and the service charge. They come suggested for your country |
| **4. Address** | The name of the location (for example "Main"), the address, a landmark, the city, the time zone and, if you want, the point on the map with **"Use my current location"** |
| **5. Opening hours** | Opens and closes for each day, or **"Closed"** |
| **6. Logo** | A square image of at least 512 × 512 px, in JPG, PNG or WebP |

Tap **"Finish"** and your business is active.

The **business country** sets the currency and the time zone, and the **business type** decides how your register is set up. Neither of them can be changed later on the web.

## Option 2: from the tablet

1. [Install the app](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/install-and-link/) and open it. Choose **"Register (charge and sell)"**.
2. Under **"Where is your account?"** choose **"Yammbo POS (restaurants or shops)"**. Another option is selected by default: change it before you continue.
3. Tap **"Create account"**, enter your email and tap **"Continue"**. Enter the 6-digit code you received (it is valid for 30 minutes).
4. Fill in **"Create your business on Yammbo POS"**:
   - **"Your name"**.
   - **"Business name"**, **"Country"**, **"Type of business"** and **"Business phone"** (6 to 15 digits).
   - **"Address"** and **"City"**. In Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua and Panama it also asks for a **"Landmark"**.
   - A **"Password"** of 10 characters or more, to also sign in to pos.yammbo.com.
5. Tap **"Create my business"**. The tablet links itself and asks you to [create your owner PIN](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/install-and-link/#your-owner-pin).

You complete the opening hours, the logo and the rest of the details later in the web dashboard.

## The free trial

- It lasts **30 days** from when you create the business. During the trial you have everything, including online ordering.
- It is **one per email**. If that email already had a Yammbo POS trial, the new business starts by asking for payment.
- To continue after the trial, choose a plan. See [Plan and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/plan-and-billing/).

## If you forget your password

On the sign-in page tap **"Forgot my password"**, enter your email and tap **"Send code"**. Enter the code and your new password. When you change it, all your open sessions are closed.

On the tablet no password is used: you sign in with a code that arrives in your email and then with your PIN.

## Limits

- Up to 5 new businesses per person every 24 hours.
- The browser session lasts 30 days.

en.title: Customers, store credit, gift cards and layaways
en.description: Save your customers, give them points, sell to them on credit, collect payments, sell gift cards and handle layaways.
en.body:
The **Customers** section has four tabs: **Customers**, **Accounts**, **Gift cards** and **Layaways**. The last three need the **"Accounts and gift cards"** permission and appear when you turn on each feature in **Settings > Customer accounts**. Layaways also need store credit to be turned on.

## Customers

- **"Add customer"** with name, phone and email. They are also saved automatically when you take payment if you leave **"Save as customer"** checked.
- Sort by **Name**, **Last visit** or **Top spenders**.
- Each customer shows what they have spent and their **"Latest orders"**.
- **Points**: if you use points, the customer earns them when buying and uses them at the register. **"Adjust points"** corrects them by hand.
- **"Price group"**: special prices for that customer.

Customers are shared with the web dashboard, where you can also import and export them as CSV.

### The phone number

Enter the local number with all its digits or with the country code (**+**). If a digit is missing, the app warns **"The phone number is not valid"**. The default country code is changed in **Settings > Business**.

## Accounts (store credit)

To sell on credit:

1. In **Accounts** tap **"Add account"** and choose the customer. Set a **"Credit limit"** (empty = no limit).
2. When taking payment, choose **"Customer account"**. The app shows what they **Owe**, the **Store credit** and the **Limit**. If it goes over the limit, it asks for a manager's PIN.
3. When they pay, tap **"Record payment"**.

At the top you see **Receivable**, how many customers have debt, how many are **over 60 days** and the credit balances. Debts are grouped by age: 0 to 30, 31 to 60 and over 60 days.

From the account you can **"Remind by WhatsApp"** or **"Share statement"**. **"Adjust balance"** corrects the balance with a reason.

Cash payments received go into the shift and appear in the Z close.

## Gift cards

1. In **Gift cards** tap **"Sell gift card"**.
2. Enter the **"Card amount"** and the **"Valid for days"** (empty = does not expire).
3. Take payment for the card. You can **"Print card"** with its code.

To use it, choose **"Gift card"** when taking payment and enter or scan the code. **"Look up"** shows the balance. **"Turn off"** blocks it if it was lost.

## Layaways

1. When taking payment choose **"Layaway (deposit now, rest later)"** and take the deposit.
2. In **Layaways** you see what is left on each one. Tap **"Add payment"** when the customer pays another part.
3. When they finish paying, tap **"Hand over"**.

Only the owner can hand over a layaway that is not fully paid.

Accounts, gift cards and layaways live on the tablet and in your backups, not in the web dashboard.

en.title: Frequently asked questions
en.description: Short answers about devices, internet, data, prices, payments and daily use of Yammbo POS.
en.body:
## Devices

**What devices does it work on?**
On **Android 7 or higher** tablets and phones. There is no version for iPhone, iPad or Windows. The web dashboard works in any browser.

**Which printer should I buy?**
An **ESC/POS** thermal printer, 58 or 80 mm, by Bluetooth, USB or network. See [Printers and hardware](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/printers-and-hardware/).

**Can I use a barcode reader?**
Yes, a USB or Bluetooth one that types like a keyboard, or the tablet's camera.

**How many tablets can I have?**
As many as you need on the same plan. See [Multiple tablets](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/multiple-tablets/).

## Internet

**Does it work without internet?**
Yes. Once linked, the register sells, takes payments in cash, by card or by transfer, prints, opens and closes shifts, and handles tables, kitchen and inventory without internet.

**What needs internet?**
The first start, paying the plan, payments by link or QR, sending receipts by email, online orders, the Google Drive backup, the Google Sheet, updates and menu and employee changes with the web.

**Do multiple tablets need internet to sync?**
No: they share data over the location's Wi-Fi.

## Data

**Where are my sales?**
On the tablet. That is why it is important to turn on the [daily backup to Google Drive](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/backups-and-google-sheets/).

**Why don't I see the register sales in the web dashboard?**
The dashboard reports count the online orders. Register sales are in **Reports** in the app and, if you turn it on, in your Google Sheet.

**Can I bring my products from Loyverse or Kyte?**
Yes. Export your catalog as CSV and import it in **Menu > Import and export**. See [Menu or catalog](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/menu-and-catalog/#import-and-export).

**What happens if my tablet breaks?**
Install the app on another one and choose **"Restore a backup"** on the first screen.

## Prices and payments

**How much does it cost?**
**Starter $60 a month** (the register) or **Business $90 a month** (the register with online ordering, coupons and reviews), with a 30-day free trial. See [Plan and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/plan-and-billing/).

**Can I take card payments?**
Yes, with your card terminal (you record the payment in the register) or with a link or QR through your Stripe, PayPal, Mercado Pago, Pagadito or Tilopay account.

**Does it issue a fiscal invoice?**
It can number receipts with your series and your authorization in **Settings > Fiscal invoice**. It does not connect to any country's tax office: confirm with your accountant whether it works for you.

## Daily use
