**Why can't I take payments?**
The shift has not been opened on that tablet. See [Shift and close](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/shift-and-close/).

**Can I change from restaurant to store?**
The type is chosen when the business is created and cannot be changed from the web. Write to us from **Support** if you need to change it.

**Is the app available in English?**
Yes. Change it in **Settings > This device > "App language"**. The language of receipts is separate, in **Settings > Business > "Customer language"**.

en.title: Install the app and link the tablet
en.description: Download Yammbo POS, choose what the tablet is for, sign in with your account or with a code from the dashboard and create your owner PIN.
en.body:
## What you need

- An **Android 7 or higher** tablet or phone. On a tablet the register is more comfortable, with the menu on the left.
- **Internet** for this first start. After that the register works without internet.
- Your [Yammbo POS account](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/create-your-account/), or create it on the same tablet.

## Download and install

1. On the tablet open [pos.yammbo.com](https://pos.yammbo.com/dashboard/login) and tap **"Download Yammbo POS"**. The link always downloads the latest version. It is also in the dashboard, under **Devices**.
2. Open the downloaded file. If Android says it does not allow installing apps from that source, tap **Settings**, turn on the permission for the browser and come back.
3. Tap **Install** and then **Open**.

The app updates itself from inside. See [Update the app](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/update-the-app/).

## "What is this tablet for?"

The first screen offers four options:

| Option | When to use it |
|---|---|
| **"Register (charge and sell)"** | The main tablet of the business. It links with your account |
| **"Join an existing business"** | Another tablet in the same location that copies the register data over Wi-Fi. See [Multiple tablets](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/multiple-tablets/) |
| **"Customer screen for another register"** | A tablet that only shows the sale to the customer |
| **"Restore a backup"** | Start with the data of a business you already used, from Google Drive or from a file |

## Link with your account

1. Choose **"Register (charge and sell)"**.
2. Under **"Where is your account?"** choose **"Yammbo POS (restaurants or shops)"**.

**Yammbo Food** is selected by default. If you do not change it to **Yammbo POS**, the app looks for your account somewhere else and does not find it.

3. Enter the **"Account e-mail"** and tap **"Send code"**. If you do not have an account yet, tap **"Create account"** (see [Create your account](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/create-your-account/#option-2-from-the-tablet)).
4. Enter the **"6-digit code"** that arrived in your email (valid for 30 minutes) and tap **"Continue"**.
   - **"Resend code"** becomes available after a few seconds.
   - **"Change e-mail"** lets you correct the email.
5. If your account has several businesses or locations, choose the business and the location.
6. Under **"Name of this register"** keep the suggested name or enter your own.
7. Tap **"Link this register"**.

On the tablet **no password is used**: you sign in with the code from the email and then with your PIN.

## Link with a code from the dashboard

Use this if you prefer not to type your email on the tablet.

1. In the web dashboard open **Devices** and tap **"Link device"**. If you have several locations, choose the location first.
2. A 6-digit code appears with its countdown.
3. On the tablet tap **"I have a 6-digit code from the dashboard"**.
4. Enter the address or the name of your business on pos.yammbo.com, the **"6-digit code"** and the **"Name of this register"**. Tap **"Link"**.

Code rules:

- It is valid for **5 minutes** and can be used **only once**.
- Generating a new one cancels the previous one.
- Each code belongs to **one location**, and the tablet stays tied to it.
- If you see **"The code expired. Generate a new one."**, tap **"Link device"** again.

To generate codes there must be an active employee with the **Owner** role. If the button is turned off, create one in **Team > POS employees**.

## Your owner PIN

If you created the business from the tablet, or your account has no employees yet, the app asks you to **"Create your owner PIN"**:

1. Enter **"Your PIN"** (4 to 6 digits) with the on-screen keypad.
2. Repeat it in **"Repeat your PIN"**.
3. Tap **"Open the register"**.

If you already have employees in the web dashboard, the tablet downloads them: you sign in with the PIN each one has on the web.

From then on, every time you open the app you will see **"Enter your PIN"**. See [Staff and roles](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/staff-and-roles/).

## First steps

The owner sees the **"First steps"** list with 8 tasks: the business details, your first product, the printer, the payment methods, opening the shift, your first sale, adding an employee and turning on the backup. They are checked off by themselves. Tap **"Hide"** if you do not want to see it.

## Common errors

| Message | What to do |
|---|---|
| "Your account has no business you can link" | Finish the wizard on pos.yammbo.com, or tap **"Create account"** to create the business from the tablet |
| The email code does not arrive | Check spam and that you chose **Yammbo POS** under "Where is your account?" |
| It asks you to create an employee with the Owner role | Tap **"Open employees on the web"** and create it in **Team** |
| "The code expired" | Generate a new one in **Devices** |

More cases in [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/troubleshooting/).

en.title: Inventory
en.description: Track stock, receive goods, record waste, do counts, keep suppliers and purchases, and review the value of your inventory.
en.body:
The **Inventory** section is on the tablet. For a product to deduct stock when it is sold, turn on **"Track stock"** for it in [Menu or catalog](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/menu-and-catalog/).

## Tabs

| Tab | What it is for |
|---|---|
| **Stock** | How much there is of each product or supply |
| **Suppliers** | Who you buy from |
| **Purchases** | Orders to suppliers and what you receive |
| **Count** | Count the physical inventory and correct differences |
| **Movements** | Everything that came in and went out, with its reason |
| **Valuation** | How much your inventory is worth at cost. It needs the **"See costs"** permission |
| **Payables** | What you owe suppliers. It is turned on in **Settings > Advanced inventory** |
| **Production** | Prepare supplies or products from others. It is turned on in **Settings > Advanced inventory** |

## Actions on a product

In **Stock** tap a product:

- **"Adjust"**: corrects the quantity.
- **"Receive goods"**: adds what arrived.
- **"Count"**: records what you counted.
- **"Log waste"** (in stores, **"Log write-off"**): takes out what was lost, with its reason.
- **"Transfer between areas"**: if you use areas (storeroom, kitchen, bar).

The waste reasons are Expired, Spoiled, Damaged, Spilled, Theft, Comped, Staff meal or Other. In stores they change to Expired, Deteriorated, Damaged, Broken or spilled, Theft or shortage, Giveaway, Staff use or Other.

## Do a count

1. In **Count** tap **"New count"**. With **"Blind count"** the person counting does not see the expected quantity.
2. Record what there is of each product.
3. Review the **"Count variances"**.
4. Tap **"Apply count"**. For what you did not count, choose **"Leave them as they are"** or **"Set them to zero"**.

You can also schedule periodic counts under **"Scheduled counts"**.

## Recipes and supplies

If a product is made from supplies (flour, cheese, cups), add its **Recipe** on the product. When it is sold, the supplies are deducted. Mark as **"It is a supply"** anything that is not sold on its own. Modifiers can also deduct supplies.

## Low stock alerts

If you set **"Warn when this many are left"** on a product, the app warns you when it drops below that quantity.

## Advanced inventory

In **Settings > Advanced inventory** you turn on areas, costs, supplier payables, production and automatic sold-out marking.

## Inventory reports

In [Reports](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/reports/) you have, depending on your permissions, the theoretical and actual cost of goods sold, the ABC analysis, sell-through and dead stock, margin by category and supplier balances.

Inventory lives on the tablet and in your backups. If you have [multiple tablets](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/multiple-tablets/), it is shared between them over Wi-Fi.

en.title: Kitchen screen
en.description: Use a tablet as a kitchen or bar screen, filter by station, mark dishes as ready, track times and manage sold-out items.
en.body:
Stores do not have a kitchen. A restaurant can turn it off in **Settings > Sales and taxes > Features**.

The **Kitchen** section shows the orders sent from the register or the tables. You can use it on the same tablet as the register or on a separate tablet in the kitchen.

## Stations

Each product or category can go to a **station** (for example **Kitchen** and **Bar**, which come already created). They are set up in **Menu > Stations** and, on each product, in **"Preparation station"**. A product that is not prepared goes under **"Not prepared"**.

## Use a tablet only for the kitchen

1. On the kitchen tablet, [join it to the location](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/multiple-tablets/).
2. Open **Settings > Location and devices > What this device is for** and choose **"Kitchen or bar"**.
3. Under **"Stations of this device"** check the ones it should show. If you check none, it shows all of them.
4. If you want staff to get in without a PIN, turn on **"Enter without a PIN"**: the sign-in screen shows **"Enter kitchen"**.

The kitchen tablet opens straight on Kitchen, keeps the screen on and does not lock by itself.

## Work the orders

- The **"Preparing"** and **"Ready"** tabs show how many there are.
- The station chips filter. **"All"** shows everything.
- Tap **"All ready"** when the order is finished. **"Delivered"** takes it off the list. **"Undo"** reverts the last step.
- Allergies are highlighted as **"Allergy: …"**.
- Dishes served in courses show the course number.
- **"Sound"** turns the new order alert on or off.

At the top you see **Pending**, **Late**, the **Longest wait** and the **Average prep time today** against your goal in minutes. The goals are adjusted in **Settings > Kitchen** and, on each product, with **"Target prep time"**.

## Sold out

In the **"Sold out"** strip you mark a product with **"Mark sold out"** and it can no longer be sold. **"Put back on sale"** turns it back on.

## No screen: printed orders

If you prefer paper, set up a kitchen printer and assign its stations. See [Printers and hardware](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/printers-and-hardware/).

en.title: Menu or catalog
en.description: Create products, variants, combos, modifiers, categories and stations; import from CSV, Loyverse or Kyte and print labels.
en.body:
In a restaurant the section is called **Menu**; in a store, **Catalog**. It works the same in both. You can edit it on the tablet or in the web dashboard, under **Menu**: changes are synced between the two.

## Tabs

**Products**, **Categories**, **Modifiers**, **Stations** and, in restaurants, **Tables**. In the three-dot menu are **"Import and export"**, **"Duplicates"** and **"Print labels"**.

## Create a product

Tap **"New product"** and fill in what you need:

| Field | What it is for |
|---|---|
| **Name** and **Price** | The basics. The price is in your currency |
| **Description** | Shown on your online page |
| **"Sold by"** | Each, Kilogram, Pound, Gram or Ounce. With weight, the price is per that unit |
| **Type** | **Item** or **Combo**. It cannot be changed after it is created |
| **Category** | Choose one or create one with **"New category"** |
| **"Barcode"** | Type it or tap **"Scan"** |
| **Photo** | **"Take photo"** or **"Choose from gallery"** |
| **"Preparation station"** | Which kitchen or bar it goes to. **"Not prepared"** if it does not go through the kitchen |
| **"Variants"** | Sizes or presentations. If you leave the price empty, it uses the product's price |
| **"Product modifiers"** | The groups of options offered with it |
| **"Stock"** | **"Track stock"** and **"Warn when this many are left"** (a quantity) |
| **Cost** and **Recipe** | The cost, or the supplies it uses up. Check **"It is a supply"** on anything that is only used as an ingredient |
| **"Schedule"** | The hours when it is sold, by day |
| **"Taxes"** | **General tax**, **Exempt** or your own taxes |
| **Active** | Turn it off to hide it without deleting it |

To delete a product tap delete and tap again to confirm. If it already has sales, it is deactivated instead of deleted.

## Combos

A combo has **"Combo groups"**, each with its minimum and maximum number of choices (for example, "choose a drink"). Tap **"Add component"** to add products, with an **"Extra"** price if they cost more. A new combo is created **inactive**: turn it on when it is ready.

## Modifiers

Tap **"New modifier group"**, give it a name, add its **"Options"** with their **"Extra"** price and set how many can be chosen. **"Stock effect"** deducts supplies if you use recipes.

## Categories and stations

- Each category can have its **"Default station"** and its schedule. **"Apply to the products in this category"** sets it on all of them.
- The stations come created as **Kitchen** and **Bar**. Add more with **"Add station"**.

## Import and export

In **"Import and export"**:

1. Tap **"Import"** and choose a CSV file. Files exported from **Loyverse** and **Kyte** are recognized, and so is any CSV made in Excel or Google Sheets.
2. Under **"Review before importing"** check what is going to be created.
3. Choose **"Update the ones that already exist"** or **"Create all as new"**.

**"Export to CSV"** downloads your whole catalog. **"Duplicates"** looks for repeated products or barcodes.

## Labels

**"Print labels"** prints labels with the name, the price and the barcode on your receipt printer. Search for or scan the products, choose the **"Copies"** and tap **"Print"**. If a product has no code, it comes out with just the name and price; you can turn on **"Use the sku as the code when there is no barcode"** and **"Print the business name"**. The barcode is printed if it fits the paper width.

## If you already had a menu on the web

If, when you link the tablet, there is already a menu in the dashboard and another one on the tablet, the app asks which one to keep: **"Use the web menu"** or **"Upload this register's menu"**.

To take a product off just for today, do not deactivate it: mark it **"Sold out"** from the register or from the [kitchen](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/kitchen/). You need the **"Mark sold out"** permission.

en.title: Multiple tablets in the same location
en.description: Add a second register, a kitchen tablet or a waiter's phone that share data over Wi-Fi, and resolve conflicts between registers.
en.body:
You can have several tablets or phones in the same location: another register, a kitchen screen, a waiter's phone or a screen for the customer. They share sales, tables, inventory and customers **over the location's Wi-Fi**, without needing internet.

## Add a tablet to the location

1. On the tablet that already has the business, open **Settings > Location and devices > Devices of the business** and tap **"Add device"**. A code appears.
2. On the new tablet, install the app and choose **"Join an existing business"**. Enter the code.
3. Wait for **"Copying the business data"** to finish. If it is interrupted, it continues where it left off.
4. On the new tablet, choose its role under **"What this device is for"**: **Register**, **Kitchen or bar** or **Waiter**.

When it joins, the new tablet **erases everything it had** and copies the location's data. Do not do this on a tablet that already has its own sales.

Both tablets must be on the **same Wi-Fi network**.

## Each tablet keeps its own

- **Its shift and its cash**: each register opens and closes its own shift.
- **Its printers**: set them up on each one.
- **Its receipt prefix**: each tablet needs a different one (T01, T02). If two match, the app fixes it by itself within seconds.
- **Its fiscal invoice number**: if you use fiscal invoices, give each tablet a different series prefix.

## The same version on all of them

All the tablets in the location must have **the same version of the app**. If not, you will see **"The other register runs another version of the app. Update both to the same version."** When an update comes out, update all of them the same day. See [Update the app](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/update-the-app/).

If a tablet stayed on an old version and can no longer sync, the app tells you to remove it from the location and join it again.

## Conflicts between registers

If two tablets do something that clashes while they were disconnected from each other (a double payment, a table with two tabs, a repeated phone number, barcode or PIN, a gift card overspent), the app **does not decide on its own**. You will see it in **Settings > Location and devices > "Conflicts between registers"**. Review each case and tap **"Mark as reviewed"** or, if they are two tabs of the same table, **"Merge tabs"**.

## Remove a tablet

In **Devices of the business** tap **"Remove"** on the tablet. It stops syncing. If it had sales that were not passed on, on that tablet you can **"Export unsynced sales"** before erasing it.

## Customer screen

A tablet that only shows the sale to the customer does not copy data: it is linked separately under **Tablets connected over Wi-Fi**. See [Printers and hardware](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/printers-and-hardware/#customer-screen).

## Multiple locations

Each location is separate: its tablets are linked with a code from **that location** from the web dashboard, under **Devices**. See [Install and link](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/install-and-link/#link-with-a-code-from-the-dashboard).

en.title: Online ordering
en.description: Turn on your ordering page on pos.yammbo.com, receive pickup or delivery orders at the register, accept cash, card terminal or transfer payments and use your couriers.
en.body:
With online ordering your business has its own page at **pos.yammbo.com/your-business**. Your customers build their order, choose pickup or delivery, and the order reaches your register.

Online ordering, coupons and reviews are in the **Business** plan. The **Starter** plan is register only. During the free trial you have everything. See [Plan and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/plan-and-billing/).

## Turn it on

It comes **turned off**.

1. In the dashboard open **Store** and look for **"Online ordering"**.
2. Turn on **"Sell online"**.
3. Check in **Locations** the opening hours, whether you offer **pickup** and **delivery**, and the **delivery zones** with their cost.
4. Check in **Store > Payment methods** what you accept online.

If your plan does not include it, you will see **"Your plan does not include online selling."** and the link to **Billing**. You can always turn it off: your page stops being shown.

## How your customers pay

Payment methods are chosen in **Store > Payment methods**:

| Method | How it works |
|---|---|
| **"Cash"** | They pay on pickup or on delivery |
| **"Card (terminal)"** | They pay by card on your card terminal on pickup or on delivery. It is not an online payment |
| **"Bank transfers"** | When they finish the order they see your account details, make the transfer and upload their receipt. You confirm or reject it in **Orders** |

You can write a note on each payment method (up to 200 characters).

## Receive the orders

Orders arrive on **the tablet** and in **Orders** in the dashboard. In the dashboard:

- The tabs are new, in progress and closed orders from the last 24 hours.
- **Accept** an order by setting the preparation time, or **reject it** with a reason.
- Move its status forward until delivered or picked up.
- Confirm or reject transfer receipts.

A location **without a register connected to the internet** does not receive online orders. If the tablet loses internet for a few minutes, the page stops accepting orders until it comes back.

On the register tablet, **Settings > Location and devices > Online account** shows the status of online orders and the buttons to stop Android from putting it to sleep (battery and notifications). Turn them on so the new order alert sounds even when the screen is off.

## Your page

- The name, the description, the color, the logo and the cover are changed in **Store**.
- The products, photos and prices are those of your [menu or catalog](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/menu-and-catalog/).
- To not sell a product today, mark it **Sold out**.

## Coupons, promotions and reviews

- **Promotions**: create coupons and automatic promotions.
- **Reviews**: your customers rate their order. You can reply once and hide a review with a reason.

## Your own couriers

In **Couriers** you add your own couriers. They use the **Yammbo Delivery** app to receive and deliver delivery orders. From the register you can also **"Send to my couriers"** an order.

## Alerts

In **Alerts** in the dashboard you choose what reaches your phone or your email when an order comes in.

## Reports

**Reports** in the dashboard counts the online orders that were delivered or picked up, with three CSV files to download: sales, products and summary.

en.title: What is Yammbo POS?
en.description: The register for restaurants and stores that runs on an Android tablet, with a web dashboard at pos.yammbo.com to manage your business.
en.body:
Yammbo POS is the register for your business. You sell, take payments, close the shift and keep your inventory from an **Android tablet or phone**, and you manage your account, your team and your online sales from **pos.yammbo.com**.

It works for **restaurants** and for **stores**. When you create your business you choose the type, and the register is set up to match.

## The two parts

| Part | Where | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| **The Yammbo POS app** | Android 7 or higher tablet or phone | Selling, payments, tables, kitchen, shift, inventory, customers, register reports |
| **The web dashboard** | [pos.yammbo.com](https://pos.yammbo.com/dashboard/login) in the browser | Your account, the menu or catalog, the team, linked tablets, online ordering, billing and support |

The app and the dashboard share the menu, the employees, the customers and the business data. **Register sales are saved on the tablet**: you see them in **Reports** in the app, in your [backup](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/backups-and-google-sheets/) and, if you turn it on, in a Google Sheet.

## It works without internet

Once linked, the register **sells without internet**: cash payments, card payments on your card terminal or by transfer, the shift, printing, the kitchen and the tables keep working. You need internet for the first start, to pay for your plan, for payments by link or QR, to send receipts by email, to receive online orders and for Google Drive backups. See the [FAQ](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/faq/).

## Restaurant or store

| | Restaurant | Store |
|---|---|---|
| Tables and reservations | Yes | No |
| Kitchen screen | Yes | No |
| Order types | Dine in, To go, Delivery | Counter, Pickup, Shipping |
| Name of the catalog | Menu | Catalog |

The business type is chosen when you create it and **cannot be changed from the web**. If you got it wrong, write to us from **Support** in the dashboard.

## What you can do

- [Sell](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/selling/) with variants, modifiers, discounts, coupons, products sold by weight and barcodes.
- [Take payments](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/payments/) in cash, by card, by transfer, on a customer account, with a gift card or with a link or QR, split the payment and add a tip.
- Serve [tables and reservations](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/tables-and-reservations/) and send orders to the [kitchen](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/kitchen/).
- Open and close the [shift](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/shift-and-close/) with the X report and the Z close.
- Keep [inventory](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/inventory/), suppliers, purchases and counts.
- Manage [customers, store credit, gift cards and layaways](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/customers-and-accounts/).
- Give each [employee](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/staff-and-roles/) their own PIN and permissions.
- Use [multiple tablets](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/multiple-tablets/) in the same location.
- Sell on your own [online page](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/online-ordering/) with the Business plan.

## Plans

You get a **30-day free trial**. After that you choose a plan: **Starter, $60 a month** (the full register) or **Business, $90 a month** (the register plus online ordering, coupons and reviews). See [Plan and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/plan-and-billing/).

## Next step

[Create your account](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/create-your-account/) and then [install the app and link your tablet](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/install-and-link/).

en.title: Take payment and hand over the receipt
en.description: Take payment in cash, by card, by transfer, on a customer account, with a gift card or with a link or QR; split the payment, add a tip and share the receipt.
en.body:
When you tap **"Charge"** the payment screen opens with the **"Total due"**. At the top you choose the method. To go back to the sale tap **"Back to the sale"**.

## Payment methods

| Method | How it works |
|---|---|
| **Cash** | Tap the exact amount or one of the suggested bills, or enter the amount in **"Other amount received"**. The app calculates the change |
| **Card** | You charge on your card terminal and record the payment. You can write the **"Authorization number"** (optional) |
| **Transfer** | You show the customer the **"Transfer details"** and write the **"Reference or receipt number"** |
| **Customer account** | Store credit: the sale is charged to the customer's account. See [Customers and accounts](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/customers-and-accounts/) |
| **Gift card** | Enter or scan the **"Gift card code"**, check the balance and use what is needed |
| Others you add | Wallets or banks that you set up in **Settings > Payment methods** |

If you accept another currency (for example dollars), its tab appears: enter the amount received and the app shows what it is worth at your exchange rate.

## Split the payment

1. Choose a method and enter part of the total.
2. Tap **"Add payment"**.
3. Repeat with the rest. The list shows how much is **Remaining** and the **Change**. **"Remove"** deletes a line.
4. Tap **"Confirm"**.

To split a table's check between diners or by items, use **"Split check"** in [Tables](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/tables-and-reservations/).

## Tip

If you turned on **"Offer a tip at checkout"** in **Settings > Payment methods**, **"Tip"** appears with **"No tip"**, 10 %, 15 %, 20 % or **"Other"**. The tip does not count as a sale.

## Layaway

**"Layaway (deposit now, rest later)"** takes a deposit and leaves the sale pending. The rest is paid from **Customers > Layaways**.

## Charge by link or QR

In **Settings > Payment methods > Charge by link or QR** you can connect your own account with a payment gateway: **Stripe, PayPal, Mercado Pago, Pagadito or Tilopay**. When you take payment, **"Charge with…"** appears: the customer pays with the link or the QR and the app checks the payment. With Stripe you can also take payment by tapping the card on the device, if it is compatible.

You need your own account with that gateway and its keys. The money goes straight to your account. These payments need internet.

If the payment was left half done, tap **"Resume and check"**.

## Fiscal invoice

If you use a fiscal invoice (**Settings > Fiscal invoice**), the app numbers the receipt and can ask for the buyer's document. If your number range runs out or the authorization expires, the register does not let you take payments until you update it. Confirm the rules in your country with your accountant.

## After taking payment

You will see **"Sale paid"** with these options:

- **"Print"** the receipt.
- **"Share receipt"** by **WhatsApp**, **"Text message"** or **"Email"**. Enter the customer's phone or email. **"Save as customer"** is checked so you do not have to type it again.
- **"Show receipt QR"**: the customer scans it and sees their receipt. The QR lasts **15 days**.
- **"New sale"**.

The email is sent automatically when the tablet is linked. If there is no internet at that moment, it is sent as soon as it comes back, within 24 hours.

## If no method appears

The message **"No payment methods are active"** means all the methods are turned off. Turn on at least one in **Settings > Payment methods**.

en.title: Plan and billing
en.description: The Starter and Business plans, the 30-day trial, how to pay by card, change plans or cancel, and what happens if you do not pay.
en.body:
## Plans

| | **Starter** | **Business** |
|---|---|---|
| Price | **$60 a month** | **$90 a month** |
| Register: sales, payments and cash close | Yes | Yes |
| Products, customers and reports | Yes | Yes |
| Team with permissions and multiple devices | Yes | Yes |
| Online orders from your own page | No | Yes |
| Coupons and customer reviews | No | Yes |

Prices are in US dollars (USD), per business.

## The free trial

- It lasts **30 days** from when you create your business. You get everything, including online ordering.
- It does not ask for a card to start.
- It is one per email: a second business with the same email starts by asking for payment.

In the dashboard, **Billing** shows **"Trial days left"**. On the tablet, **Settings > Plan and subscription** shows **"Free trial: N days left"**.

## Pay from the web dashboard

1. Open **Billing** at [pos.yammbo.com](https://pos.yammbo.com/dashboard/billing).
2. Under **"Choose your plan"** select Starter or Business.
3. Tap **"Subscribe"**. You pay by card on **Stripe**'s secure page.

If you subscribe during the trial, **nothing is charged until it ends**: the days you have left are respected.

## Pay from the tablet

1. Open **Settings > Plan and subscription**.
2. Tap **"Choose a plan"** and pick one.
3. Enter the owner's PIN and pay by card on the Stripe page that opens inside the app.

When it finishes, the app comes back by itself. If it does not update, tap **"Refresh status"**.

Only the owner, or someone with the Settings permission, can pay or change the plan. Everyone else sees **"Ask the owner to activate a plan"**.

## Change the card, download invoices or cancel

In **Billing** tap **"Manage subscription"** (on the tablet the button has the same name). The Stripe portal opens, where you change the card, download your invoices or cancel.

If you cancel, the plan continues until the end of the period you already paid for and is not renewed.

## If the trial ends without payment

| When | What happens |
|---|---|
| 7 days before | Notices in the dashboard and by email ("Your Yammbo POS trial ends…") |
| Day 23 | The tablet shows **"Your plan is due in N days"** with the **"Pay"** button |
| **Day 30** | The trial ends. **Online ordering is paused**: your page stops being shown. The register keeps selling |
| Days 30 to 40 | Time to pay. The tablet warns **"Your free trial is over"** |
| **Day 40** | **The register locks** (**"Register locked for lack of payment"**) and **your business data is erased on the server** |
| Days 45 to 49 | The tablet warns every day how many days are left before it is erased |
| **Day 50** | **The tablet erases its data** and is left like new |

The erased data (products, orders, customers, employees and the tablet's sales) cannot be recovered. If you are not going to continue, export your sales first.

With the register locked, the owner enters their PIN and can:

- **"Pay the plan"**: the register unlocks by itself when the payment is confirmed.
- **"I already paid, check"**: if you already paid and it is still locked.
- **"Export sales (CSV)"** or **"Save a copy to Google Drive"**.
- **"Erase this register"**.

## If you pay late

If your payment arrives after the data was erased, we send you an email so you can choose: **continue with a new account** with the time paid, or **the full refund**. If you do not choose within 14 days, we refund the payment.

## Questions about a charge

Write to us from **Support** in the dashboard or at [support@yammbo.com](mailto:support@yammbo.com).

en.title: Printers and hardware
en.description: Connect receipt and kitchen printers by Bluetooth, USB or network, and set up the drawer, barcode readers and the customer screen.
en.body:
Everything is set up in **Settings > Printers and hardware**. Each tablet or phone keeps **its own printers**: if you have two registers, set up each one.

## Which printers work

**ESC/POS** thermal receipt printers of **58 mm** or **80 mm**, which are most point-of-sale printers. They connect in these ways:

| Connection | When |
|---|---|
| **Bluetooth** | Portable or counter printers. Pair it first in Android's Bluetooth settings |
| **USB** | Connected to the tablet with a cable |
| **Network (IP)** | Over Wi-Fi or a network cable, on port 9100. The tablet and the printer must be on the same network |
| **Built-in printer** | Devices with a printer included, such as some Sunmi or iMin |
| **Serial port** or **USB-serial adapter** | Older printers with an adapter (CH340, CP210x, FTDI) |

## Set up step by step

1. Tap **"Set up a printer step by step"**.
2. **How does it connect?** Choose the connection.
3. **Choose the printer** from the list. For network, enter the IP or tap **"Detect equipment"**.
4. **Paper width**: 58 mm or 80 mm.
5. **Test page**: check that it prints correctly.
6. **What is it for?**: **Receipts**, **Kitchen** or **Receipts and kitchen**.

You can also use **"Add printer"** and fill in the details by hand. On each printer you choose the **"Stations it prints"** (Kitchen, Bar…) and test it with **"Print test"**.

If your device has a printer and it does not respond with **"Built-in printer"**, try **"Serial port (built-in printer)"**. Write to us with the model if neither works.

## Cash drawer

The drawer connects to the receipt printer. On the printer choose the drawer pin: **"Pin 2 (the usual one)"**, **"Pin 5"** or **"Both pins"**, and tap **"Test drawer"**. It opens by itself when the receipt of a sale paid in cash is printed (not when reprinting). To open it without a sale use **"Open the drawer"** at the register: it asks for a reason.

## Barcode reader

At the register, a USB or Bluetooth reader that types like a keyboard adds the product when you scan, with nothing to set up. You can also use the camera with **"Scan barcode"**.

## Customer screen

It shows the sale, the total and, if you want, the receipt options to the customer. There are three ways:

- **Second screen on the same device**: if your device has a screen for the customer, turn it on in **"Customer screen"** with **"Show the sale on the customer screen"**. **"Show preview"** shows you how it looks.
- **Another tablet over Wi-Fi**: in **Settings > Location and devices > Tablets connected over Wi-Fi** tap **"Pair a tablet"**. On the other tablet choose **"Customer screen for another register"** and enter the code. Both must be on the same Wi-Fi; internet is not needed.
- **This same device**: **"Use this device as a customer screen"**. To exit, press and hold the top left corner for 3 seconds.

The customer screen uses the **"Customer language"** from Settings > Business.

## If it does not print

See [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/troubleshooting/#it-does-not-print).

en.title: Reports
en.description: Which reports the register includes, how to choose the period, share and export to CSV, and how they differ from the web dashboard reports.
en.body:
**Reports on the tablet** counts the sales you take at the register. **Reports in the web dashboard** counts the orders from your online page. Register sales are not uploaded to the web.

## Register reports

Open **Reports** on the tablet. Choose the period: **Today**, **Yesterday**, **7 days** or **Other range**. Tap **"Share report"** to send it or **"Export to CSV"** to open it in Excel or Google Sheets.

### Summary

Tickets, average ticket, gross sales, discounts, service, delivery fees charged, net sales, total collected, tips, refunds and net total after refunds.

### Detail

- **Payments by method**.
- **Top products**, by quantity and by amount.
- **Sales by hour** and **Sales by employee**.
- **Voids** and **By order type**.
- **Profit**, if your products have a cost.
- **Accounts receivable** (needs the accounts permission).

### Advanced reports

Further down, more cards appear depending on your permissions and what you have turned on:

| Report | What it is for |
|---|---|
| **Input cost: theoretical and actual** (in stores, **Cost of goods sold**) | How much what was sold should have cost according to the recipes, against what left the inventory |
| **Menu engineering** (in stores, **Product performance**) | Which products sell a lot and leave a good margin |
| **ABC analysis** | Which products make up most of your sales |
| **Sell-through and dead stock** | What moves little or not at all |
| **Margin by category** | Profit by category |
| **Tax breakdown** | Tax collected by rate |
| **Promotions and points** | What the discounts and points cost |
| **Busiest hours** | When you sell the most |
| **Sales by table**, **by customer** and **by category** | Detail for each one |
| **Supplier balances** | What you owe each supplier |
| **Payroll** | Hours, commissions and tips by employee |

## Your sales in Google Sheets

To make charts or review sales from the computer, turn on **Settings > My data in Google**. The register copies your sales, products, inventory, customers and shift closes to a sheet in your Google Drive. See [Backups and Google Sheets](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/backups-and-google-sheets/).

## Web dashboard reports

On pos.yammbo.com, **Reports** shows the online orders that were delivered or picked up, counted on the day they were completed using your business's time. You can download three CSV files: sales, products and summary. See [Online ordering](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/online-ordering/).

en.title: History, voids and refunds
en.description: Look up past sales, reprint receipts, void a sale and make full or partial refunds with their slip.
en.body:
## View sales

In the **Register** tap **"Sales"**. Search by receipt number, by customer or by phone.

Each sale shows its status:

| Status | What it means |
|---|---|
| **Paid** | Paid |
| **Voided** | Voided before it was paid |
| **Refunded** | Fully refunded |
| **Partially refunded** | Part of it was refunded |
| **Merged into another check** | Combined with another table or tab |
| **Open** | Not paid yet |

When you open a sale you see the products, the totals, the payments, the customer and the delivery details. From there you can **"Reprint receipt"** or **"Refund"**.

## Make a refund

1. Open the sale and tap **"Refund"**.
2. Under **"What is being returned"** choose the products and the quantities, or tap **"All"**.
3. Choose the **"Reason"**: Defective product, Unhappy customer, Duplicate charge, or write another one. It is required.
4. Check **"Return to inventory"** if the product goes back on the shelf.
5. Under **"How the money goes back"** choose **"To the original payments"** or **"All in cash"**.
6. Tap **"Refund"** with the amount.

You will see **"Refund recorded"** with its number, and you can **"Print refund slip"**.

A refund returns the exact price and tax of what is returned, even if the sale had discounts or exempt products. You can refund a sale in several parts: in the end it adds up to exactly what was charged.

If it was paid by card or with a link, the app **records** the refund, but you return the money yourself on your card terminal or in your gateway's panel.

If your role cannot make refunds, the app asks for a supervisor's PIN.

## Void

- **A sale that has not been paid**: **"Void sale"** under **"More options"**. It asks for a reason.
- **A product already sent to the kitchen**: remove it from the tab and confirm **"Void sent item"**. The station gets a printed notice.

Voids appear in [Reports](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/reports/) and in the [Z close](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/shift-and-close/).

## Refunds in the shift

Cash refunds come out of the shift's cash and are seen in the X report and the Z close as **"Cash refunds"**.

en.title: Selling at the register
en.description: How to build a sale in Yammbo POS, with variants, modifiers, notes, discounts, coupons, customers, saved orders, delivery and quotes.
en.body:
Sales are made in the **Register** section. To take payments you need an [open shift](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/shift-and-close/) on that tablet. If there is none, you will see **"Open a shift to charge"**.

## Add products

- Tap a product to add it. Filter by category with the chips at the top (**"All"** shows everything).
- **"Search product"** searches by name. **"Scan barcode"** uses the camera or a connected reader.
- If the product has **variants** (sizes, flavors), the app asks you to **"Pick a variant."**
- If it has **modifiers**, you will see **"Choose one option"**, **"Choose up to N, if you like"** or **"Choose N to M"**.
- Products sold **by weight** ask for the weight in kg, lb, g or oz depending on the product.
- **"Sold out"** marks what is no longer available. **"Out of stock"** appears if you track inventory and it ran out.
- If a product has a schedule and you are outside it, the app asks whether you want to add it anyway.

## Edit the sale

- **Tap a line** to write a note on it. Press and hold or swipe to remove it.
- **"Note for the kitchen"** goes on the kitchen order. **"Allergy"** is shown large in the kitchen.
- In restaurants you can split the dishes into **courses** (starter, main) and fire them when it is time.

## Order type

| Restaurant | Store | What it asks for |
|---|---|---|
| **Dine in** | **Counter** | Nothing else |
| **To go** | **Pickup** | Optional: the **"Pickup time"** |
| **Delivery** | **Shipping** | The customer's name, phone and address, and the **"Delivery fee"**. Check **"Save to the customer"** so you do not have to type them again |

## Customer

Tap **"Add customer"**, search by name or phone or tap **"New customer"**. With a customer you can use their **points**, charge the sale to their account (store credit) and send them the receipt. See [Customers and accounts](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/customers-and-accounts/).

## Discounts, coupons and points

- **"Discount"**: as a percentage or an amount, on the whole sale, with a reason (Regular customer, Promotion, Courtesy, Employee). **"Remove discount"** undoes it.
- **"Item discount"**: only on one line.
- **"Coupon"** and **"Use points"**, if you have them turned on.

If your role cannot give discounts, the app asks for **"Supervisor authorization"**: someone with permission enters their PIN and taps **"Authorize"**.

## Save an order for later

Tap **"Save order"**. The order stays open and you pick it up again in **"Orders"**, at the top of the register. There you filter by To go, Delivery or Counter, see whether it is **In the kitchen** or **Ready** and **dispatch** it.

On a delivery you can set **"How do they pay?"** (cash or card on delivery), how much they pay with and the **"Change to carry"**. If you have your own couriers, tap **"Send to my couriers"**.

## Send to the kitchen

In restaurants, **"Send to kitchen"** sends the order to the [kitchen screen](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/kitchen/) or to the printer of its station. If a product has already been sent and you remove it, the app asks for **"Void sent item"** and the kitchen gets the notice.

## Take payment

Tap **"Charge"** with the total. See [Payments](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/payments/).

## Other options under "More options"

- **"Quotes and special orders"**: **"Save as quote"** saves the sale without charging it. Later you turn it into a tab.
- **"Open the drawer"** without a sale: it asks for a reason and the opening is recorded.
- **"Void sale"**: discards the sale in progress. It asks for a reason.

In **Staff > Roles** you can set caps on discounts, refunds, voids and cash taken out, or always require a manager. They are turned on in **Settings > Advanced sales**.

en.title: Settings
en.description: What is in each Settings category of the Yammbo POS app, from business details and taxes to printers, backups and auto-lock.
en.body:
Open **Settings** on the tablet (at the bottom of the side menu, or under **"More"** on a phone). You need the **Settings** permission. When you change something, tap **Save**; the app warns you if you leave with unsaved changes.

With the tablet linked, the country, the base currency, the second currency and the tax are changed on pos.yammbo.com. On the tablet they appear with **"Change it at pos.yammbo.com"**.

## Categories

| Category | What it has |
|---|---|
| **Business** | Name, country, **"Customer language"**, business type, tax ID (RUC, NIT, RFC…), address, phone, country code for phone numbers, **"Receipt footer message"**, time zone and logo |
| **Plan and subscription** | Your plan, the trial days, payments and invoices. See [Plan and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/plan-and-billing/) |
| **Sales and taxes** | Tax name, service and features (Tables, Kitchen) in restaurants, default delivery fee, currency, other currencies you accept and cash rounding |
| **Payment methods** | **"Accept cash"**, your cards, banks and wallets, **"Offer a tip at checkout"** and charging by link or QR |
| **Customer accounts** | Store credit, gift cards and layaways |
| **Advanced inventory** | Areas, costs, payables, production and sold-out items |
| **Advanced sales** | Taxes, promotions, limits, deliveries and staff |
| **Kitchen** | Wait times and course times (restaurants only) |
| **Fiscal invoice** | Numbering and receipt texts |
| **Printers and hardware** | Printers, drawer and customer screen. See [Printers and hardware](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/printers-and-hardware/) |
| **Location and devices** | Connected tablets, the location's registers, online account and the role of this device. See [Multiple tablets](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/multiple-tablets/) |
| **Backups** | Google Drive, daily copy and restore |
| **My data in Google** | Your sales in a Google Sheet |
| **This device** | Appearance, language, prefix and auto-lock |
| **Help** | The help center and the app details for support |

## Payment methods

- Add a **"Card or electronic payment"** (your card terminal, a wallet) or a **"Transfer or deposit"** with bank, account holder, account number, currency and instructions for the customer. Check **"Ask for a reference"** if you want the register to ask for the receipt number.
- In **Charge by link or QR** you paste the keys of your Stripe, PayPal, Mercado Pago, Pagadito or Tilopay account. See [Payments](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/payments/#charge-by-link-or-qr).

## Currency

- **"Base currency"**: the one your prices are in. Changing it does not convert the prices; the app asks you to confirm.
- **"Other currencies you accept"**: up to 3, with their value (for example, the value of 1 USD in córdobas).
- **"Cash rounding"**: to 0.50, 1 or 5 units.

## Fiscal invoice

Turn on **"Use fiscal receipt"** and fill in the document name, the authorization text, the legend, the series prefix, the next number, the last number of the range and the **"Valid until"** date. You can ask for the buyer's document.

The register does not let you take payments when the range runs out or the authorization expires. With multiple tablets, give each one a different series prefix. Each country has its own rules: confirm them with your accountant.

## This device

- **Appearance**: Automatic, Light or Dark.
- **"App language"**: Español or English. It is different from the **"Customer language"** (Business), which is used on receipts and on the customer screen.
- **"Device prefix"**: 1 to 4 letters or digits (for example T01). It numbers the receipts of this tablet, like T01-000123.
- **"Auto-lock"**: minutes without use before asking for the PIN again. 0 = never.
- **Updates**: the installed version and **"Check for updates"**. See [Update the app](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/update-the-app/).

## Help

**"Open the help center"** opens this page. There you also see the **"App version"** and the **"Device id"**; tap **"Copy details"** and paste them when you write to support.

en.title: Shift, X report and Z close
en.description: Open the shift with the starting cash, record cash in and cash out, run the X report and close the shift with the Z close.
en.body:
Without an open shift the register **does not take payments**. Each tablet keeps **its own shift**.

## Open the shift

1. Open **Shift**. You will see **"No open shift"**.
2. Count the cash in the drawer and enter it in **"Opening cash"**.
3. Tap **"Open shift"**.

If you accept another currency, it may ask you for **"Today's exchange rate"**.

## During the shift

Under **"Shift open"** you see the sales made, the total sold, the payments by method and the **"Cash that should be in the register"**.

- **"Cash in"**: money you put in the drawer (for example, more change). It asks for an amount and a reason.
- **"Cash out"**: money you take out (a payment to a supplier, a withdrawal). It asks for an amount and a reason.
- **"X report"**: a partial summary at any time, without closing. You can **"Print"** or **"Share"**.

## Close the shift

1. Tap **"Close shift"**.
2. Count the cash in the drawer and enter it in **"Counted"**.
3. Confirm. If there are open tabs, the app warns you: they stay open for the next shift.

You will see **"Shift closed"** with the **Expected**, the **Counted** and the **Difference**. Tap **"Print Z"** or **"Share Z"**.

## What the Z close includes

- **Gross sales**, **Refunds**, **Net sales**, **Tax**, **Tips** and **Total collected**.
- Payments **by method** (cash, card, transfer and the rest).
- The cash: **Opening cash**, cash sales, **Cash in**, **Cash out**, cash refunds and what should be in the drawer.
- **Payments received on accounts** from customer accounts and **Gift cards sold**, if you use them.
- The counters: number of tickets and voids.

## Previous shifts

Under **"Previous shifts"** you see each close with who opened and who closed, and **"Drawer balanced"** or the difference. Tap one to see the **"Shift detail"**.

If you have two registers in the same location, each one opens and closes its shift with its own cash and its own Z close.

en.title: Staff, roles and PINs
en.description: Add employees with their PIN, give them a role with permissions, ask for a supervisor's authorization and use the time clock.
en.body:
Each person signs in to the register with **their own PIN** of 4 to 6 digits. What they can do depends on their **role**.

## Where they are managed

If your tablet is linked to pos.yammbo.com, employees, roles and PINs are managed in the dashboard, under **Team > POS employees** and **Team > Roles**. The tablet downloads them by itself.

On the tablet the section is **Staff**, with the **Staff** and **Roles** tabs. Employees that exist only on that tablet appear as **"Only on this register"** and are never deleted automatically.

## Add an employee

**On the web:** open **Team > POS employees**, add the person with their name, their role and a PIN of 4 to 6 digits. The PIN is shown only once. You can have up to 100 employees.

**On the tablet:** tap **"Add employee"**, enter **Name**, choose the **Role** and enter the **PIN**.

Two active employees cannot have the same PIN. To remove someone, **deactivate them**: their history is kept.

## Roles that come created

**Owner**, **Manager**, **Cashier**, **Server** and **Kitchen**. The **Owner** role cannot be edited. You can create your own (up to 30 on the web).

## Permissions

| Group | Permissions |
|---|---|
| **Sales** | Quick sale, Tables, Charge, Discounts, Void, Refunds, Open drawer, Accounts and gift cards |
| **Operations** | Cash shift, Kitchen display, Sales reports, Record waste, Production, Mark sold out, Payroll |
| **Administration** | Menu and tables, Inventory, See costs, Payables, Customers, Staff and roles, Settings |

In a store, "Menu and tables" is called "Catalog".

A role with no section will see **"Your role has no access to any section. Ask the owner for help."**

## Supervisor authorization

If someone tries something their role does not allow (a discount, a refund, a void), the app shows **"Supervisor authorization"**. A person with permission enters their PIN and taps **"Authorize"**.

In **"Limits and approvals"** for each role you can set, for discounts, refunds, voiding sent items, voiding tabs and cash taken out: **Free**, **Up to a cap** or **Always with a manager**. The limits are turned on in **Settings > Advanced sales**.

## Sign in and lock

- When you open the app: **"Enter your PIN"** and **"Enter"**. After several failed attempts, the app asks you to wait a few seconds.
- **"Lock"** closes your session so another person can sign in. On a phone it is under **"More"**.
- The register locks by itself after a few minutes without use. It is changed in **Settings > This device > "Auto-lock"** (0 = never).

## Time clock

On the sign-in screen tap **"Clock in or out"**. Each person enters their PIN and chooses **Clock in**, **Clock out**, **Start break** or **End break**.

With the **Payroll** permission you can set each employee's hourly pay, commission and share of tips, and see the **Payroll** report.

## Dashboard people

The **members** of the dashboard (Team > Members) sign in to pos.yammbo.com with their email and password. **POS employees** sign in to the register with their PIN. See [The web dashboard](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/the-dashboard/#invite-another-person-to-the-dashboard).

en.title: Tables and reservations
en.description: Create your tables, draw the floor plan, open tabs by table, move them, merge them, split the check and manage reservations.
en.body:
Stores do not have tables. A restaurant can turn them off in **Settings > Sales and taxes > Features**, as long as there are no open table tabs.

## Create the tables

1. Open **Menu** and the **Tables** tab.
2. Tap **"Add table"**, give it a name and, if you want, an **"Area"** (Terrace, Dining room).

## The floor plan

In **Tables** tap **"Edit tables"** and then **"Edit plan"**. Drag each table to its place and choose the shape: **Square**, **Round** or **Rectangle**. The ones you have not placed yet appear under **"Not placed"**. **"Fit all"** fits the plan to the screen.

## Serve a table

The map shows the status of each table:

| Status | What it means |
|---|---|
| **Free** | No tab |
| With a tab | It has products ordered |
| **Ready** | The kitchen is done |
| **Check requested** | The customer asked for the check |
| **Booked** | It has a reservation at that time |

1. Tap a free table to open its tab.
2. Add products and tap **"Send to kitchen"**.
3. When they ask for the check, tap **"Request check"** or **"Print check"**.
4. Tap **"Charge"**.

The **"Mine"** chip shows only the tables of the waiter who signed in with their PIN.

## Move, merge and split

- **"Move to another table"**: moves the whole tab to another table.
- **"Merge with another table"**: joins two tabs into one.
- **"Split check"**: **"By item"** (each person pays for their own) or **"By diner"** (equal parts). Each part becomes **"Check 1"**, **"Check 2"**…

## Service

In **Settings > Sales and taxes > Service** you set the service charge percentage, whether it is charged on tables and whether the waiter can request the check.

## Reservations

Open the **"Reservations"** tab in Tables.

1. Tap **"New reservation"**: name, phone, **"Time"**, duration in minutes, table and note.
2. When they arrive, tap **"Seat"** or **"Open table"**.
3. When they leave, **"Finish"**. If they did not show up, **"No show"**. To cancel it, **"Cancel reservation"**.

The statuses are **Booked**, **Seated**, **Finished**, **Cancelled** and **No show**.

## Waiter tablet

On a second tablet or phone, set **Settings > Location and devices > What this device is for** to **Waiter**: when it signs in it opens Tables with **"Mine"** turned on. See [Multiple tablets](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/multiple-tablets/).

en.title: The web dashboard
en.description: What is in each section of pos.yammbo.com, how to sign in and what is managed on the web and what on the tablet.
en.body:
The Yammbo POS dashboard is at **[pos.yammbo.com](https://pos.yammbo.com/dashboard/login)**. It works in the browser on a computer or a phone.

## Sign in

1. Open [pos.yammbo.com](https://pos.yammbo.com/dashboard/login). You will see **"Log in to your dashboard"**.
2. Enter your email and your password and tap **Log in**.
3. If you do not remember it, tap **"Forgot my password"**. See [Create your account](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/create-your-account/#if-you-forget-your-password).

The session lasts 30 days. To sign out, tap your photo or your initials and choose log out.

## Sections

On a computer the sections are in the menu on the left. On a phone the bottom bar shows Orders, Dashboard, Menu and Customers, and the rest is under **"More"**. Each person sees only the sections their role allows.

### Main

| Section | What it is for |
|---|---|
| **Orders** | The orders from your [online page](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/online-ordering/): accept them, reject them, move them forward and review transfer receipts |
| **Dashboard** | A summary of the business and the link to download the app |
| **Menu** | Categories, products, combos, modifiers and stations. See [Menu or catalog](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/menu-and-catalog/) |
| **Customers** | List of customers, add, import and export as CSV |
| **Reviews** | Reviews from your online customers (Business plan) |
| **Promotions** | Coupons and automatic promotions (Business plan) |
| **Reports** | Sales from online orders, with CSV export |

### Your business

| Section | What it is for |
|---|---|
| **Store** | Name, description, phone numbers, tax ID, receipt footer, color, logo and cover, online ordering, taxes, currency and payment methods |
| **Locations** | Your locations, with opening hours, pickup and delivery, and delivery zones |
| **Devices** | Link tablets with a code and see or remove the linked ones. See [Install and link](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/install-and-link/#link-with-a-code-from-the-dashboard) |
| **Couriers** | Your own couriers, who use the Yammbo Delivery app |
| **Team** | Members who sign in to the dashboard, roles and POS employees with their PIN. See [Staff and roles](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/staff-and-roles/) |
| **Support** | Write to Yammbo and see your requests |
| **Billing** | Your plan, the trial and payment. See [Plan and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/plan-and-billing/) |

If your role has alerts, you will also see **Alerts**, where you choose what reaches you on your phone or by email.

## What is changed on the web and what on the tablet

When the tablet is linked, some data is sent by the web and shows on the tablet with the note **"Change it at pos.yammbo.com"**:

| On the web | On the tablet |
|---|---|
| Country, base currency and second currency with its exchange rate | Sales, payments, shift and X/Z report |
| Tax percentage and whether it is included | Inventory, suppliers and purchases |
| Employees, roles and PINs | Printers and customer screen |
| Online ordering, locations and zones | Store credit, gift cards and layaways |
| Plan and payment (also from the tablet) | Backups and Google Sheet |

The **menu** and the **customers** can be edited on both sides and are synced.

**Reports** in the dashboard counts the online orders. The sales you take at the register are seen in **Reports** in the app. See [Reports](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/reports/).

## Invite another person to the dashboard

1. Open **Team > Members** and invite the person with their email.
2. They receive a link that is valid for **7 days**.
3. Choose their role. The role decides which sections they see.

Members sign in to the dashboard with email and password. POS employees sign in to the register with their PIN: they are different things.

## Support

From **Support** you write the subject and the message. We answer you there and by email. The statuses are **Open**, **Waiting for your reply** and **Closed**. You can also write to [support@yammbo.com](mailto:support@yammbo.com).

en.title: Troubleshooting
en.description: What to do when the code does not arrive, the tablet does not link, it does not print, you cannot take payments, tablets do not sync or online orders do not arrive.
en.body:
## Sign in and link

**The code does not arrive in my email.**
- Check the spam or promotions folder.
- Wait a minute and tap **"Resend code"** (on the web, **"Send another code"**).
- On the tablet, check that you chose **"Yammbo POS (restaurants or shops)"** under **"Where is your account?"**
- The code expires after 30 minutes.

**"Your account has no business you can link".**
Finish the wizard at [pos.yammbo.com](https://pos.yammbo.com/dashboard/login) or create the business from the tablet with **"Create account"**.

**The "Link device" button is turned off.**
An active employee with the **Owner** role is missing. Create one in **Team > POS employees**.

**"The code expired. Generate a new one."**
The dashboard code lasts 5 minutes and is used once. Generate another one in **Devices**.

**"Wrong PIN" or "Too many attempts".**
Wait the seconds it indicates and try again. If the employee forgot their PIN, the owner changes it in **Team > POS employees** (or in **Staff** on the tablet if it is not linked).

## Taking payments

**I cannot take payments.**
- **"Open a shift to charge"**: open the shift in **Shift**. Each tablet needs its own.
- **"No payment methods are active"**: turn on at least one method in **Settings > Payment methods**.
- The fiscal invoice reached the end of its range or expired: update it in **Settings > Fiscal invoice**.
- **"Register locked for lack of payment"**: see [Plan and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/plan-and-billing/).

**"The phone number is not valid".**
Enter the local number with all its digits or add the country code with **+**.

**The receipt email does not arrive.**
The tablet has to be linked. Without internet, the email waits up to 24 hours and is then discarded.

## It does not print

1. Tap **"Print test"** in **Settings > Printers and hardware**.
2. **Bluetooth**: the printer must be on and paired in Android's Bluetooth settings.
3. **Network**: the tablet and the printer on the same Wi-Fi, and the right IP. Use **"Detect equipment"**.
4. **USB**: accept the USB permission that Android asks for when you connect it.
5. Check the paper width (58 or 80 mm) and that the printer is **ESC/POS**.
6. Each tablet has its own printers: if you changed tablets, set it up again.

**Kitchen orders do not come out.**
On the kitchen printer check **"Stations it prints"** and that the product has its **"Preparation station"**.

## Multiple tablets

**"The other register runs another version of the app".**
Update all the tablets to the same version. See [Update the app](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/update-the-app/).

**The tablets do not share data.**
They must be on the same Wi-Fi. Some guest networks do not let devices see each other: use the main network.

**I see alerts in "Conflicts between registers".**
Review each one and tap **"Mark as reviewed"**. See [Multiple tablets](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/multiple-tablets/#conflicts-between-registers).

## Online ordering

**Online orders do not arrive.**
- Online ordering must be turned on in **Store** and your plan must be Business (or be in the trial).
- The location needs a register **with internet**: without one the page stops accepting orders.
- On the tablet, in **Settings > Location and devices > Online account**, turn on the battery and notification permissions so Android does not put it to sleep.

**"Your plan does not include online selling".**
Switch to the Business plan in **Billing**.

## Update

**"The update failed".**
Tap **"Download from the browser"** and install over it, without uninstalling.

## Write to support

- From the dashboard: **Support**.
- By email: [support@yammbo.com](mailto:support@yammbo.com).

On the tablet open **Settings > Help** and tap **"Copy details"**: it copies the app version and the device id. Paste them in your message.

en.title: Update the app
en.description: How Yammbo POS updates itself from inside the app, how to check for a new version by hand and what to do if the update fails.
en.body:
The app checks for new versions by itself, when you open it and when you come back to it, at most every 6 hours. It needs internet for that.

## When there is a new version

1. **"There is a new version of Yammbo POS"** appears with the number. People with the Settings permission see it.
2. Tap **"Update"**. You will see **"Downloading the update"** with the percentage.
3. The first time, Android asks for permission: **"Allow Yammbo POS to install updates"**. Tap **"Open settings"**, turn on the permission and come back. The installation continues by itself.
4. Confirm the installation on the Android screen.

**"Later"** postpones it for 24 hours. Your data is not touched when updating.

## Check by hand

Open **Settings > This device > Updates**. There you see the **installed version** and the **"Check for updates"** button. If you already have it, it says **"You have the latest version"**.

## If it fails

If you see **"The update failed"**, tap **"Download from the browser"**: the installation file downloads and you open it by hand. You can also download it with **"Download Yammbo POS"** on [pos.yammbo.com](https://pos.yammbo.com/dashboard/login): it is always the latest version. Install it over the one you have, **without uninstalling**.

Uninstalling the app erases the tablet's data. To update, always install over it.

## Multiple tablets

If you have [multiple tablets in the location](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/multiple-tablets/), **update all of them the same day**. Tablets with different versions stop syncing with each other until they all have the same one.

en.title: Analytics and customers
en.description: What sales data you see in Analytics and what information Yammbo Store gathers about your online customers.
en.body:
Analytics (your dashboard's home page) and Customers are shown in Spanish today, even if you browse the dashboard in English. Below are the literal labels you'll see.

## Analytics (`/dashboard`)

This is your dashboard's home page. Pick a period — **"Hoy"** (Today), **"7 días"** (7 days) or **"30 días"** (30 days) — and you'll see:

- **"Ventas netas"** (Net sales), **"Nº de ventas"** (Number of sales), **"Ticket medio"** (Average ticket) and **"Por la web"** (From the web).
- **"Ventas por día"** (Sales by day).
- **"Productos más vendidos"** (Best-selling products).
- **"De dónde viene"** (Where it comes from) — comparing web sales against sales rung up directly at the till.
- **"Entrega"** (Delivery), for web orders only (pickup vs. delivery).
- **"Por local"** (By location), if you have more than one branch.
- **"A qué hora se vende"** (What time you sell).

The data covers **all** sales, both from your online shop and whatever's charged directly in Loyverse. A refund subtracts from the figures. The time zone used is the one you set in [Settings](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/settings/).

## Customers

A list of everyone who has bought from you online, grouped by email, with a **"Repite"** (Repeat) tag for anyone who's bought again. KPIs at the top: Clientes (Customers), Nuevos (New, 30 days), Repiten (Repeat) and Gasto medio (Average spend).

If nobody has bought anything yet: "Todavía nadie ha pedido por la web…" (Nobody has ordered through the website yet…). Customers who buy directly at your location, in Loyverse, don't show up here: those stay in Loyverse's own customer file.

## Next step

Check what all of this costs you in [Plan, add-ons and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/plan-pricing-and-billing/).

en.title: Coupons
en.description: Creating discount codes in Yammbo Store — percentage, fixed amount or free shipping — and what the buyer sees when applying them at checkout.
en.body:
## The Coupons section (`/dashboard/coupons`)

"Coupons" — "Codes your customers type at checkout. The discount is applied to the products; Loyverse records the reduced price with a note of the code."

## Creating a coupon

Under **"New coupon"**:

- **Code** — for example `SUMMER10`. Uppercase, letters, numbers, underscore and dash only, 3 to 30 characters.
- **Type** — **"% off"**, **"$ off"** or **"Free shipping"**.
- **Value** — the percentage (1 to 90) or the fixed amount, depending on the type.
- **Minimum order ($, optional)**.
- **Max uses (optional)**.
- **From (optional)** and **Until (optional)** — "Until" includes that whole day, in your shop's time zone.

Button **"Save coupon"**. If you use a code that already exists, you're editing it instead of duplicating it: "Same code again = edit it."

If you leave something wrong when saving a coupon, the error message appears in Spanish today, regardless of your dashboard language.

| Message (shown in Spanish) | Cause |
|---|---|
| "El código necesita al menos 3 letras o números." | Code too short |
| "Elige el tipo de descuento." | You didn't pick percentage, amount or free shipping |
| "El porcentaje tiene que estar entre 1 y 90." | Value out of range |
| "Pon el importe del descuento." | Missing discount amount |

## Your coupons

The list shows the code, the discount (**"−10%"**, **"−$5.00"** or **"Free shipping"**), how many times it's been used out of the maximum, the dates, and whether it's **"Active"** or **"Paused"**. You can **"Pause"**/**"Activate"** or **"Delete"** each one. If you haven't created any yet: "No coupons yet."

A use is counted when the order is **paid**, not when the code is typed — an order that's in the middle of paying within the last hour also takes up a slot.

## What the buyer sees

At checkout, the **"Discount code"** field with an **"Apply"** button. If it works: "Code applied." or "Free shipping applied."

| Error message | Cause |
|---|---|
| "That code does not exist or is no longer active." | Code doesn't exist or is paused |
| "That code cannot be used yet." | The "From" date hasn't arrived yet |
| "That code has expired." | Past the "Until" date |
| "That code has been used up." | Max uses reached |
| "That code is for orders from $X." | The cart doesn't reach the minimum order |

The discount reduces the price of each order line (never below the extras chosen); due to rounding, in some cases it may apply one or two cents less than expected, but what's shown at checkout always matches what's charged. In Loyverse, the sale is recorded with a note like "Cupón CÓDIGO −X.XX".

A **"Free shipping"** coupon and "Free delivery over" in Settings do the same thing for the customer: they pay no shipping, but your shop still pays the label to Shippo.

## Next step

To actually start charging, connect your account in [Payments with Stripe](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/payments-with-stripe/).

en.title: Create your account and first steps
en.description: Yammbo Store sign-up step by step — your details, picking a plan, telling us about your shop, the wait while we set up your till and the ready email.
en.body:
Sign-up has five required steps, in this order: details, plan, shop settings, waiting, and ready. Until you finish, any attempt to open the dashboard sends you back to the pending step.

## 1. Create your account

Go to `store.yammbo.com/alta`. The screen reads **"Create your account"** — "Your business online, wired to your till. Two minutes to start."

Fields:

- **Your full name**
- **What are you in the business?** — Owner / Partner / Manager / Other
- **Business name**
- **Address of the place** — "Start typing and pick from the list."
- **Phone**
- **Email** — "We send a sign-in code there. Use one you read."

Button **"Create my account"**.

Unlike Yammbo POS, you're not asked whether you're a restaurant or a shop: your account is always set up as a shop.

Possible errors:

| Message | Cause |
|---|---|
| "That email already has an account. Sign in with it." | An account already exists with that email |
| "Some details are missing." | You left a field empty |
| "Enter a full phone number: we need it to reach you." | The phone number has fewer than 10 digits |

## 2. The code by email

You'll get a 6-digit code at your email. Getting it right moves you to the next step. See [Signing in](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/signing-in/) for expiry and attempts.

## 3. Pick your plan

"Change it whenever you like. No per-order commission on any of them." You'll see plan cards and a full comparison, under **"Everything each plan includes"**. Button **"Choose this plan"**, which takes you to pay the subscription through Stripe. At the bottom: "Prices in US dollars, taxes apart. Change plan or cancel whenever you like from your panel; no lock-in."

See the real prices in [Plan, add-ons and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/plan-pricing-and-billing/).

If you come back from Stripe and the payment hasn't fully processed yet, you'll see a waiting screen that retries on its own.

## 4. Tell us about your shop

"This is what we build your shop and till from. You can change it later." Sections:

- **The basics** — name, "One line about your shop", address, phone, time zone.
- **Opening hours** — with **"Copy Monday to the rest"** so you don't repeat the same hours seven times.
- **Delivery and pickup** — "People can collect at the shop", "You deliver", "Minimum order for delivery", with the note: "The shipping cost is worked out by the carrier based on weight and destination. You finish setting it up afterwards, in Shipping."
- **Social media** — Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, WhatsApp.

Button **"Send and finish"**.

## 5. The wait: "We are building your till"

The dashboard appears blurred behind this dialog:

> "With what you told us we are setting up your till, your catalogue and your online shop. We will email and message you the moment it is ready, usually the same day." — "You do not need to wait here."

You don't need to sit and watch the dashboard during this wait — we'll email you as soon as it's ready.

## 6. The ready email

Once Yammbo finishes connecting your till, you get the email **"Your till is ready"** — "You can start selling!" — with the button **"Go to my panel"** and a list of suggested next steps, including putting the prep screen on your packing tablet.

## Your first test order

Before announcing your shop, it's worth placing a real, small order: open your storefront, buy a cheap product with your own card, and follow it through to delivered. That way you confirm in one go that Loyverse, Shippo (if you ship) and Stripe are all connected properly before a real customer sees anything.

## Next step

Sign in to your dashboard for the first time: [Signing in](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/signing-in/).

en.title: The dashboard: a map of every section
en.description: Where to find everything in the Yammbo Store dashboard — the sidebar, the mobile menu, the QR card and pending reminders.
en.body:
The sidebar has two groups.

## Your business

| Section | What it's for |
|---|---|
| **Analytics** (`/dashboard`) | The home page: sales, top-selling products, where your orders come from |
| **Orders** (the URL is actually `/dashboard/analytics`) | View and manage every order |
| **Picking** (`/dashboard/kitchen`) | The packing screen |
| **WhatsApp**, **Instagram**, **Messenger**, **Telegram** | Connect your Yammbot chat channels |
| **Social** (`/dashboard/social`) | Post products to your networks with Buffer |
| **Customers** | Who buys from you online |
| **Settings** | Name, web address, social links, hours and Loyverse |
| **Design** (`/dashboard/theme`) | Choose your shop's visual theme |
| **Products** (`/dashboard/products`) | Extra photos and weight for your items |
| **Coupons** (`/dashboard/coupons`) | Discount codes |
| **Shipping** (`/dashboard/shipping`) | Your Shippo account and shipping rules |
| **Your brand** (`/dashboard/brand`) | Colors, logo, home banner |
| **Payments** (`/dashboard/payments`) | Your Stripe account |

## Your account

**My plan**, **View store** and **Sign out**.

## On mobile

The bottom bar shows Analytics, Orders, Picking, Customers and **"More"** with the rest of the sections.

## The QR card

On the dashboard you'll see an **"Open it on your phone"** card with two buttons: **"Print the sign"** and **"Copy the link"**. More detail in [Poster, chat and social](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/poster-chat-and-social/).

## Pending reminders

Analytics shows the full "what's missing" list; other sections only show a one-line count of pending tasks. The full list is in [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/troubleshooting/#pending-reminders).

## The dashboard footer

Three links: **"Help"** (here, help.yammbo.com), **"What's new"** (blog.yammbo.com) and **"Legal"**. Next to them, the switch to toggle light and dark mode.

## The greeting

At the top you'll see "Hi, \<your name>" with "Here is what is happening at \<your shop> today." — or "Here is what is happening at your shop today." if you haven't set a public name yet.

en.title: Design and branding: themes, Your brand, home banner
en.description: Choosing your shop's visual theme, setting colors and logo in Your brand, and the sizes and formats for each image.
en.body:
## Design (`/dashboard/theme`)

"Your shop design" — "Choose how your online shop looks. Your colors and logo (in Your brand) go on top of any design, and your products, prices and stock keep coming from Loyverse."

Store offers 4 themes (no "Classic", which is Yammbo POS's supermarket layout). You start on **Minimal** by default.

| Theme | Good for |
|---|---|
| **Minimal** | Clean and white, square photos with no borders. Fits any shop |
| **Editorial** | Full-height cover, serif headlines, portrait photos — fashion, shoes, beauty |
| **Boutique** | Arched photo, warm background, large pieces — jewelry, crafts, home decor |
| **Catalog** | Dense and fast: categories on top, more products per row, price up front — electronics, hardware |
