Each theme card has a **"Preview"** link that opens your real shop with that theme applied, without affecting what customers see yet. The **"Use this design"** button applies it for real and confirms: "Design saved. Your customers see it now."

Important note: all four themes use the first image of your home banner (below) as the cover's first slide; if you haven't uploaded one, they use your best-selling product's photo.

## Your brand (`/dashboard/brand`)

"Your brand" — "How your shop looks: your colours, your logo and the image it shares with."

### Colors

- **Main colour** — used for buttons, links and prices.
- **Background**, **Top accent**, **Bottom accent**.
- **Text on the colour** and **Text on the background** (automatic by default).
- **Borders** (automatic).
- **"Back to black and white"** button to start fresh.
- A live preview ("How it looks") and contrast warnings when needed.

### The logo

**"Show the shop name too"** checkbox — "Turn it off if your logo already has the name in it: otherwise it shows twice."

### Images and sizes

| Image | Size | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| **Logo** | — | Your shop's header |
| **Icon** | 512×512 or bigger | Browser tab and app install icon |
| **App icon** | 512×512, with a background | If you have the installable-app add-on |
| **Sharing image** | 1200×630 | What shows when your link is shared on social media |

Formats: PNG, JPG, WebP or AVIF. SVG isn't accepted, for safety. Each image is cropped and resized for you — the editor lets you choose which part to keep before confirming with **"Use this part"**.

### Home banner

5 cards at **1440×620 px**. In Store: "The five cards at the top of the catalogue. Yours go first, in this order and with no gaps: upload only 3 and 5 and they show as first and second. Whatever is left fills with your best sellers, and each card you upload drops the weakest automatic one."

With an active theme (Minimal, Editorial, Boutique or Catalog) you won't see the classic row of banner cards: the **first card** feeds the homepage cover and the **second** feeds the "Our shop" block at the bottom of the page.

## Your shop's homepage

With an active theme, the homepage builds itself from what you already have: the first banner card (or your best-selling product) as the main image, your three categories with the most products, and — if at least two are true — lines like "In-store pickup", "Home delivery", "Secure card payment" or "Help on WhatsApp". At the end there's an "Our shop" block if you have a description, and "Follow us on Instagram" if you connected that network.

## Next step

With your shop looking like your own, check how to manage what comes in: [Orders](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/orders/).

en.title: Frequently asked questions
en.description: Quick answers about Loyverse, products, shipping, payments and pricing in Yammbo Store.
en.body:
## Can I create products from the Yammbo Store dashboard?

No. Products, prices, variants, stock, categories and taxes are always created and edited in your Loyverse till. In the Store dashboard you only add extra photos and the shipping weight. See [Products](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/products/).

## Do I have to connect my own Loyverse till?

No. Yammbo creates your Loyverse account and connects it during sign-up; you never touch a connection button. In Settings you only see that connection's status and the "Sync now" button. See [What is Yammbo Store?](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/what-is-yammbo-store/).

## How long does a Loyverse change take to show in my shop?

Up to 10 minutes for price, name or photos; stock updates instantly and is also re-checked every 30 minutes. If you don't want to wait, press "Sync now" in Settings.

## Is there a free trial?

No. Yammbo Store doesn't offer a free trial period; billing for the plan starts the moment you pick it during sign-up. See [Plan, add-ons and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/plan-pricing-and-billing/).

## How much does it cost?

The "Yammbo" plan costs $90 USD a month per location, with no per-order commission. Each extra location costs another $90/month. There are three optional per-location add-ons: "Your shop as an app" ($15), "Advanced inventory" ($30) and "Unlimited history" ($10). See [Plan, add-ons and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/plan-pricing-and-billing/).

## Can I offer delivery with my own drivers?

No. In Yammbo Store, home delivery is parcel shipping only, through Shippo. Own-driver delivery and the DoorDash/Uber integration are exclusive to Yammbo POS.

## Can my shop take cash or tips?

No. Yammbo Store's checkout only accepts card payment, inside the page itself, and doesn't offer a tipping option.

## Why doesn't home delivery show up at my shop's checkout?

You need all three: parcel shipping turned on, a complete location address in Loyverse, and a connected Shippo account. See [Shipping with Shippo](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/shipping-with-shippo/).

## Do my opening hours block orders if I mark "closed"?

No. The hours you set in Settings are informational only ("Open now" / "Closed now"); they don't stop a customer from placing an order outside those hours.

## Can I invite someone else from my team to the dashboard?

Not from the dashboard itself: email support@yammbo.com and we'll set up the additional user for you.

## Where do I ask for help if none of this answers my question?

Email **support@yammbo.com** telling us what you expected to happen. Before that, check [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/troubleshooting/) — it covers most cases.

en.title: Orders: statuses, prep, shipping label, cancel and refund
en.description: How an order moves from start to finish in Yammbo Store, which button to press at each step, how to print the label and how to cancel with a refund.
en.body:
The Orders screen (`/dashboard/analytics` — yes, the URL still says "analytics") is shown in Spanish today, even if you browse in English. Below are the literal labels you'll see, with what they mean.

## The order lifecycle

An order comes in already **paid and confirmed** — there's no "accept" or "reject" step for a new order.

Confirmado (Confirmed) → En preparación (In progress) → Listo (Ready) → Entregado (Delivered) — or Cancelado (Cancelled).

If you press "Entregado al repartidor" (Handed to the driver) on the Prep screen, the order moves to "En camino" (On the way) and the customer sees it that way. From Orders, "Marcar entregado" (Mark delivered) closes it the same from either "Listo" or "En camino".

## The Orders section

"Toca uno para ver los artículos, el contacto y las acciones. Los pedidos por preparar están en Preparación." ("Tap one to see the items, contact details and actions. Orders to prep are under Picking.") You'll see two lists, **"En curso (N)"** (In progress) and **"Cerrados (N)"** (Closed), with the last 80 orders. The page refreshes itself every 25 seconds.

Buttons depending on the current status:

| Current status | Button (shown in Spanish) | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Confirmed | **"Empezar a preparar"** | Start preparing |
| In progress | **"Marcar listo"** | Mark ready |
| Ready | **"Marcar entregado"** | Mark delivered |
| On the way | **"Marcar entregado"** | Mark delivered |

## The order detail

Cliente (Customer), Teléfono (Phone), **Entrega** (Delivery — "Envío a domicilio" / "Recoge en el local", i.e. home delivery or local pickup), Dirección (Address, with a Google Maps link), **Paquetería** (the chosen carrier), **Seguimiento** (Tracking, with a link), Referencia (Reference), Nota (Note), and whether it's Cancelado (Cancelled).

## Shipping label

If the order ships by parcel, the label is bought automatically as soon as it's paid. From the order detail you can:

- **"Imprimir etiqueta"** (Print label) — opens the Shippo PDF.
- **"Reintentar etiqueta"** (Retry label) — shows up if the purchase failed.

While it's being bought you'll see "Comprando la etiqueta de envío…" (Buying the shipping label…); if it fails, the exact reason appears next to the retry button. See more cases in [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/troubleshooting/).

## Cancel and refund

Only available on Confirmed, In progress or Ready orders, with the **"Cancelar y reembolsar"** (Cancel and refund) button. It opens the "Cancelar el pedido" dialog:

> "El cliente verá el motivo y se le devolverá el dinero automáticamente, en Stripe y en Loyverse." ("The customer will see the reason and get their money back automatically, in Stripe and in Loyverse.")

You have to write a **Motivo** (Reason) — for example, "we ran out of that size"; without one you can't confirm: "Escribe un motivo para poder cancelar." (Write a reason to be able to cancel.)

When you cancel, in this order: the Shippo label is refunded (if any), the Stripe charge is refunded, the Loyverse sale is refunded (restocking the item), and a cancellation email goes to the customer. There are no partial refunds: the whole order is cancelled.

If something fails during that process you'll see: "Pedido cancelado, pero el reembolso falló:" (Order cancelled, but the refund failed:) with a list of what couldn't be undone (for example, the Shippo label), so you can fix it manually in that service.

## What the buyer gets

- An email **"Order \<code> confirmed · \<your shop>"** with the invoice (lines, total, taxes included in price if that applies, address or pickup, and how it was paid).
- If you cancel, **"Order \<code> cancelled · \<your shop>"** with the reason and the refund status.
- On their order page they can turn on **"Notify me of changes"** to get a browser notification.

## Next step

For whoever packs the order physically, see [the Prep screen](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/prep-screen/).

en.title: Payments with Stripe: connecting, statuses, taxes and refunds
en.description: How to connect your Stripe account in Yammbo Store, what each status means, where the money goes, how taxes are calculated and how refunds work.
en.body:
The Payments screen (`/dashboard/payments`) is shown in Spanish today, even if you browse in English. Below are the literal labels you'll see, translated inline.

## Where the money goes

Yammbo Store uses **Stripe Connect** accounts with direct charges: the money from every sale lands directly in your shop's own Stripe account, not Yammbo's. The dashboard puts it plainly: "El dinero va directo a la cuenta de la tienda." (The money goes directly to the shop's account.)

You have a single Stripe account for all your locations, if you have more than one.

## Connecting your account (`/dashboard/payments`)

Press **"Conectar cobros"** (Connect payments), which takes you to Stripe's onboarding form. Depending on where you are in the process, the button changes to **"Continuar en Stripe"** (Continue on Stripe) if you left onboarding half-done or if Stripe needs something more from you, or, once the account is ready, to **"Revisar la cuenta en Stripe"** (Review the account on Stripe).

If the link to Stripe expired, you'll see: "El enlace caducó. Vuelve a pulsar para continuar." (The link expired. Click again to continue.)

### Account statuses

| Status (shown in Spanish) | Meaning |
|---|---|
| "Cobro online sin conectar." | You haven't started onboarding yet |
| "Alta empezada, sin enviar." | You started Stripe's form but didn't submit it |
| "Formulario enviado. Stripe pide algo más." | Stripe needs an extra piece of information to activate you |
| "Listo para cobrar." | Your shop can now accept card payments |
| "No se pudo consultar la cuenta." | A one-off failure checking status with Stripe |

The account detail shows your ID, country and currency, whether onboarding was submitted, whether the card is enabled, whether you can charge and whether you receive payouts — plus lists of what Stripe still needs, what it rejected and what it's reviewing, when relevant.

## While it isn't ready

Your shop looks the same, but can't take payment: "This shop is not taking online orders yet. You can browse the products, but you cannot pay here yet."

## How the buyer pays

On the web, payment only happens by card, **inside the page itself**, in the "Payment" step of checkout (with a "Back to my details" option to go back); there's no cash and no tipping in that checkout. Chat orders are paid with a card link if your payments are ready; if not, they're left to pay on pickup.

## Taxes

Taxes are defined by your Loyverse till, not by Stripe. There are two modes:

- **Included** — "Prices include tax."
- **Added** — "Tax is added to the price and shown below."

Yammbo Store respects which locations each tax applies to, exactly as you've set it up in Loyverse.

## Refunds

When you cancel an order from [Orders](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/orders/), the Stripe refund is automatic and doesn't require you to open your Stripe account. Yammbo Store's plan charges no per-order commission (0%), so there's nothing extra to refund on that side. There are no partial refunds: the whole order is refunded.

## Next step

Set the rest of your shop's details in [Settings](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/settings/).

en.title: Plan, add-ons and billing
en.description: The price of the Yammbo Store plan, per-location add-ons, how to change or cancel through the Stripe portal, and what happens if a payment fails.
en.body:
## The plan

Yammbo Store has a single plan, **"Yammbo"**:

| Item | Price |
|---|---|
| Plan, 1 location included | $90 USD/month |
| Each additional location | $90 USD/month |
| Per-order commission | 0% |

It includes an online shop, card payments, Loyverse employees, your own branding and abandoned-cart recovery. Your Loyverse till is included too: Yammbo sets it up, pays for it and keeps it running.

Yammbo Store doesn't offer a free trial period. Billing starts the moment you pick a plan during sign-up.

## Add-ons per location

| Add-on | Price |
|---|---|
| Your shop as an app | $15/mo |
| Advanced inventory | $30/mo |
| Unlimited history | $10/mo |

"Reparto con tus repartidores" (your own delivery drivers) is a Yammbo POS add-on. In Store, delivery is parcel shipping only (Shippo), so that add-on isn't offered here.

"Prices in US dollars, taxes apart. Change plan or cancel whenever you like from your panel; no lock-in."

## My plan (`/dashboard/plan`)

"Your plan" — "What you pay for having your shop online." You'll see your status (**"Active"**, **"Payment due"** or **"Paused"**), the button to subscribe or switch plan, your invoices ("Your invoices"), and per-location add-ons you can **"Add"** or **"Remove"**.

## Changing or cancelling through the Stripe portal

The **"Manage my subscription"** button — "Change the card, see invoices or cancel." — takes you to Stripe's secure portal, where you can change your card, download invoices or cancel your subscription.

## If there's a payment due or the account is paused

With a payment due, the dashboard warns: "There is a payment due: your shop takes no orders until it is settled. Your catalogue and data are untouched." The effect on your customers is more visible: while there's a payment due or the account is paused, they see "Orders paused" instead of your shop — only the info page stays open, with the location's phone and address. Your data isn't lost; everything comes back as soon as you resolve it from "Manage my subscription".

## Next step

See what else you can show off with [the poster, chat and social](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/poster-chat-and-social/).

en.title: Poster with QR, chat (Yammbot) and social (Buffer)
en.description: The printable poster for your store, connecting WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and Telegram to take orders by chat, and posting products with Buffer.
en.body:
## The QR poster

On the dashboard you have an **"Open it on your phone"** card with a QR code that leads straight to your shop, and two buttons: **"Print the sign"** and **"Copy the link"**.

"Print the sign" opens the **"Sign"** page (`/dashboard/cartel`), ready to print: the headline **"Shop from your phone"**, the text "Scan the code, fill your basket and pick it up or have it delivered.", the steps "Scan" → "Fill your basket" → "Pick up or get it delivered", and the **"Print"** button, with the tip: "Tip: print it and stick it where people wait — the counter, the door, the table."

If your shop doesn't have a public address set up yet, you'll see "Your shop has no public address yet." instead of the poster.

## Chat channels (WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram)

These channels use the **Yammbot** app on your business's phone to automatically reply with your catalogue and take orders over chat.

The WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and Telegram setup screens in the dashboard are shown in Spanish today, regardless of your browser language.

To connect a channel, the dashboard gives you an 8-character pairing code (no I, O, 0 or 1) next to a QR. It expires in 15 minutes and works only once. Scan it, or type the code, from the Yammbot app on your business's phone. Connecting a new phone disconnects the previous one.

The pairing link that opens on your phone is titled "Connect WhatsApp to Yammbo POS" (or Instagram/Messenger/Telegram) — a leftover of the wording shared with Yammbo POS. It works the same in Store.

In Yammbo Store, orders placed through WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger or Telegram can only be for in-store pickup — home delivery isn't offered through this channel.

The phone with Yammbot needs to stay on and with the app open: it only replies to people who message it, it doesn't start conversations on its own and it doesn't post in groups.

## Social (Buffer)

Under **"Social"** (`/dashboard/social`) you can connect your **Buffer** account to post a product you pick by hand — with its photo and price — to your social networks without leaving the dashboard.

This integration doesn't yet have a long track record of real-world use. If you try it and something doesn't post as expected, email support@yammbo.com.

## Next step

See what your shop looks like from the other side: [The store your customer sees](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/the-customer-facing-store/).

en.title: The Prep screen
en.description: The link for your packing tablet, phone alerts, and how to print an order from the Prep screen in Yammbo Store.
en.body:
In the sidebar this is called **"Picking"**. In Store it's the same screen a restaurant calls "Kitchen", renamed for packing rather than cooking. It's meant to stay open on a tablet while someone packs orders.

## Setting it up (`/dashboard/kitchen`)

The setup screen at `/dashboard/kitchen` is shown in Spanish regardless of your browser language. Here's what each button means.

For each location you'll see:

- **"Crear acceso"** (Create access) — or **"Generar un enlace nuevo"** (Generate a new link) if you already had one — creates the `/kds/<token>` link to open on the tablet.
- **"Última vez abierta"** (Last opened) — when that link was last used.
- **"Mostrar las ventas del TPV"** / **"Ocultar las ventas del TPV"** (Show / Hide till sales) — to also see sales made directly at your Loyverse till on the same screen.
- **"Phone alerts"** → **"Alert me on this device"** (this box does show in English) — rings when a new order comes into this location, even with the Picking screen closed.

The Prep screen link is the key: it asks for no password. If you lose it or switch tablets, generate a new one and the old one stops working instantly.

## The screen itself (`/kds/<token>`)

This screen follows the device's own language, so it shows in English on an English phone or tablet. Title **"Order prep"**, with the **"In progress"** column and a **"Print order ticket"** button for each order.

Printing works with a thermal printer through the Android prep app, or with your browser's own print dialog.

Loyverse doesn't announce open tickets at the till: an order only shows up here once it has actually been paid.

If an order ships to the customer's home, you may see buttons with courier wording ("Request a driver", "Handed to the driver") inherited from the screen shared with Yammbo POS, even though Store has no own couriers. To mark the order as delivered, use the [Orders](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/orders/) flow in the dashboard instead.

## Next step

If you ship to customers' homes, set up your account in [Shipping with Shippo](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/shipping-with-shippo/).

en.title: Products: extra photos, weight and what comes from your till
en.description: In Yammbo Store, products are created in Loyverse. In the dashboard you only add extra photos and shipping weight, and you can see what you can change and where.
en.body:
There is no screen in Yammbo Store to add a new product. The whole catalogue — name, price, stock, variants, categories and taxes — is created and edited in your Loyverse till. The dashboard only adds what Loyverse doesn't store: extra photos and weight.

## Changing price, stock or name

Edit them directly in Loyverse. The change shows in your shop within 10 minutes (stock, instantly). If you don't want to wait, use **"Sync now"** in Settings.

## The Products section (`/dashboard/products`)

Subtitle: "Name, price and stock come from Loyverse. Here you add extra photos (they show in the product sheet) and, if needed, the product weight for shipping."

- Search box **"Search product"** and filter **"All categories"**, 24 products per page.
- Each row shows the Loyverse thumbnail ("Loyverse photo"), the name, the category, any extra photos already uploaded with **★** ("Make first") and **×** ("Remove") buttons, the **"Add photos"** button (accepts several at once), and the **"Weight (lb, packed)"** field with its **"Save"** button.

## Extra photos

- Up to **6 extra photos per product**.
- Supported formats: PNG, JPG, WebP or AVIF. They're resized in your browser to 1600 px before uploading, with a 3 MB limit.
- They show in the product page, after the photo it already has from Loyverse.
- If the upload fails, you'll see: "Could not upload that photo."

## Weight for shipping

The **"Weight (lb, packed)"** field only matters if you ship with [Shippo](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/shipping-with-shippo/). It's in pounds, up to a maximum of 150, and accepts a comma or a dot as the decimal separator.

If you leave it empty, the placeholder tells you what weight will be used instead: **"Uses X lb (category)"** or **"Uses X lb (shop default)"**. The priority order is: product weight → category weight → the shop's general weight.

## Variants and categories

- Variants (size, color…) are whatever you've set up in Loyverse. In your shop, a product with variants shows as a **single card**, and the customer picks the variant when they tap it.
- Categories are also Loyverse's: empty ones hide on their own and new ones appear as soon as they sync.

## Products that can't be sold online

- A product with a **variable price** can't be sold through the website.
- An item sold **by weight** in Loyverse sells in your shop as a sealed package at whatever price you show, with a reminder in the dashboard so you know.

## Next step

So your shop isn't black and white, continue with [Design and branding](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/design-and-branding/).

en.title: Settings: name, web address, social, hours and Loyverse
en.description: Everything you configure in Yammbo Store Settings — shop details, social links, hours, delivery and pickup, alerts and the Loyverse connection.
en.body:
Everything your Loyverse till doesn't store — hours, delivery, social links and alerts — is configured here. When you're done, press **"Save changes"**: "Settings saved. They are live in the store."

## The shop

- **Public name** — if you leave it empty, Loyverse's name is used.
- **Description** — the tagline that shows on your homepage.
- **Your web address** — the slug you share your shop with (`store.yammbo.com/<slug>`). The dashboard itself warns: "Es el enlace que repartes a tus clientes. Si lo cambias, los que ya diste dejan de funcionar. Solo minúsculas, números y guiones." ("It's the link you hand out to your customers. If you change it, the ones you've already given out stop working. Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only.")

If your new web address isn't valid, the error message appears in Spanish regardless of your dashboard language.

| Message (shown in Spanish) | Cause |
|---|---|
| "La dirección web solo admite minúsculas, números y guiones." | You used uppercase, spaces or unsupported characters |
| «"x" está reservado por el sistema. Elige otro.» | The slug matches a system route (panel, kds, order, api, admin, info, checkout, legal, privacidad, terminos, login, alta, dashboard, etc.) |
| «"x" ya lo está usando otro restaurante.» | That slug is already used by another shop on the platform |

## Social media

Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X and WhatsApp, plus your own website if you have one.

## Opening hours

Set your hours day by day, with **"Copy Monday to the rest"** so you don't repeat the same hours seven times, and your business's time zone.

The hours you set in Settings only control whether your shop shows as open or closed on the info page. They don't block orders: a customer can still place one outside those hours.

## Delivery and pickup

- **"Allow pickup at the store"**
- **"Allow delivery"** — delivery itself is configured in [Shipping](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/shipping-with-shippo/); here you only turn it on or off. The dashboard adds: "Home delivery is handled through parcel shipping (Shippo). Set it up in Shipping."
- **"Minimum order"**
- **"Free delivery over"** — the same value you see in Shipping.

## Alerts

**"New-order alert URL"** — an optional webhook (https POST) that fires every time a new order comes in, if you want to wire it into another tool of your own.

## Loyverse connection

Store-only: a card showing the sync status with your till.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| "Not synced yet" | Loyverse hasn't run its first sync yet |
| "Connected" | Everything is working normally |
| "No sync for a while." | More than 45 minutes without a successful run |
| "Something failed in the last sync." (or the literal error) | The last sync run ended in an error |

**"Sync now"** button — at most once a minute:

- "Synced with Loyverse."
- "It was just synced: try again in a minute."
- "Loyverse did not answer. Look at the connection card below."

## Next step

Check who buys from you and how you're doing in [Analytics and customers](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/analytics-and-customers/).

en.title: Shipping with Shippo: connect, package, rates and labels
en.description: How to connect your Shippo account step by step, set up your package and weights, free shipping, carriers and labels in Yammbo Store.
en.body:
In Yammbo Store, home delivery is **parcel shipping only**, through **Shippo**: there's no flat-rate delivery, own couriers or DoorDash/Uber. In-store pickup is always the other option.

Parcel shipping only works with US addresses and in USD. With another currency, home delivery is not available.

## 1. Connect your Shippo account

In **Shipping** (`/dashboard/shipping`), the **"Your Shippo account"** card walks you through:

1. "Create a free account at goshippo.com."
2. "Add a card in Settings › Billing: Shippo charges you for each label."
3. "In Settings › API copy your Live Token (or the Test Token to try it out first)."
4. "Paste it here."

Paste the token into the **"Shippo token"** field and press **"Connect"**. Once it works you'll see "Connected (••••1234 · Live|Test)" with an option to **"Disconnect"**.

Note from the dashboard itself: "UPS and FedEx need to be enabled in your own Shippo (Settings › Carriers). USPS comes enabled."

### Errors when connecting

Key validation happens on the server and its error messages are in Spanish today, regardless of your dashboard language.

| Message (shown in Spanish) | Cause |
|---|---|
| "Esa no parece una clave de Shippo: empieza por "shippo_live_" o "shippo_test_"." | The token doesn't have the right format |
| "Shippo no acepta esa clave." | Shippo rejected it while validating |
| "No pudimos comprobarla ahora, prueba en un minuto." | A one-off failure validating against Shippo |

Shippo charges per printed label, with no prepaid balance — each label is charged to your Shippo account the moment it's bought.

The dashboard warns: "Meanwhile a Yammbo test key is used: labels are samples." Those labels don't actually ship anything — don't accept real shipping orders until you connect your own Shippo account. With no Shippo account connected at all, your shop simply doesn't offer home delivery.

## 2. Turn shipping on

Under **"Status"**, turn on **"Ship orders by parcel"**. Turning it off also turns off home delivery for your customers (they're left with in-store pickup only, if you offer it).

## 3. The address you ship from

It's taken from your location **in Loyverse** — the dashboard says it plainly: "Taken from your location in Loyverse. To change it, edit the location there."

If something's missing, you'll see: "Your ship-from address is missing. Fill it in Loyverse › Settings › Stores › your store (street, city, state and ZIP code); it updates here within minutes. Until then your shop does not offer home delivery." And if the location's phone or email is missing: "Carriers (USPS) require the seller phone and email on the label. Add a phone to your location in Loyverse or complete your contact details."

## 4. Free shipping

Under "Free shipping" → **"From ($)"**: "0 = never. From this subtotal (after coupons) the customer pays no shipping; the shop still buys the label." In other words, you still pay for the label to Shippo; what you're waiving is just the charge to the customer.

## 5. Your usual package and weights

"Your usual package": Length, Width and Height in inches, **"Box weight (lb)"** and **"Weight per item (lb)"**. Defaults: 12×10×4 inches, 0.3 lb box and 0.6 lb per item. The formula is simple: total weight = box weight + (weight per item × number of items).

You can also set a **"Weight by category"**, one field per category that has products. The priority order to work out an order's weight is: the product's own weight (in [Products](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/products/)) → its category's weight → the shop's general weight.

Press **"Save"** when done; it confirms with "Saved."

## What the customer sees at checkout

1. They choose **home delivery** and type their address — with nearby suggestions —, apartment (optional), city, state and ZIP code.
2. While it's calculating they'll see "Getting shipping options…" and then up to **4 real carrier rates** (USPS, UPS, FedEx…), each with its estimate in business days.
3. The order summary shows the shipping cost, and if they're close to free shipping: "Add $X more for free shipping" or "You have free shipping".
4. Once payment is confirmed, the label is purchased automatically.

A quoted rate only stays valid for 30 minutes and only for that same address, that same weight and that same customer — if anything changes, the buyer has to pick shipping again.

## Retrying a failed label

From [Orders](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/orders/), the **"Reintentar etiqueta"** (Retry label) button quotes again with the same carrier service or the cheapest one available; if it comes out more expensive than the first time, your shop absorbs the difference, not the customer.

## Next step

If you want to offer discounts, continue with [Coupons](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/coupons/).

en.title: Signing in
en.description: How to sign in to your Yammbo Store dashboard with your email and a one-time code, how long it lasts, how many attempts you get and what each error means.
en.body:
Yammbo Store doesn't use passwords. You sign in with your email and a one-time code.

The sign-in page (`store.yammbo.com/login`) is shown in Spanish today, even if your browser is set to English. Here's what each piece of text means.

## Steps

1. Go to `store.yammbo.com/login` — "Te mandamos un código para entrar." ("We'll send you a code to sign in.")
2. Enter your email and press **"Enviar código"** ("Send code").
3. You'll see: "Si \<your email> tiene acceso, le acaba de llegar un código de 6 dígitos. Caduca en 10 minutos." ("If \<your email> has access, a 6-digit code just arrived. It expires in 10 minutes.") Enter the code and press **"Entrar"** ("Sign in").

If you typed the wrong email, use the **"Usar otro correo"** ("Use another email") link to go back.

If you don't have an account yet, the login page itself has a link: "¿Aún no vendes con nosotros? Crea tu cuenta" ("Not selling with us yet? Create your account").

## Expiry and attempts

- The code **expires in 10 minutes**.
- You get **5 attempts** to enter it correctly; after that you need to request a new one.
- Requesting a new code cancels the previous one.
- Once in, your session lasts **30 days**.
- `store.yammbo.com/` with no path redirects straight to `/login`.

## Errors

| Message (shown in Spanish) | What happened |
|---|---|
| "Esa dirección no parece un correo." | The email you typed isn't a valid format |
| "No se pudo enviar el correo. Inténtalo de nuevo en un minuto." | A one-off failure sending the email; wait a moment and try again |
| "Ese código no es correcto." | The code doesn't match the one that was sent |
| "El código caducó. Pide uno nuevo." | More than 10 minutes passed since you requested it |
| "Demasiados intentos. Pide un código nuevo." | You used up your 5 attempts |

## Additional users

The owner cannot invite additional users from the dashboard itself: if you need someone else on your team to have access, email support@yammbo.com and we'll set them up.

## Next step

Once you're in, check the [dashboard map](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/dashboard-map/) to find your way around.

en.title: The store your customer sees
en.description: What the Yammbo Store storefront looks like for a buyer — URL, homepage, search, cart, checkout, language, order tracking and invoice.
en.body:
## The URL

Your shop lives at `store.yammbo.com/<your-shop>/`. If you have more than one location, each one has its own address: `store.yammbo.com/<your-shop>/<location>/`. There's also `…/info` (contact details and hours), `…/checkout`, and for every order, `store.yammbo.com/order/<id>`.

## The homepage

With an active theme (see [Design and branding](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/design-and-branding/)), the homepage builds a carousel — collection, name and tagline —, your categories with the most products, and a final "Our shop" block if you wrote a description. If you connected Instagram, "Follow us on Instagram" shows up too.

## Search and categories

Your customer can search for a product by name or browse by category. Out-of-stock items, items with a variable price, or items you don't sell at that location simply **disappear** from the catalogue — they aren't shown crossed out.

## The product page and variants

A product with variants (size, color…) shows as a single card: tapping it lets your customer pick the variant and any available extras, then press "Add" to add it to the cart. The photo gallery shows the Loyverse photo first, then the extra photos you uploaded in [Products](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/products/).

## "Order your last shop again?"

The homepage may show this question, with the **"Add it to my cart"** button. It's based on the last purchase saved on the customer's own device (up to 90 days), with today's prices; anything no longer available is left out.

## The cart and checkout

The cart is per location. At checkout, your customer types:

- **Name**, **Phone** (required) and **Email** (required, to send them the invoice).
- **Delivery**: "Pick up at the shop" (showing the location's name, address and phone) or home delivery (with an address — see [Shipping with Shippo](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/shipping-with-shippo/)).
- An optional **note** for the order.
- A **discount code**, if they have one — see [Coupons](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/coupons/).

The summary shows discount, taxes and shipping before the total. Confirming with **"Place order"** moves to the **"Payment"** step.

Payment happens inside the same page, card only. Yammbo Store doesn't offer a cash option or a tip at checkout.

Their details are saved on their own device for next time ("We keep your details on this device for next time.").

## Language

Spanish or English, detected automatically from the browser; it can also be picked from the "Español / English" selector in the footer.

## Order tracking

At `store.yammbo.com/order/<id>` your customer sees their order status live (the page refreshes itself). For pickup: Confirmed → Being prepared → Ready for pickup → Delivered. By parcel: Confirmed → Being prepared → Packed → On the way → Delivered, with the tracking number and a **"Track my parcel"** button to the carrier's website. They can turn on "Notify me of changes" for a browser notification when the status changes.

If it was cancelled, they'll see "Order cancelled." with the reason and confirmation that the refund went to their card.

## The invoice

Once the order is confirmed, the customer gets an invoice by email with your shop's name as the visible sender, with the line items, total, taxes and how it was paid.

## Next step

If something isn't working as expected, check [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/troubleshooting/).

en.title: Troubleshooting
en.description: Every error message and reminder in Yammbo Store, what it means and what to do about it — in the storefront, checkout, dashboard and sync.
en.body:
Orders, Payments, Analytics, Customers, the Picking setup screen, and a few validation messages (coupon creation, Shippo key checks) are shown in Spanish today, even when you browse in English. Those are marked below.

## On the storefront

| What the customer sees | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| "This shop is not taking online orders yet. You can browse the products, but you cannot pay here yet." | Stripe isn't fully connected, online payment is off, or the location is over the plan's limit | Finish connecting in [Payments with Stripe](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/payments-with-stripe/); check [My plan](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/plan-pricing-and-billing/) |
| "Orders paused" | The account is unpaid or paused | Check [My plan](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/plan-pricing-and-billing/) |
| Home delivery doesn't show up at checkout | One of three things is missing: parcel shipping turned on, a complete ship-from address in Loyverse, or a connected Shippo account | See [Shipping with Shippo](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/shipping-with-shippo/) |

## At checkout

| Message | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| "This shop only ships by parcel and has not set it up yet." | Delivery is on but parcel mode isn't | In Shipping, turn on "Ship orders by parcel" |
| "The shop has not completed its shipping address yet." | Street, city, state or ZIP is missing on the Loyverse location | Fill in those details in Loyverse › Settings › Stores › your store |
| "Check the address: street, city, state (2 letters) and ZIP code." | The customer entered an incomplete or malformed address | Ask them to fix the form |
| "We could not price shipping to that address. Check the street and ZIP code." | Shippo didn't return rates for that address | Check the address; check which carriers are enabled in your Shippo account |
| "Parcel shipping is not available right now." | No Shippo key connected, currency other than USD, or the hourly quote limit was hit | Connect Shippo; if it's the limit, wait a few minutes |
| "The shipping option expired or the address changed. Choose shipping again." | More than 30 minutes passed since the quote, or the address, items or contact details changed | The customer needs to pick shipping again |
| "Too many different products for one parcel. Split the order in two." | More than 200 distinct lines in one order | Ask them to split it into two orders |
| "That code does not exist or is no longer active." and the rest of the coupon errors | See [Coupons](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/coupons/) | Review your coupons |

If a product's stock, availability or price changed in Loyverse between browsing and checking out, the cart shows the warning in Spanish, even on an English checkout.

| Message (shown in Spanish) | Cause |
|---|---|
| «"‹product›": quedan N y se piden M» | Not enough stock left for the quantity ordered |
| «"‹product›" no está disponible en esta tienda» | The item isn't sold at that location anymore |
| «"‹product›" tiene precio variable y no se puede vender online» | The price changed to variable in Loyverse |

## In Orders (dashboard)

Every message below is shown in Spanish regardless of your dashboard language.

| Message | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| «No se pudo comprar la etiqueta de envío: La tienda no tiene conectada su cuenta de Shippo» | The Shippo key was missing at the moment of charging | Connect Shippo and press "Reintentar etiqueta" |
| «…: Shippo no respondió a tiempo. Mira en Shippo si la etiqueta existe antes de reintentar.» | Shippo timed out; the label may have been bought anyway | Check your Shippo account before retrying |
| «…: La compra de la etiqueta quedó a medias. Mira en Shippo si existe antes de reintentar.» | The purchase stayed half-done for more than 10 minutes | Check Shippo before retrying |
| «No pudimos reembolsar la etiqueta: hazlo desde tu cuenta de Shippo (Transactions › Refund).» | The Shippo key was changed or removed, or Shippo rejected the refund | Refund the label manually from your Shippo account |
| «Pedido cancelado, pero el reembolso falló: …» | Stripe, Loyverse or Shippo failed during cancellation | Resolve the refund manually in the service named |
| «No se pudo registrar en tu TPV: ‹error›» | The order was charged but the sale didn't reach Loyverse | Check your [Loyverse connection](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/settings/#loyverse-connection) |
| «La caja registró $X y al cliente se le cobraron $Y. Revisa el recibo en Loyverse.» | Known mismatch: shipping doesn't always fit in the Loyverse receipt | Check the receipt directly in Loyverse |

## In Products

| Message | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| "Could not upload that photo." | Unsupported format, over 3 MB, you already have 6 extra photos, or the product isn't yours | Upload a PNG, JPG, WebP or AVIF up to 3 MB; remove one if you already have 6 |

## Syncing with Loyverse

| Message | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| "No sync for a while." | More than 45 minutes without a successful run | Press "Sync now"; if it persists, email support |
| "Something failed in the last sync." | The last run ended in an error | Press "Sync now"; if it persists, email support |
| A new product, photo or price isn't showing yet | Normal sync delay (up to 10 minutes) | Wait a little or press "Sync now" |

## Sign-in errors

See the full list in [Signing in](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/signing-in/#errors).

## Pending reminders

The dashboard warns you on its own when something needs attention. Full list in Analytics; summarized elsewhere as "N pending tasks".

| Reminder | Urgent | When it shows |
|---|---|---|
| "There is a payment due" / "Your account is paused" | Yes | Your subscription is unpaid or paused |
| "You cannot take payments yet" → "Finish connecting" | Yes | Your Stripe account isn't ready |
| "Your location has no address" | Yes, if you offer delivery | The location's address is missing in Loyverse |
| "Your shop has no opening hours" → "Set the hours" | Yes | You haven't set opening hours |
| "Finish setting up shipping" → "Set up shipping" | No | Delivery is on but parcel setup isn't finished |
| "Your ship-from address is missing" → "Open Shipping" | Yes | The Loyverse ship-from address is incomplete |
| "Connect your Shippo account" → "Connect Shippo" | Yes | You don't have a usable Shippo key |
| "We could not place your location on the map" | No | No coordinates, with delivery turned on |
| "Your web payments land as "Card"" | No | Loyverse has no "Online" payment type |
| "Your shop is still black and white" → "Customise it" | No | No color or logo set yet |
| "Your shop cannot be installed yet" → "Upload the icon" | No | You have the app add-on but no icon |
| "Your link shares with no image" → "Upload the image" | No | Missing sharing image in [Design and branding](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/design-and-branding/) |
| "Some items are sold by weight in your till" | No | You have items sold by weight in Loyverse |

## Worth knowing: things that don't quite work as they sound

These aren't bugs you need to fix — they're current behaviors of Yammbo Store worth knowing about.

- **Hours don't block orders.** Even though the "no hours" reminder talks about blocking orders, in practice the hours only paint "Open now" / "Closed now" on the info page — they never actually stop a customer from ordering.
- **"Minimum order" isn't enforced on parcel-shipped orders.** It shows on the info page, but the parcel order calculation doesn't check it yet.
- **"On the way" does happen in Store.** If you press "Handed to the driver" on the Prep screen, the order moves to "En camino" and the customer sees it that way. From Orders, "Marcar entregado" closes it the same from either "Listo" or "En camino".
- **The info page can show "Delivery fee: Free"** even with real parcel rates configured — that field still reads the flat-rate setting, which is 0 in Store.
- **The emailed invoice doesn't include shipping, discount or tracking** as separate lines.
- **Some text still uses restaurant wording**, for example the duplicate web-address error ("ya lo está usando otro restaurante") or the steps to pair Yammbot ("Connect WhatsApp to Yammbo POS"). It's just wording; it doesn't affect whether your shop works.
- **Orders, Payments, Analytics, Customers and the sign-in page (`/login`) always show in Spanish**, even if your browser is set to English.

## If none of this solves your case

Email **support@yammbo.com** telling us what you expected to happen and, if you can, the exact message you saw.

en.title: What is Yammbo Store and how does it work?
en.description: An online store for businesses that sell products, built on top of your Loyverse register. What each part does, what your customer sees, and how it differs from Yammbo POS.
en.body:
Yammbo Store is the online store for a business that sells products — clothing, footwear, accessories, goods — served at `store.yammbo.com/<your-store>`. To your customers it shows up only under your own brand; to you, the product is called **Yammbo Store** and emails arrive from support@yammbo.com.

## Your register: Loyverse

Store needs a register behind it: **Loyverse**. There is no screen in the dashboard to create products — the name, price, stock, categories and taxes all come from there.

- **You don't connect anything yourself.** During sign-up, Yammbo creates your Loyverse account and connects it for you.
- In the dashboard, the Settings card is literally called **"Loyverse connection"** — in Store the product names Loyverse by its own name.
- A change in Loyverse (price, photo, new product) can take up to 10 minutes to show in your store; stock updates instantly and is also re-checked every 30 minutes. If you don't want to wait, Settings has a **"Sync now"** button.

## What each part does

- **The dashboard** (`store.yammbo.com/dashboard`) — where you sign in: you see orders, add extra photos and weight to your products, pick a design, create coupons, connect Shippo and Stripe.
- **The storefront** (`store.yammbo.com/<your-store>`) — what your customer sees: homepage, catalogue, product page, cart and checkout. See [The store your customer sees](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/the-customer-facing-store/).
- **The Prep screen** — a screen, usually a tablet, where whoever packs orders sees and marks incoming orders.

## Store vs POS

Yammbo Store uses the same dashboard as Yammbo POS, but with its own sections and others that don't exist:

| In Store | |
|---|---|
| Home delivery | Only via parcel carrier (Shippo) — no own couriers, no DoorDash/Uber |
| In-store pickup | Yes |
| **Products**, **Coupons**, **Shipping** | Dashboard sections that only exist in Store |
| **Design** | 4 themes: Minimal, Editorial, Boutique, Catalog |
| Alcohol / age verification | Not used |
| Kitchen screen | Called "Order prep", not "Kitchen" |
| WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram | Visible, but chat orders are pickup-only |

Yammbo POS asks whether you're a restaurant or a shop. Store doesn't need to: your account is always set up as a store.

## Next step

If you don't have an account yet, continue with [Create your account and first steps](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/create-your-account/).

en.title: I can't sign in
en.description: Why signing in fails in each Yammbo product, the message you see in each case and how to get back in.
en.body:
## First: which product are you signing in to?

Each Yammbo product has [its own account](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/account/sign-in/). An account on Yammbo Web doesn't let you into Yammbo Music, and a Yammbo POS account doesn't let you into Yammbo Store. Most "my password doesn't work" cases are an account that exists in one product but not in the one you're trying.

| Product | You sign in with | Go to |
|---|---|---|
| Yammbo POS · Yammbo Store | Email + password on the web; email + code and PIN on the POS tablet | [POS and Store](#pos-and-store) |
| Yammbo Web · Yammbo Music | Email + password, or Google / Twitter | [Web and Music](#web-and-music) |
| Yammbot | Email + password | [Yammbot](#yammbot) |
| Yammbo TV | Email + password | [TV](#tv) |

Capital letters in the **email** don't matter in any product. In the **password** they do.

## POS and Store

On the web you sign in at `pos.yammbo.com/dashboard/login` (POS) or `store.yammbo.com/dashboard/login` (Store) with your **email and password**.

| You see | What it means | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| *Wrong email or password.* | One of them is wrong, or that email has no account in that product | Check you're on the right product, or use **"Forgot my password"** |
| *Please verify your email first.* | You didn't finish confirming the account | Type the code you got when you signed up, or ask for another |
| *The code is wrong or has expired.* | The code is wrong or more than 30 minutes have passed | Ask for a new one and use the latest |
| *Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.* | Many attempts in a row | Wait and try again |
| *This account is disabled.* | The account was disabled | Write to **support@yammbo.com** |

**If you forgot your password:** tap **"Forgot my password"**, type your email and tap **"Send code"**. You get a 6-digit code that works for **30 minutes**. Type it with your new password (10 characters or more). Changing it signs you out everywhere. Sessions last 30 days on that browser.

**On the Yammbo POS tablet** there is no password: the app emails you a code to link it, and then you sign in with your PIN. If the code doesn't arrive, check that you picked **Yammbo POS** under "Where is your account?". See [POS troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/troubleshooting/).

## Web and Music

**Forgot your password:** press **Forgot your password?** on the sign-in screen. You get an email with a link that works for **60 minutes**.

- If the screen says it **can't find a user with that email address**, that email has no account in that product. Try the other email you use, or create an account.
- In Music, after several requests in a short time the screen says **"Too many attempts. Please try again later."** Wait an hour before asking again.

**Wrong email or password:**

- Web shows *"The email or password you entered is incorrect."*
- Music shows *"These credentials do not match our records."*

**Signed up with Google or Twitter (X)?** Your account may not have a password. Use the same Google or Twitter button you used the first time. If you want a password (for example, to use the Music Android app, which only takes email and password), use **Forgot your password?** to create one.

**"Too Many Attempts."** After 5 failed tries in a minute with the same email, Web and Music block that email on that connection for about a minute. Wait, then try again with the right password or reset it.

**It asks for a verification code after signing in:**

- **Web** won't let you use the app until you type the 6-digit code it emailed you when you signed up ("Verify your email"). The code lasts 30 minutes; you can ask for another one on that screen.
- **Music** lets you listen without verifying, but asks you to confirm your email before you subscribe, comment or upload.

**Two-step verification:** only Web and Music have it, and only if you switched it on in your account settings. Type the code from your authenticator app; if it's always rejected, set your phone's clock to automatic time. If you no longer have the app, use one of the recovery codes you saved when you switched it on. The Music Android app has no field for this code.

## Yammbot

The Yammbot sign-in, in the app and at `bot.yammbo.com/entrar`, is in Spanish.

- **Forgot your password:** press **¿Olvidaste tu contraseña?**. You'll see the same message whether the email has an account or not (*"Si existe una cuenta con ese correo, te enviamos un enlace…"*), so if nothing arrives, check you used the email you signed up with. The link works for 60 minutes, and setting a new password signs you out on every device.
- **Wrong email or password:** *"Correo o contraseña incorrectos."*
- **Too many tries:** after 10 failed tries in a minute you'll see *"Demasiados intentos. Espera un minuto y vuelve a probar."* Wait a minute.
- If the link says *"El enlace no es válido o ya caducó"*, it's expired or already used: ask for a new one.

## TV

- Signing in has two steps: type your email, press **Continue**, then the password. The forgot-password link appears in the second step.
- The password reset email is in Spanish; its link works for 60 minutes.
- **Before you can watch, you must confirm your email** with the link sent when you signed up. If you see the "verify your email" page, open that email (it can be in spam). The link works for 48 hours; on that page you can ask for a new one.
- On a TV, the app shows a QR code: scan it with your phone and sign in on the page it opens; the TV then signs in by itself. If you create the account from that page, the TV won't sign in until you confirm your email, and after about 5 minutes the code expires: confirm the email and scan the new code.

## If the page keeps loading or does nothing

- Reload the page (Ctrl+Shift+R on a computer).
- Try a private/incognito window: a browser extension can block the sign-in.
- Try another network, for example mobile data instead of Wi-Fi.

## Still can't get in?

Write to **support@yammbo.com** with:

- The product (POS, Store, Web, Music, Yammbot or TV).
- The email of the account.
- The exact message you see, or a screenshot.

Yammbo never asks for your password or your sign-in code, by email or anywhere else.

en.title: A product is loading slowly
en.description: What to check when a Yammbo page, app or video is slow or doesn't load, and what to send us if it keeps happening.
en.body:
Go through these in order. The first two tell you whether the problem is your device, your network or something on our side.

## 1. Is it only you?

- **Another device on the same network:** if it's slow on every device, look at the network. If it's only slow on one, the problem is on that device.
- **Another network:** try mobile data instead of Wi-Fi, or the other way round. If it's fast on the other network, the problem is that connection.

## 2. Reload the page properly

The browser can keep an old copy of the page.

- **Computer:** Ctrl+Shift+R (Windows / Linux) or Cmd+Shift+R (macOS).
- **Phone:** close the tab and open the address again.
- If you've had the same tab open for hours, close the browser completely and open it again.
- Try a private/incognito window. If it works there, a browser extension is getting in the way.

## 3. Product by product

**Yammbo TV: the video doesn't start or keeps loading.** Some internet providers block the server the videos come from. Change your network's DNS to **1.1.1.1** and **8.8.8.8** (on the router, or on the device), as explained on `tv.yammbo.com/install`. The app for TVs (Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV) checks for a new version each time it opens and offers to install it: accept, because fixes arrive that way.

**Yammbo Music:** see [Music troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/music/troubleshooting/) for playback, the Android app and Chromecast.

**Yammbo POS:** the register works without internet, so if it's slow it's usually the tablet: close other apps and check it has free storage. For printing, syncing between tablets or online orders, see [POS troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/pos/troubleshooting/).

**Yammbo Store:** the register is Loyverse, which has its own app; if the till is slow, that's the Loyverse app. For the dashboard or the online shop, see [Store troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/store/troubleshooting/).

**Yammbo Web:** see [Web troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/web/troubleshooting/), especially if the editor or a published site is the slow part.

**Yammbot:** if replies are slow or don't go out, see [Yammbot isn't replying](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/yammbot/not-replying/).

## When to write to support

If it's still slow on more than one device and network, write to **support@yammbo.com** with:

- The product and the page or screen that's slow.
- The date and time it happened, with your time zone.
- Roughly how long it takes (1 second, 5 seconds, 30 seconds: the difference matters).
- A screenshot or a short video if you can.

en.title: What is Yammbo TV?
en.description: Films and series by subscription, in the browser and in apps for Android phones, TVs and Windows. Account, plans, devices and how to install it.
en.body:
Yammbo TV is a streaming service for **films and series**, by subscription. You watch it at `tv.yammbo.com` or in its apps.

## You need an account and a plan

- Create the account at `tv.yammbo.com/auth/register` with your email and a password. There is no sign-in with Google or other networks.
- **Confirm your email** with the link you receive (it works for 48 hours). Until you do, the player doesn't open.
- To play videos you need an **active plan**.

If you can't get in, see [I can't sign in](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/troubleshooting/cant-sign-in/#tv).

## Plans

| Plan | Monthly | Yearly | Devices at the same time |
|---|---|---|---|
| Basic | $7.99 | $79.98 | 1 |
| Standard | $12.99 | $119.99 | 2 |
| Premium | $19.98 | $179.99 | 3 |

All plans are ad-free. Current prices and offers are at `tv.yammbo.com/pricing`.

- You pay by card, through **Stripe**.
- You manage your plan at `tv.yammbo.com/mi-suscripcion`: from there you open the Stripe portal to change your card, see invoices or cancel.
- When you cancel, you keep access until the end of the period you already paid for.

## Where to watch

| Device | How |
|---|---|
| Computer or phone browser | Go to `tv.yammbo.com` and sign in. |
| Android phone | Install the app (APK) from `tv.yammbo.com/install`. It isn't on Google Play, so Android asks you to allow installing from that source. Android 5.0 or later. |
| Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV, TV boxes | Install the **Downloader** app on the TV, type the code **4874406** (or `tv.yammbo.com/tv`) and install. To sign in, the TV shows a QR code that you scan with your phone. |
| Windows 10 and 11 | Installer from `tv.yammbo.com/install`, with the same account. |

There is no app for iPhone, iPad or Apple TV.

## In the app

- **What you left halfway** appears on the home screen, and your progress is saved in your account.
- **Add-ons:** you can add catalogs and subtitles from a list Yammbo prepares (for example, Spanish subtitles or anime).

Some internet providers block the server the videos come from. Change your network's DNS to **1.1.1.1** and **8.8.8.8**, as explained on `tv.yammbo.com/install`. More in [A product is loading slowly](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/troubleshooting/slow-loading/).

Questions about your plan or a charge: **support@yammbo.com**, with the email of your Yammbo TV account.

en.title: AI in the editor
en.description: Generating a section, editing a whole section, writing or rewriting text, and creating images with AI — the real buttons, their limits and their messages.
en.body:
Every feature on this page is a **paid-plan** feature (Basic, Standard and Pro) — on the Free plan these buttons appear locked or open "Join the PROs".

The real button names are: **"Create site with AI"**, **"Generate section with AI"**, **"Edit section with AI"**, **"Write with AI"**, **"Edit with AI"** and **"Create AI image"**.

## Generating a section with AI

A button in the **Elements** panel. Pick the **"Section type"** from 18 options (Hero, Features, Pricing, Testimonials, FAQ, Call to action, Team, Contact, About, Stats, Gallery, Newsletter, Menu / Price list, Hours & Location, Reservations / Booking, How it works, Promotion / Offer and Service area), write a **"Describe this section"** prompt (5 to 1,000 characters) and pick a **"Tone"**. Click "Generate".

When it's done you'll see "Section added". Limit: **20 requests per minute**.

## Editing a whole section with AI

Select a full section on the canvas (a header, footer, or any container with 3 or more elements inside) and the Inspector shows the **"Edit section with AI"** button. The "Edit this section with AI" dialog offers suggestions ("Make it dark and elegant", "Give it more breathing room", "Show it in two columns", "Use warmer colours", "Make the heading bigger"), a **"Rebuild from scratch"** checkbox, and an optional **"Design style (optional)"** field (defaulting to "Keep the current look").  Click **"Apply changes"**.

The dialog's promise: "Your text and images are kept. Only what you ask for changes, and you can undo it." Result: "Section updated". If you don't like the result, use **"Undo"**. Same limit: 20 per minute.

## Writing or rewriting text with AI

With a text element selected, the Inspector shows **"Write with AI"** and **"Edit with AI"**.

- **"Write with AI"** opens the "AI text writer": describe what you want and click "Generate".
- To refine text you already wrote: "Simplify language", "Shorten", "Lenghten" (yes, that's the product's own spelling), "Fix spelling & grammar", "Change tone" and "Translate". Then you choose between "Use text" and "Discard".

A fixed notice appears in both dialogs: "AI can make mistakes, so double-check that the results are accurate before using them."

## Creating AI images and stock photos

The "Add an image" dialog has two tabs:

- **"Generate with AI"**: describe the image, pick a style and an aspect ratio (Square, Landscape or Portrait), click "Generate" and then "Use image".
- **"Stock photos"**: search for free photos ("Search free photos, e.g. coffee shop") and click "Use photo". They're free to use; attribution is appreciated but not required.

Without the AI images permission, the button that opens this dialog appears disabled — in practice, that also means no stock photos on the Free plan.

## If something goes wrong

- **Quota used up**: "You have used all the AI tokens included in your plan this month. They reset on the 1st, or you can upgrade for a larger allowance."
- **Invalid AI response**: "AI response could not be parsed. Please try again." — try again; if the section ends up broken, use "Undo".
- **Too many requests**: if you hit the 20-per-minute limit, wait a moment before generating again.

## Next step

Before you publish, check how [preview, save and undo](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/web/preview-save-and-undo/) work.

en.title: Create a site
en.description: The three ways to start a site in Yammbo Web — blank, from a template or with AI — step by step, how long it takes and what to do if it fails.
en.body:
On your **Dashboard**, the **"New site"** button takes you to "Choose a template for your project", where you pick one of these three paths.

## 1. From scratch

Click **"Start with blank page"** → the "Create new site" dialog → enter a **"Name"** (3 to 255 characters, **unique across all of Yammbo Web**, not just your account) → **"Create"**. The editor opens with a blank page.

## 2. From a template

There are **225 templates** across 20 categories (Business, Landing Page, Portfolio, Technology/SaaS, Photography, Restaurant/Cafe and more). Filter with "All categories" or type into "Search...".

- Hover over a template to see **"View"** and **"Select"** (opens "Create new site" → "Name" → "Create").
- If nothing matches: "No matching templates".

The search compares the template's name (in English) against exactly what you type, in lowercase. For example, "Coffee" with a capital letter won't find "coffee". It also only searches the name, not the description.

## 3. With AI ("Create site with AI")

Only available on **paid plans**. On the Free plan the button opens "Join the PROs", telling you building a full site with AI is part of the paid plans.

The "Create site with AI" dialog groups its fields like this:

- **The basics**: "Site name" (required, unique), "Industry / type of business" and **"Describe your business or project"** (required, 10 to 2,000 characters).
- **Help the AI build the right site**: main products or services, target audience, main goal of the site (get leads, book appointments, showcase a portfolio, or inform/build brand awareness), visual style (13 options, "Let AI decide (recommended)" by default), brand colors and a logo (URL or upload).
- **Your real details**: phone/WhatsApp, email, address or service area, hours, menu/price list or catalog, why choose you, real proof, social media, and what to avoid. The dialog warns: "Anything you leave blank, the AI has to invent — and invented details are the first thing you end up rewriting."
- **Sections to include** (13 checkboxes; Services, About, Gallery and Testimonials are checked by default — a header, hero and contact section are always included).
- **Additional pages**: your plan includes up to 5, 10 or 25 pages depending on the plan (including the home page). If you request more, the server silently trims the list.
- **Tone & language**: Tone (Professional, Friendly, Casual, Confident, Inspirational or Playful) and Language ("Español" or "English").

Click **"Generate site"**.

### What happens while it generates

1. First, Yammbo checks the name isn't taken and that you still have generation quota left.
2. You'll see "Designing your website with AI…" or "Designing your website… page 2 of 5", with the note **"This can take a few minutes for multi-page sites. Do not close this window."**
3. When it finishes, the editor opens with "Site created with AI".

The project is created once your browser receives the result. If you close the window before that, the site isn't saved — but the generation has already used up your monthly quota.

### How long it takes

The latest internal measurements show roughly **2.5 minutes for a one-page home**; multi-page sites take longer, since the extra pages are generated in batches after the main frame is done.

### If it fails

If the generation fails, takes more than 30 minutes, or you've already used this month's generations, the dialog goes back to the form without showing any notice. Wait a few minutes and try again; if it keeps happening, email support@yammbo.com.

If a secondary page fails, it's skipped and the rest of the site is still delivered — you can add that page by hand afterwards.

## Next step

With your site created, get familiar with [the editor](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/web/the-editor-screen-map/).

en.title: Create your account and sign in
en.description: Sign up with email, verify with a code, sign in with Google or Twitter (X), and how to recover your password in Yammbo Web.
en.body:
## Create your account

At `/register`, the **"Create a new account"** screen: "Email", "Password" and "Confirm password", with a **"Create account"** button. Registration is open to anyone; there are no policy checkboxes to accept.

- Your password needs a **minimum of 5 characters** and must match the confirmation field.
- Your email must be unique on Yammbo Web. Some email domains are blacklisted; if yours is, you'll see "This domain is blacklisted."

## Verify your email

Verification is mandatory before you can use your account. Instead of a link, you get a **6-digit code** by email. The "Verify your email" screen has a "Code" field and a "Next" button, with a link to resend the code.

If you take a while to check your email, ask for a new code instead of using an old one.

Part of this screen is in English with no Spanish translation either way, for example the note to check your spam folder before requesting a resend.

## Sign in

At `/login`: "Email", "Password", "Forgot your password?", "Stay signed in for a month" and "Continue".

- If your details don't match: "The email or password you entered is incorrect."
- After 5 failed attempts in a minute with the same email: "Too Many Attempts." (always in English). Wait about a minute.

## Signing in with Google or Twitter (X)

On the sign-up and sign-in screens you'll also see **"Continue with Google"** and **"Continue with Twitter"**, under "Or sign in with". Facebook isn't available as an option.

If an account already exists with that email (for example, you'd signed up before with a password), you'll see: "An account with this email address already exists. If you want to connect the two accounts, enter existing account password.", with a **"Connect"** button. From your account, under "Social login" → "Manage social login", you can turn these connections on or off.

## If you forgot your password

At `/forgot-password`, "Forgot my password": enter your email and click "Continue". This time you get a **link** (not a code). Possible messages:

| Message | What it means |
|---|---|
| "We have e-mailed your password reset link!" | Check your email (and spam) |
| "We can't find a user with that e-mail address." | That email has no account |
| "This password reset token is invalid." | The link expired or was already used; request a new one |
| "Your password has been reset!" | You can now sign in with the new password |

## Next step

With your account created, the next step is [Plans and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/web/plans-and-billing/) or straight to [Create a site](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/web/create-a-site/).

en.title: Custom domain
en.description: How many custom domains each paid plan includes, and how to get help connecting yours to your Yammbo Web site.
en.body:
You can publish your Yammbo Web site on a domain you already own, instead of (or alongside) the `web.yammbo.com/sites/your-site` address. It's a paid-plan feature:

| Plan | Custom domains |
|---|---|
| Free | 0 |
| Basic | 1 |
| Standard | 1 |
| Pro | 2 |

Under "Publishing" → "Branded domain" you'll find the **"Connect domain"** button; you can also start from the Dashboard → "Branded domains".

Connecting a domain involves DNS changes that depend on where your domain is registered, and it's best done with help so your domain doesn't go without service in the meantime. Write to **support@yammbo.com** with your domain and which provider you have it with, and we'll walk you through connecting it step by step.

## `www` versus the root domain

Yammbo Web treats `yourdomain.com` and `www.yourdomain.com` as two separate domains, and each one uses up a slot from your plan. Let us know which variant you'll use (with or without `www`) when you write to support.

## Next step

If you don't need a custom domain right now, continue with [Forms and their submissions](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/web/forms-and-submissions/).

en.title: Elements and blocks
en.description: How to insert, drag and search for blocks in the Yammbo Web editor, and the right-click menu to move, duplicate or delete them.
en.body:
## The "Elements" panel

It's organised into accordions by category: components, typography, layout, buttons, forms, media and **Yammbo** (this last category has no translation). In total there are around 41 native elements and **74 Yammbo-specific blocks**.

Among the most-used Yammbo blocks: heroes (centered, gradient, video, aura), navigation bars, footers, pricing, FAQ, testimonials, galleries, team, stats, timeline, contact, **Contact form pro**, **Opening hours** (with "open now"), **WhatsApp order**, **WhatsApp button**, **Booking modal**, **Before / after**, embedded map, embedded video, 404 page and **SEO config**.

## Inserting a block

- **Drag and drop**: drag the block from the panel onto the canvas and drop it where the guide line marks. On touch screens, press and hold before dragging.
- **Tap or click** the block: it gets inserted below the currently selected element, or at the end of the page if nothing is selected.

## Searching for blocks

The "Search blocks…" field also works for Spanish terms — for example, typing "formularios" finds the form blocks. If nothing matches: "No blocks match your search."

## Moving, duplicating and deleting (right-click)

Right-clicking any element on the canvas opens a menu with:

- **Cut**, **Copy**, **Paste**
- **Delete**
- **Duplicate**
- **Move up** / **Move down** (with the arrow keys)
- **Undo** / **Redo**

You can also pick "Select parent" or "Select child" to move through the element hierarchy.

## Rows and columns ("Layout")

In the "Layout" panel: **"+ Add container"** and **"+ Add row"**. For each row you can pick preset columns or "Custom" → "Customize row columns" — the column widths have to add up to 12.

If you're on a paid plan, the "Generate section with AI" button in the Elements panel builds a full section (hero, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, team and more) from a short description. See [AI in the editor](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/web/ai-in-the-editor/).

## Next step

Edit each block's content in [Text, images and styles](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/web/text-images-and-styles/).

en.title: Export or download your site
en.description: Downloading your site as a ZIP (Standard and Pro) or exporting it via FTP (Pro) — what the file includes and what stops working outside Yammbo.
en.body:
Under "Project settings" → the **"Export"** tab.

## Downloading as a ZIP (Standard and Pro)

"Export your site as a zip file" → **"Download zip file"**. Without the required plan you'll see "To download your site as a zip file upgrade your plan."

## Exporting via FTP (Pro only)

"Export to your own FTP server": Host, Username, Password, Directory ("Leave empty to store at root" — in practice the field already comes filled in with your site's name, not empty), Port (21), "Use SSL" and "Remember credentials" → **"Export"** → "Project exported". Without the Pro plan: "To export your site via FTP or as a .zip file upgrade your plan."

The ZIP and the FTP export contain the files exactly as saved, including an internal placeholder instead of the real forms address. Outside Yammbo Web, your contact forms won't receive messages — see [Forms and their submissions](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/web/forms-and-submissions/). The automatic SEO tags generated when the site is served from Yammbo also don't apply.

## When exporting makes sense

Exporting makes sense if you want to move your site to your own hosting or keep a copy outside Yammbo. If you just want to keep receiving contact messages, the simplest option is to keep the site published on Yammbo Web.

## Next step

Organise and manage your sites from [Manage your projects](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/web/manage-your-projects/).

en.title: Frequently asked questions
en.description: Quick answers about pricing, AI, publishing, custom domains, and what doesn't exist yet in Yammbo Web — subdomains, favicon, a store or a blog.
en.body:
## How much does Yammbo Web cost?

There are four plans: Free, Basic ($9/month), Standard ($19/month) and Pro ($39/month), with a discount if you pay annually. See the full table in [Plans and billing](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/web/plans-and-billing/).

## Can I publish more than one site at a time?

No. The limit is **1 published site at a time, on every plan**, including Pro. You can have as many unpublished projects as you want; only one can be live at the same time.

## Is the AI free?

No. Generating a full site, generating or editing sections, and writing or rewriting text with AI are paid-plan features (Basic, Standard and Pro). On the Free plan those buttons appear locked.

## Can I connect my own domain?

Yes, on paid plans (1 domain on Basic and Standard, 2 on Pro). To connect it, write to **support@yammbo.com** and we'll walk you through it — see [Custom domain](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/web/custom-domain/).

## Does Yammbo Web give me a free subdomain?

No. That option doesn't exist today: every site is published at `web.yammbo.com/sites/your-site`.

## Can I set a favicon for my site?

No, there's no option for that in the interface yet.

## Can I duplicate or rename an entire project?

No. You can only duplicate individual pages within the same site, not the whole project, and there's no way to rename it or change its URL from the interface.

## Does Yammbo Web have an HTML editor?

No. The custom code dialog only has CSS and JavaScript tabs; there's no way to edit the HTML directly.

## Can I sell products or run a blog?

Not with Yammbo Web: there's no cart, products, payments or posts module. For selling products online, Yammbo's product for that is **Yammbo Store**.

## Where do I see the messages people send through my contact form?

Under the **"Leads"** tab of "Project settings". Every submission is saved there, even if the email notification fails. See [Forms and their submissions](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/web/forms-and-submissions/).

## If I export my site as a ZIP, do the forms still work?

No. Outside Yammbo Web, forms stop receiving messages — you'd need to hook up a form service on your own hosting.

## Is there autosave?

No. You need to click "Save" yourself; the button only becomes active when there are pending changes.

## Why do I see the app in Spanish?

Because the message is hardcoded, or because your account language is set to Spanish. Change it under Account settings → Location and language → Language → English. See [Your account](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/web/your-account/).

## Where do I ask for help if none of this answers my question?

Write to **support@yammbo.com** telling us what you expected to happen. Before that, check [Troubleshooting](https://help.yammbo.com/docs/en/web/troubleshooting/) — it usually covers most cases.

en.title: Forms and their submissions
en.description: Which forms actually work in Yammbo Web, where to see the messages your visitors send, and why they stop working on an exported site.
en.body:
## Which forms actually work

Three kinds of form really save what a visitor types:
